Its cherished twin pistols, the "", are like little sisters to the "" possessed by Beelzebumon. It opens up to everybody without hesitation, and in particular, it is close friends with many gun-wielding Digimon, and has been given the nickname "" by Magna Kidmon and the like. However, it is at loggerheads with the solitary Beelzebumon, so although it recognizes its competence, it keeps a slight distance. It is dressed in a jet-black leather suit, and it wears a muffler that is able to...

species.name: Beelzebumon
species.profile: A Demon Lord Digimon that, while possessing the power to preside over the many Devil Digimon, continues to act independently. As one of the "Seven Great Demon Lords", it is said that it could stand at the peak of the dark army, "Nightmare Soldiers", if it cared to, although it is also said that there exists a Demon Lord Digimon which surpasses even Beelzebumon. It rides the gigantic motorcycle-type machine, "", and wields its cherished shotguns, the "". Although its personality is cruel and merciless, it is also exceedingly prideful, so it would never gang up with others or attack the weak....

species.name: Beelzebumon: Blast Mode
species.kanji: ベルゼブモンブラストモード
species.profile: An ultimate Demon Lord that raised its power and spirit to their utmost limits. Instead of evolving in a wicked manner, it maintained a calmer mental state, and its three sinister red eyes have become green. It demonstrates power and speed at a level incomparable to its usual state, and four jet-black wings grow from its back. One could almost say that the opponent no longer exists the moment they stand before Beelzebumon when it took on this form. Its right arm is integrated with its , which fires powerful energy waves to disintegrate everything into atoms. Its Signature Move is firing a...

species.name: Beelzebumon (2010 Anime Version)
species.profile: An aloof demon warrior possessing terrifying destructive power. Although its taciturnity and indifference towards others give the impression that it has a calm personality, in actuality, it loves battle more than anyone else. It is considered one of the strongest Digimon, and anyone who sees Beelzebumon and still challenges it to a fight is nothing but a fool. Also, Beelzebumon will never run away from a battle it was challenged to. Its "Death the Cannon", fired from the gigantic "" gun on its right arm, is a technique which has tremendous power, but what poses the most danger is the fact...

species.name: Beelzebumon + Revolmon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Shoutmon, Proof of a King!"

species.name: Belial Vamdemon
species.kanji: ベリアルヴァンデモン
species.profile: A Demon Lord Digimon said to be Vamdemon's final form. Unlike Venom Vamdemon, which lost its intelligence by seeking too much power and was like a beast, it succeeded in surpassing Venom Vamdemon by harmonizing its intelligence alongside all of its other aspects. It possesses an inhumanly cruel personality, and is willing to do anything to achieve its own desires. The organic cannons on both its left and right shoulders, "Sodom and Gomorrah" respectively, leech off of it. Its Special Move is an extremely high-temperature beam that it fires from its shoulders, and (Pandemonium Flame).

species.name: Belphemon: Rage Mode
species.kanji: ベルフェモンレイジモード
species.profile: It is said that Belphemon awakens from its eternal slumber once in a thousand years, and regains its natural shape. When Belphemon awakens from its slumber it changes into an incarnation of rage, and anything that enters its field of vision becomes a target for destruction. It is said that just by suffering Belphemon: Rage Mode's roar, Perfect Digimon and below will have their data disintegrated and die instantly, and not even Ultimate Digimon can escape unharmed. Its Special Moves are black flames cast from the chains coiled around its body (Lampranthus), and a slash attack which is...

species.name: Belphemon: Sleep Mode
species.kanji: ベルフェモンスリープモード
species.profile: A Demon Lord Digimon said to be sealed in the deepest parts of the Dark Area. As the strength it possesses is too immense, its data is said to have been put in a sleep state by the Digital World's system, although the truth of the matter is uncertain. Because it has fallen into a deep sleep, it cannot unleash attacks on its own, but it is able to inflict damage on Digimon with just its snores, and for that reason it won't be easy to attack Belphemon: Sleep Mode in its sleep. Its Special Moves are the "Eternal Nightmare" it invokes with its peaceful snoring, and black flames produced from...

species.name: Belphemon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: It is said that once every thousand years, Belphemon awakens from its prolonged slumber and regains its natural form. When Belphemon awakens from its slumber, it transforms into an incarnation of rage, and anything that enters its field of vision becomes a target for destruction. It is said that just by suffering Belphemon: Rage Mode's roar, Digimon of the Perfect level and below will have their data disintegrated and die instantly, and not even Ultimate Digimon can escape unharmed. Its Special Moves are black flames cast from the chains coiled around its body (Lampranthus), and a slash...

species.name: BEMmon
species.profile: An artificial Digimon that was created experimentally by someone. Programmed only with the command codes for "eating and getting stronger", once it defeats an enemy, it uses its "Fusionize" to turn them into its flesh and blood.Its Special Move is piercing the enemy with its sharp claws (Messer Claw).

species.name: Beowolfmon
moves: Licht Angriff Cleansing Light Lightning Missile
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Light that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten and acquiring unknown abilities. It is a strong-armed warrior that possesses both the wildness of a beast and the intelligence of a human, and can easily swing down its double-bladed greatsword "Trinity" with one hand. In battle, it coolly sizes up the situation and fights without getting heated up, but it believes in the way of the warrior, of fighting for its comrades and challenging strong opponents. It has the "Roland missile " missile pod on its left...

species.name: Betamon
species.profile: A quadrupedal Amphibian Digimon. Although Betamon has a gentle, docile personality, once it is angered, it emits its "Dengeki Biririn" from its body, generating more than 1 MV of electricity to strike the opponent.

species.name: Betamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An Amphibian Digimon that walks on four legs. Its personality is gentle, but although it is a docile Digimon, once Betamon is angered it emits its "Dengeki Biririn" from its body, generating more than 1 MV of electric current to strike the opponent.As a Digimon used for enjoyment by some enthusiasts due to its emerald green body color and gentle personality, it continues to be overhunted, and although it is endangered, it is gradually becoming experienced at fighting as a lifeform that evolves into a fine Aquatic Digimon. Both the claws on its feet and its crest have grown, and it now...

species.name: Betel Gammamon
species.profile: A form in which Gammamon grew up, and its body turned red due to the flames of its blazing heart. Its agility has increased, and its power and speed in close combat have risen even more. The power of its attacks doubles as the excitement of its emotions swells.Its Special Moves are "w=4865 Sor", in which it punches the enemy with the flames it amasses in its hands, and "Sorshot", in which it hurls the flames in its hands, albeit less powerful.
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Gammamon Dim Card)

species.name: Betsumon
species.profile: An eccentric Digimon that impersonates all sorts of Digimon in order to confuse the enemy. While it is a Puppet Digimon, similarly to Etemon and Monzaemon, it is a rare type capable of disguising itself as various types of Digimon by changing the (?) it wears. Its Special Moves are "Tsukkomi Punch", which despite only having the power of a straight man's interjections has the ability to mentally drain the opponent, and "Cold Gag", an attack which utilises its dubious gaze and cryptic gags to stop opponents in their tracks, as if they have been frozen.

species.name: Bibimon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Big Mamemon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon that acts as a boss-like figure towards Mamemon, which hold the alias of "". It's said that it is actually an aggregation of Mamemon. While regular Mamemon are around the same size as Baby Digimon, they possess a degree of power unimaginable from their appearance; however, as its name suggests, Big Mamemon is dozens or even hundreds of times the size of a Mamemon. That said, the reason why it is considered a "Mamemon" even at this size is still unclear. Its personality is extremely gentle, and it hates conflict and battle. It is always playing with its Mamemon followers....

species.name: Big Ukkomon
species.profile: A Digimon that is thought to have appeared the moment the ancient Digital World was destroyed. It is said that it sacrificed its own life to summon a Digitama from the sorrow of the Digimon that disappeared one after another as a result of the destruction. However, there are no records of whether this act had been accomplished or not. Although the existence of Ultimates known as the legendary Ten Warriors has been documented during the era of the ancient Digital World, it is presumed that Big Ukkomon also possessed an amount of data equivalent to an Ultimate, but it has not been possible to...

species.name: Bio Coatlmon
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "Masaru's Memory is Erased, The Lost Bond"

species.name: Bio Darkdramon
species.kanji: バイオダークドラモン
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "Final Decisive Battle! Kouki, Ultimate Evolution" "

species.name: Bio Lotusmon
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "Genius Showdown! Thoma VS Nanami"

species.name: Bio Spinomon
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "The Fierce Attack of Kurata's Army Corps, Protect the Holy Capital"

species.name: Bio Stegomon
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "Masaru's Memory is Erased, The Lost Bond"

species.name: Bio Thunderbirmon
species.kanji: バイオサンダーバーモン
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "Masaru's Memory is Erased, The Lost Bond"

species.name: Birdramon
species.profile: A Giant Bird Digimon which has an appearance shrouded in blazing flames. Just like Meramon, it is a Digimon that was generated from the Internet's defensive "Firewall". It flaps its gigantic wings, and flies about the sky. Although its personality is in no way combative, it unleashes counterattacks against attacking enemies to a furious degree. Its Special Move is flapping its wings and hurling its feathers like meteors (Meteor Wing).

species.name: Bishop Chessmon (Black)
species.kanji: ビショップチェスモン（黒）
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that freely uses technical arts. The reach of its attacks is very wide, so it can strike at long-range enemies.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Bagra Brothers, The Bond of Darkness!"

species.name: Bishop Chessmon (White)
species.kanji: ビショップチェスモン（白）
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that freely uses technical arts. The reach of its attacks is very wide, so it can strike at long-range enemies. Its catchphrase is, "Oh Lord, give me strength!" Its Special Moves are a long ray of light fired from its staff (Bishop Laser), and annihilating the opponent with a cruciform magic circle (Bishop Cross). Also, it can freely wield its staff in close combat, bewitching the opponent (Magical Stick).

species.name: Bitmon
species.profile: An Armor Level Mammal Digimon that evolved with the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". It possesses not only long ears, but also claws on its forelegs that are sharp enough to crush even diamonds, and which it uses to dig through the strata no matter how solid. It is rumored that from time to time, it will run into ancient fossils as it travels underground, which it keeps as part of its collection. Its body and head are covered by armor created from the gathering of minerals, which allows it to absorb the impact from attacks when it curls its body into a ball. It has a very gentle...

species.name: Black Galgomon
species.profile: A species of Galgomon, its specialty is ambushing the enemy in the dark. It excels more than a normal Galgomon in terms of tactics and combat strength due to the effects of the "Black Digitron" mixed into its body, and primarily specializes in taijutsu. Its Special Moves are "Gatling Arm", in which it randomly fires the vulcans on both of its arms, and the intense exploding uppercut "w=Dumdum Upper".

species.name: Black Gaogamon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon that resulted as Gaomon's physique got larger, its claws that were once protected by gloves have grown steadily. "Black Digitron" was mixed in during its growth process, resulting in it taking on this black form. It is more resilient and takes less damage as compared to normal Gaogamon, at the expense of its speed. Its Special Moves are approaching the opponent at a speed faster than the eye can see and unleashing its "Dash Double Claw", and biting the opponent with its sturdy teeth, not letting go until they collapse (Gaoga Hound). Also, it can release a powerful vortex of...

species.name: Black Growmon
species.profile: A Demon Dragon Digimon that is called the "". Although it is fundamentally the same species as Growmon, it has more of a Virus-species' nature, and is said to be the natural form of Growmon. Unlike a Growmon raised by a Tamer, it can roughly be described as having gone feral. Black Growmon's roar is identical to Growmon's, having the power to shake the solid earth, and before battle it raises its voice to an offensive roar to intimidate the opponent. Its Signature Move is developing plasma along the blades on both of its elbows, then striking the opponent (Plasma Blade). Its Special Move is...

species.name: Black King Numemon
species.kanji: ブラックキングヌメモン
species.profile: A jet-black Numemon that has established its position as King of the dark trash data world and became a Perfect. It carries a crown it picked up on its back like a shell, and also grew a mustache. As it is dignified, it tries to refrain from poop attacks which violate its dignity, but uses them on impulse. Its Special Move is firing black beams from its round eyes (Dark Pupil). Also, its "Poison Mucus", in which it splashes a liquid that its mouth contains copious amounts of, makes the body smelly and sticky, and poisons it, causing insufferable pain.

species.name: Black Mach Gaogamon
species.kanji: ブラックマッハガオガモン
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that carries rocket engines with enormous propulsive power on its back. The sudden introduction of "Black Digitron" into its body resulted in it taking on this black form. Although it is now able to stay airborne for longer periods at a time, its maximum speed has decreased. Its Special Moves are circling the opponent with maximum thrust and unleashing an extremely high-speed barrage (Gaoga Tornado), and a blow of its fist boasting supreme impact strength (Winning Knuckle). Also, it can attack with the ultrasonic waves released in a single howl (Howling Cannon).

species.name: Black Megalo Growmon
species.kanji: ブラックメガログラウモン

species.name: Black Rapidmon
species.kanji: ブラックラピッドモン
species.profile: A black form of Rapidmon made for night combat after "Black Digitron" was mixed into its body. Despite falling, its speed allows it to move without making a sound. Its ability to capture enemies with its ear-shaped radar remains unchanged, and it specializes in fighting in the dark, and it can be said to be almost impossible to win against Black Rapidmon in night combat. Its Special Moves are rapid-firing homing missiles from its revolver and both of its arms (Rapid Fire), and firing a beam from its whole body that disassembles the enemy's data (Golden Triangle).

species.name: Black Saint Galgomon
species.kanji: ブラックセントガルゴモン
species.profile: A type of Saint Galgomon specialising in entering enemy territory to attack, it is equipped with massive amounts of armaments. Although it lacks speed, it is able to utilise the heat-based weapons located all over its body to counterattack in all directions without moving an inch. Its Special Move is firing all of the heavy artillery on its body at once (Burst Shot).

species.name: Black Seraphimon
species.kanji: ブラックセラフィモン
species.profile: A form of Seraphimon, the highest ranking Angel Digimon, whose concealed inner resentment tumefied and engulfed it in darkness. Its gold wings and armor have transformed ominously, and it is said that it will fall and become a Demon Lord Digimon if this condition persists for long. Its Special Moves are firing seven super-heated spheres of darkness (Seven Hells), and its greatest special technique, which sacrifices its mortal life to incinerate its enemy with hellfire (Testament).
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "Takuya's Fusion Evolution, Aldamon's Explosive Attack!"

species.name: Black Seraphimon (DW3)
species.kanji: ブラックセラフィモン

species.name: Black Shoutmon X7
species.kanji: ブラックシャウトモンＸ７

species.name: Black Tailmon
species.profile: A Virus attribute Tailmon who sports vivid, pitch-black fur. A child completely born of evil, it lives its life treading through the ominous darkness. Black Tailmon is a variety of Tailmon that is born very rarely, and as such is said to have a low population size. It has a mean and prideful personality, and is a problematic Digimon that loves picking on the weak. It is a dark-type Digimon that generally evolves into Fallen Angel Digimon. Its Special Move is "Neko Punch", the same as Tailmon's.

species.name: Black Tailmon Uver.
species.kanji: ブラックテイルモン Uver.
species.profile: A form that Black Tailmon transformed into by absorbing large amounts of courier service data that flowed into the Digital World in recent years. Its mean personality has completely gone, and it delivers ordered packages with full dedication, whatever the day. It is often seen delivering things while clinging to the back of Pistmon, who it is on good terms with. The delivery bag on its back is capable of keeping anything warm or cool in optimal condition, and since it can only be opened and closed by Black Tailmon, it is safe even for confidential data.It eliminates Digimon that get in the...

species.name: Black War Greymon
species.kanji: ブラックウォーグレイモン
species.profile: A Virus-species War Greymon feared as the "". Although its creed and principles are the polar opposite of those of the Virus Busters War Greymon, it exists for the sake of its own peculiar "Justice". It detests cowardice and foul play, and doesn't consider itself a fellow of vulgar Digimon even if they are of the same Virus-species. How exactly it converted into a Virus is a mystery, and the "" equipped to its back is not engraved with the Crest of Courage. Its Special Move is similar to War Greymon's "", except that it takes all of the "negative emotions" within this world and concentrates...

species.name: Black War Greymon (X-Antibody)
species.kanji: ブラックウォーグレイモン（X抗体）
species.profile: Feared as the "", it is a Virus-species War Greymon. Although its creed and principles are the polar opposite of those of the Virus Busters War Greymon, it exists for the sake of its own peculiar "Justice". It detests cowardice and foul play, and it doesn't consider itself a fellow of vulgar Digimon, even if they are of the same Virus-species. How exactly it converted into a Virus is a mystery, and the "" equipped to its back is not engraved with the Crest of Courage. Its Special Move is similar to War Greymon's "", except that it takes all of the "negative emotions" within this world and...

species.name: Blade Kuwagamon
species.kanji: ブレイドクワガーモン
species.profile: An Insect-type Machine Digimon whose entire body has been weaponized. Although it is an Adult, it is a rare species whose whole body has been turned into Chrome Digizoid. It has a habit of reacting indiscriminately to anything that moves, and even Ultimate Digimon have been known to get pierced all over their bodies when attacked by a swarm of Blade Kuwagamon, killing them. Its Special Moves are turning into a blade of light and piercing with it (Spark Blade), and generating a vacuum wave (Air Knife).
species.debut: Bo-1165 (Digitalize Booster Pack) or Digimon Accel Justice Genome

species.name: Blastmon
species.profile: A super-heavyweight Digimon with a mineral body. It is clad in a hard crystal armor that regenerates when broken, and boasts a number of various, powerful techniques, so its slowly moving form is the epitome of an impregnable moving fortress. Because of its glittering body and power, it calls itself the "most beautiful, sublime creature."Its "Diamond Machine Gun", which fires off the crystals throughout its body like a machine gun, alongside an intense punch, can sweep through hundreds of enemies in one shot, and its "Diamond Hedgehog", which capitalizes on its hard body and great weight,...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Taiki, Go to Another World!"

species.name: Blimpmon
species.profile: A Vehicle Digimon just like Mechanorimon, it flies in the skies without a care in the world. Although its delicate balloon portion is protected by a metallic coating, it seems to still be under construction as its left flank is left exposed. Its Signature Move is shooting bullets of helium gas and detonating them (Helium Bomb). Its Special Move is firing cannonballs from the two large cannons seated on its top (Zeppelin Explosion).

species.name: Blitz Greymon
species.profile: An ultimate form of Greymon-species Digimon, it is a subspecies of War Greymon armed with electric-powered weapons.It reinforces its heavyweight grappling with electricity, striking with the "" on both arms, which send electric current flowing into even the sturdiest of structures and destroying them from within.It is capable of rotating the "" on its back to face forward, from which it fires electricity, or using them while faced backwards to propel it forward.Not only that, it is capable of releasing plasma particles into its surroundings and using them to erect a barrier around it (Elec...

species.name: Blitzmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder which bears the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors. Its keen movements, unbecoming of its large build, are a technique to form a high voltage current running throughout its body. It generates a special magnetic field that produces an anti-gravity state in its vicinity, and is capable of high-speed movement. Its overflowing thunder power comes out as sparks from various parts of its body, and although Blitzmon looks mechanical, its personality is, in contrast, expressive and human. Its language is trollish, but it additionally conveys...

species.name: Blizzarmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice, and bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. Although its behaviour is better described as recklessness rather than dauntless courage, it is in any case a ruffian overflowing with enthusiasm and ambition. It is extremely curious, loves being in the limelight, and tends to get carried away. Even during battle, it gets up to humorous antics such as striking a pose while offering a prayer unto the god of ice and snow it follows, or calling out the names of its Special Moves. In actuality, however, it is also closely observing the opponent...

species.name: Bloom Lordmon
species.profile: A Fairy Digimon in the form of a plant clad in armor, it is a kind-hearted knight that fights to protect nature. It accumulates energy by absorbing sunlight through the flowers on its shoulders. The power it exhibits once that energy has been raised to its limit is said to even rival that of the Royal Knights. It has the ability to turn any foul weather into fine weather, and creates battlefields that always work to its advantage when out in the open.Its Special Moves are shooting countless seeds from the petals on its left shoulder like a machine gun (Multiple Seed), and piercing the enemy...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Hermit in the Jungle Dim Card)

species.name: Blossomon
species.profile: With the appearance of a giant flower, it is a Perfect Plant Digimon that grew countless vines as roots from its body. Despite its strange appearance it is very docile, and due to its personality it rarely appears before others. For a plant it has an unusually long life span, and although the petals around its body (or face, really) fall out whenever the seasons change, it has the special ability to grow back new petals. It hates arid regions, and always inhabits areas near water. Its Special Move is hurling the tiny flowers growing from its vine tips like they were shuriken (Spiral...

species.name: Blucomon
species.profile: A Small Dragon Digimon that resides in areas isolated from the outside world by ice. Its physical strength has been tempered by cold, harsh environment, allowing it to lift objects larger than itself with ease. However, because its body is made mainly out of ice, its body will shrink and its power will weaken when exposed to high temperatures. Due to being brought up in areas with small populations, they will tend to form very strong bonds even with Digimon of different species that they encounter. It is especially close to Penmon. Its Special Moves are exhaling chilled air from its mouth,...

species.name: Blue Meramon
species.profile: A Flame Digimon that burns with higher temperature flames than the Adult-level Meramon. Its Special Move is inflicting burns on the opponent with supercooled air (Ice Phantom).

species.name: Boarmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Courage". A Digimon that undoubtedly exists to embody the term "rushing recklessly", its legs, tail and mane are shrouded in blazing flames. No one can stop a Boarmon from dashing, and according to one theory, it is said that the program that governs Boarmon's thinking has no concept of "turning". Because the "" made of Chrome Digizoid is attached to its brow, all obstacles in front of it are completely smashed. Its Special Move is inhaling large amounts of air in the atmosphere, and releasing...

species.name: Bokomon
species.profile: An old man-like Mutation Digimon wrapped in a haramaki. A knowledgeable Digimon scholar, it carries the "", which has things about the Digital World written in detail, but barely ever shows it. As it is poor at fighting, it is usually boisterous and lively, but when push comes to shove, it becomes surprisingly reliable, instantly taking on a serious look. Its Special Move is running away at tremendous speed when it feels that it can't win (Nigeashimou Dash).
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "The Legendary Warrior! Agnimon of Fire"

species.name: Bolgmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder, which bears the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors. It has a cautious and prudent personality because it was discovered in a defense system created in reference to the Scarab treasure chamber in the deepest part of a pyramid. During battle, it patiently serves as a shield for its comrades using its sturdy armor and endures the opponent's attacks, but once it reaches its critical point, it will go on an intense offensive with all of its gunports until the opponent is reduced to nothing. Because its heavy weight lowers its mobility, it...

species.name: Boltmon
species.profile: A prototype Cyborg Digimon constructed at the same time as Andromon. Unlike the machine-based Andromon, the flesh-based Boltmon possessed emotions, as well as power that surpassed Andromon's; however, it was difficult to control and ran wild, and thus the matter was covered up. It is an unfortunate Digimon whose own existence was denied, and so it wanders within the darkness of its sorrow. Its Special Move is wielding its gigantic battle axe with ease (Tomahawk Steiner).

species.name: Bomber Nanimon
species.profile: It seems to be a subspecies of Nanimon, who came from the Digital World of another dimension to invade this one, but the truth is unclear. As its name suggests, its whole body has turned into a bomb, and it appears that its body became one as it continued to battle in the Digital World. Another of its features is that the hair on its calvaria has become a fuse. Its Special Moves are throwing bombs that never miss their mark (Free Throw Bomb), and unleashing a powerful explosive punch (Baku Oyaji Punch).

species.name: Bombermon
species.profile: The self-proclaimed "" who loves explosions more than anything else. Its sole guiding principle is how beautifully the bombs it creates will detonate, and it has no feelings towards the damage caused by their explosions. It is capable of generating its standalone "" bombs by snapping the fingers on its left hand. The receive Bombermon's instructions, move to the target of the explosion, attach themselves to the target, and then detonate. The explosive power of the varies depending on Bombermon's emotions; the higher its spirits are, the more powerful they will be. During battle, it uses its...

species.name: Bombmon
species.profile: A short-tempered Digimon that easily blows its top at trivial things. As it loses its temper, its topknot steadily shortens, and when the topknot has completely retracted into its head, its anger explodes. Although it has Special Moves like "Bomberhead", which heaps shock-waves upon the opponent, and "Fireworks Revolution", which scatters particles of various colors, all of them have the power of a firecracker. However, because of its vivid beauty, it is often enjoyed as a party entertainment. It is a nuisance for Bombmon that it is provoked even though it is at a party.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Rival!! The Blue Hound Kiriha!!"

species.name: Bommon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon which has a bomb-shaped body. The fuse on its tail ignites the moment it hatches from its egg and steadily grows shorter, but because it evolves to the next generation before the fuse disappears, nobody knows what will happen if the fuse went out. It possesses a short-tempered personality, and it's said that when it gets in a bad mood, the progress of the fuse gets faster. Because its fuse's "Bachibachibacchin" sparks produce an intense noise, any opponent would be surprised if they were suddenly produced before their eyes.

species.name: Boogiemon
species.profile: An eerie-looking Demon Man Digimon. Numerous tattoos containing evil incantations are carved onto its body, and it is apparently capable of casting as many spells as it has tattoos. Rather than fight head-on, it is a coward that usually lies in wait and launches ambush attacks on the enemy from the darkness. Its Special Move is stabbing the enemy with the trident it wields in its right hand (Death Clash).

species.name: Bosamon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Angoramon Dim Card)

species.name: Botamon
species.profile: A Digital Monster that was born just recently. On the surface of its slime-shaped body, it has grown thick, black fuzz. It is unable to battle as it has just been born, but it can produce bubble-like objects from its mouth to intimidate the enemy.

species.name: Boutmon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Bowmon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet BE (BEMemory Digimon Seekers Loogamon Dim)

species.name: Brachimon
species.profile: A Plesiosaur Digimon resembling the Brachiosaurus that existed long ago. It is quite the heavyweight among dinosaur Digimon, so you'll be in for a world of hurt if you get trampled by its large body. However, because it is herbivorous and docile, it never attacks without reason. Its Special Move is spitting out countless bubbles to attack the enemy (Brachio Bubble).

species.name: Breakdramon
species.profile: A gigantic Machine Dragon Digimon said to exist in order to destroy everything in existence. During evolution, it succeeded in obtaining the design data for various construction equipment through hacking, and thus it possesses power and ability surpassing other Machine Digimon. However, in exchange for excellent mechanical performance, its organic parts were reduced almost to 0, and its motives and emotions were lost. For that reason, it does not falter when taking damage, and it is feared as the ultimate dragon of destruction that will continue destroying until it rusts away. Its...

species.name: Bryweludramon
species.profile: An Ultimate Legend-Arms shield Digimon, virtually all of its body is comprised of shields and has taken the form of a dragon. By attaining the data of "Legendary Shields" from mythology and video games, it evolved to become a shield with absolute hardness that cannot be scratched by any attack. While appearance-wise it seems to be made from Red Digizoid, the extent of its hardness cannot be analyzed. Bryweludramon has two standalone AI units, "" and "", which allow it to see in all directions. "" and "" also possess barriers made from flames, and are able to extend the range of their...

species.name: Bubbmon
species.profile: Although it looks like merely pale green bubbles at first glance, it is actually a Bubble Digimon that can move freely and express a plethora of facial expressions. Because its surface has not hardened yet, its defensive power is practically nonexistent and it is unsuited for combat. It produces tiny bubbles which proliferate infinitely from the pacifier-like part it holds in its mouth. This proliferation ability was being used for computer virus development at one point, but because its life force was too weak, that was fortunately never implemented. Although its life is fleeting, it is a...

species.name: Budmon
species.profile: Blended from the data of various poisonous plants, it is a Plant Digimon which has the form of a flower bud. Usually, it drifts through the air carried by its leaf, and doesn't attack as long as nothing happens. Its Special Move is its "Dokutogetoge", which are painful if touched. If it gets angry, it can also fire off the thorns.

species.name: Bulkmon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Bullmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved with the power of the "Digimental of Hope". Its appearance is that of a fighting bull, and it possesses tremendous charging and destructive power. However, due to the fact that it is only capable of charging forward, and that it always charges forth at full speed, it is incapable of reversing or turning. Not only that, it has a fairly short temper, and a weakness in that gets agitated the moment it sees anything red. Its Special Move is charging forward at great speed and using its two horns to strike up towards the enemy (Matador Dash).

species.name: Buraimon
species.profile: A Bird Man Digimon that evolved after continuous sword training. After training, it acquired enough skill to freely wield two swords. It is on a training pilgrimage, wandering across the Digital World while working as a bodyguard, relying on its honed sword abilities. It is rumored to take any job for a reward, and is often treated as an outlaw. However, it actually has a kind nature that never forgets its spirit of helping the weak, and will never take jobs that torment the weak.Its Special Moves are mincing the enemy with a cross-slash that it quickly unleashes with both its swords...

species.name: Burgamon
species.profile: A Digimon that took in the data of various hamburgers. It enjoys serving hamburgers that it puts all of its skill into making to hungry Digimon most of all. It aims to start a first-rate hamburger restaurant that will bring in a lot of customers with Ebi Burgamon. It is merciless to those who disturb others while they are eating, and drives them away with its "Delicious Patty", where it places the opponent inside a large, delicious patty and kneads them, and "Green Pickles", in which it throws a pickle-shaped disk at them like a frisbee.

species.name: Burgamon Adult
species.profile: It is a Digimon that evolves from Child-level Burgamon that consist of carefully selected ingredient data and have a pure heart. It is a kind Digimon whose purpose in life is to cook, and serves other Digimon without asking for anything in return. Its Special Moves are causing the enemy to lose their fighting spirit with onion slices full of pepper (Spicy Onion), and placing them in a huge patty (Delicious Patty).

species.name: Burpmon
species.profile: There are times when Digimon with great appetites eat more than they can manage, and mutate into Burpmon. Once in this form, they will never become full regardless of how much they eat, and hate moving around, idling away. It keeps eating while rolling about in search of food, and will devour anything once it runs out of food and goes hungry. It seems that if one chooses to limit the amount of food they eat and continue exercising, they will return to their former state.

species.name: Bushi Agumon
species.profile: A wandering super-swordsman -- my name is Bushi Agumon. The family crest adorning its chest is proof of its status as a super-swordsman, at least according to Bushi Agumon itself, though there's no denying that its swordsmanship is first-rate. However, the meaning behind its 'super-swordsman' title is a mystery. Its Special Moves are "Choukousoku Ichimonjigiri" and "Chouteisoku Ichimonjigiri". It appears to excel at attacking at varied paces.

species.name: Butenmon
species.profile: A God Man Digimon clad in crimson armor, wielding a greatsword, it evolves from Digimon who have honed their sword abilities through repeated battles. Despite being a Perfect, it is an expert who has already mastered swordsmanship. Possessing sword techniques that even feel elegant and such incredible strength that is said to shatter mountains, the way it runs across the battlefield with its greatsword in hand is truly a statement for someone worth a thousand warriors.Its Special Move is fully swinging its greatsword at high speed, as if drawing a circle, bisecting enemies in its path...

species.name: Butterflamon
species.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Knowledge". Like Flybeemon and Honeybeemon, it is a mythical Digimon that was born due to the power of the Digimental during a large Kunemon outbreak. It prefers living in areas with flower beds and a warm climate. It hates conflict and has a friendly personality. Its Special Move "Sweet Pheromone" is a technique for protecting itself when it has no other options, causing phosphorus powder containing a hallucinogenic program stored in its wings to rain down on the opponent and confuse them. This...

species.name: Calamaramon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Water, which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. It has a half-human, half-beast appearance, and its tentacles are used offensively and defensively to either attack the enemy by rapidly spinning them, or guard its body by gathering them together to form a wall. If it is unable to win while attacking and defending with its tentacles, it will retract its body into its mantle and perform a powered-up attack in the form of a giant squid. The elasticity of its mantle is superior to that of its tentacles, so external physical attacks are...

species.name: Callismon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a bear. Although it is considered to be a Digimon that evolved from the Gryzmon line, all Callismon are mutants that evolved from individuals that underwent data abnormalities. It is unknown whether the data abnormalities responsible for this occurred suddenly or were caused intentionally, and because its population is small, there are many mysteries surrounding it such as its ecology and evolution requirements.It has extremely high combat ability, owing to its hugely developed arms and armaments, and exhibits a ferocious nature that will...

species.name: Candmon
species.profile: A Flame Digimon whose Digicore, which can also be said to be a Digimon's heart, burns intensely while mounted atop its head. When the Digicore on its head ceases to burn, Candmon becomes unable to maintain its life processes. One theory suggests that the flame on its head is its true form, and that the rest of its body is naught but a dummy. Despite being a Flame Digimon, it has a docile personality and will not cause harm to its surroundings out of its own volition. Its Special Move is spitting out small fireballs (Bonfire).

species.name: Cannonbeemon
species.profile: A massive Digimon that defends the mysterious "aerial, covert honey base, Royal Base". Although the aerial base is exposed to danger from all angles, Cannonbeemon is able to cover a vast range with a bombarding barrage fired simultaneously from the gigantic arms containers on its upper body. Also, even if the opponent is heavily armored, it can use its Special Move "Nitro Stinger" to shoot clean through them with its high-caliber laser cannon. Its "Sky Rocket ∞" fires shots from its containers, which boast an innumerable number of loaded ordnance, and will continue furiously until the coast...

species.name: Cannonbeemon (Aircraft Carrier)
species.kanji: キャノンビーモン （空母型）

species.name: Cannondramon
species.profile: A Cyborg type Digimon equipped with long-distance cannons. Covered in tough armor, it greets approaching enemies with a swing of its tail. Its Signature Move is random-firing grenades from the gun on its front (Grenade Storm). Its Special Move is firing its cannons while stationed at an area where enemy attacks cannot reach (Dyna Cannon).

species.name: Canoweissmon
species.profile: A Sky Dragon Digimon with large wings, its body surface has turned a high-purity white as a result of the flames of its blazing heart further intensifying. It prefers fair matches in terms of power and speed, and shows a joyful expression as the battle heats up. However, it will not permit injustice or unjust actions, and takes them on in a righteous manner to overcome them. It is said that when it draws out power that transcends its limits during battle, its whole body will glitter with white light, and become so bright that it can even be detected from the Digital Worlds of other...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Gammamon Dim Card)

species.name: Caprimon
species.profile: A tiny Baby Digimon wearing a metallic helmet. Within the two horns attached to its helmet, it has antennae that are able to receive any radio wave or sound. Caprimon has bat-like traits such as having weak eyesight, instead producing ultrasonic waves from its mouth to detect objects ahead of it based on the rebounding sound waves. For that reason, Caprimon is able to remain active regardless of whether it is day or night. Its technique is generating a resonance between its two horns (Howling Hertz); even a large Digimon will have their sense of hearing paralyzed if they suffer this technique.

species.name: Captain Hookmon
species.kanji: キャプテンフックモン

species.name: Catch Mamemon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon that evolved from a Mamemon that fused with file management software data. It has a serious personality and an uncompromising side, and seems to think that managing Digitama is its duty. It is also capable of walking instead of floating, by using its arm parts as legs. Its Special Move is catching any Digimon that try to lay their hands on the Digitama, and in order to ensure that they do not retaliate, it uses a mysterious power to turn them into a plush toy and carries them away (Magic Arm). Not only that, its slots start spinning the moment it makes a catch; if they...

species.name: Caturamon
species.debut: Digimon Tamers: "Impmon Evolves! The Shudder of Beelzebumon the Dark Lord" or Bo-571 (Booster 12)

species.name: Centalmon
species.profile: A half-man, half-beast Digimon with a humanoid upper body and a bestial lower body. Its body is protected by a hard substance secreted onto the surface from its insides, and its right arm has fused to become one with its weapon. The ducts extending from its back spout high-pressure vapor, allowing it to move at near-sonic speed, though only for an instant. It has outstanding defense, attack, and speed. It is extremely prideful, and absolutely despises being ordered around or restrained. Its Special Move is using the Hunting Cannon which has become one with its right arm. It is near...

species.name: Cerberumon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon called the "". The claws on its feet are hard enough to easily tear through Chrome Digizoid alloys, if they have a low purity. Also, its body is protected by a hard living shell, which has the ability to instantly repair any damage it incurs. The armor on its shoulders each possess sentience, and are able to instantly sense an attack coming from any direction, then report it to Cerberumon's central body. Its Signature Move, "Inferno Gate", is opening a "Hell Gate" engraved in the earth, then casting the opponent through it to the jet-black Dark Area. Its Special Move...

species.name: Cerberumon: Werewolf Mode
species.kanji: ケルベロモン：人狼モード
species.profile: A mutation of Cerberumon, who resides in the Dark Area and is known as the "". It feared that the data born from "human malice", overflowing on the Internet as text and images, could have an impact on the Digital World, so it mutated into this form in order to prevent an influx of that data.Its entire body, covered in an organic shell, is now capable of walking on two legs, and its data was rewritten as a sturdy body with arms that have developed to crunch through evil-tainted data.Its Special Moves are firing flame shots at point-blank range while biting the opponent with the large heads...

species.name: Ceresmon
species.profile: One of the Olympos XII, Ceresmon is a monstrous, gigantic bird Digimon that carries on its back the "", a forest bearing the Digital World's greatest sweets and famous fruits. With a body composed of rocks and rich, fertile soil, Ceresmon's soaring form is definitely the epitome of an island floating in the sky.Sitting on the head of Ceresmon is "Ceresmon Medium", which serves as its true form. "Ceresmon Medium" has practically nil fighting strength and so rarely, if ever, comes out in public on its own, but it is said that it will occasionally show itself unattended by the monstrous bird...

species.name: Ceresmon Medium
species.kanji: ケレスモン メディウム
species.profile: One of the Olympos XII, Ceresmon is a monstrous, gigantic bird Digimon that carries on its back the "", a forest bearing the Digital World's greatest sweets and famous fruits. With a body composed of rocks and rich, fertile soil, Ceresmon's soaring form is definitely the epitome of an island floating in the sky.Sitting on the head of Ceresmon is "Ceresmon Medium", which serves as its true form. "Ceresmon Medium" has practically nil fighting strength and so rarely, if ever, comes out in public on its own, but it is said that it will occasionally show itself unattended by the monstrous bird...

species.name: Chackmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. It styles itself as holding rank as a member of a polar army's polar region defense force. Since it replies that the matter's top secret if you ask anything about it, the truth is unknown. It's thought to be largely something it dreamed up. However, its operation of the it carries (nicknamed NATO phonetic alphabet) and its precision conduct in battle are genuine, and its survivalist knowledge also has a strong, truly reliable existence. Since it rarely acts of its own volition, it primarily...
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "Bullying is Unforgivable! Evolve, Chackmon of Ice" or St-623 (Starter Ver. 7)

species.name: Chamblemon
species.profile: A Plant Digimon in the shape of an extremely poisonous mushroom. It is a mystery whether it evolved from Mushmon, or if it is another variant. Although it is often seen as being weak, it is quite the ruffian. If anyone approaches it carelessly, its floating "Sweepore" spores will attach to them, and sprout into mushrooms containing their drained vitality. If one picks and eats them, they will be brimming with energy, and it seems that among them, the Data-type mushrooms are especially delicious.Its Special Move is releasing mushroom bombs of various sizes all at once (Champignon Bomb). With...

species.name: Chamelemon
species.profile: An Armor-level Reptile Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Kindness". Chamelemon's skin has a unique structure, and it has the ability to blend in by scanning the surrounding environment and re-covering the texture of its skin. As a Digimon suited for espionage, it is able to slip through impregnable security and enter databases. For that reason, there are occasions when it is used by various companies in order to enter the databases of rival companies and steal information. Also, it is able to skillfully move both of its eyes, which are equipped with scanning...

species.name: Chaos Dukemon
species.profile: Another form of Dukemon, which has awoken to its instincts as a Virus-species. Its heart and thoughts are completely Dark Side, and it is nothing more than the "Digital Hazard" that brings calamity to the Digital World. It is clad in black, demonic armor refined from high purity Chrome Digizoid just like Dukemon, and its right hand can become the demonic lance "Balmung" while its left hand can become the demonic shield "Gorgon". It is definitely a being set in opposition to Dukemon. Its Special Moves are the powerful barrage of attacks of its demonic lance (Demon's Disaster), and firing a...

species.name: Chaos Dukemon Core
species.kanji: カオスデュークモン コア

species.name: Chaosmon
species.profile: Normally, when a Jogress occurs, the Digicores of the two Digimon are completely fused and reborn as a new Digimon; however, Chaosmon retains each of the Digicores of the Digimon before the Jogress, and maintains its form in a very incomplete state. Chaosmon is the codename for Digimon who "should not exist", and according to the "Central Dogma" of the Digital World, are absolute impossible singularities (bugs). Due to its extremely unstable existence, its lifespan is very short, and it is conjectured that the program being run by the Digital World's managing system which eliminates bugs is...
species.debut: Digimon Accel Justice Genome & Evil Genome

species.name: Chaosmon: Valdur Arm
species.kanji: カオスモン：ヴァロドゥルアーム

species.name: Chapmon
species.profile: A Lesser Digimon that only lives in clear, beautiful waters. For this reason, it is only seen in a limited number of areas within the Digital World. It spends most of the day on the water's surface, and when it sleeps, it sleeps with only its face poking out of the water. It has the sensitivity to detect the approach of opponents just from tiny movements of the water's surface, and will escape to a safe spot before it is found. Even when it is found, it spits its "Foam Shower" from its mouth to confuse the opponent with the bubbles, then flees.

species.name: Cheer Galmon
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Armor Evolution to the Unknown

species.name: Cherubimon (Vice)
species.profile: An Angel Digimon which has the appearance of a beast. It is one of the Three Archangels Digimon assigned the highest rank, just like the Seraph Digimon Seraphimon. Its primary duty is to defend the Digital World's "Kernel". Angel Digimon, which are positioned at the ultimate "Virtue", have the aspect of their being easily stained by its antithesis of "Vice" as a consequence of their extremity. It uses mighty lightning techniques, and their strike is thought to be divine punishment. Its Special Moves are firing a spear of lightning (Lightning Spear), and summoning a gigantic thundercloud,...
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Digimon Hurricane Touchdown!! Supreme Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

species.name: Cherubimon (Vice) (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An Angel Digimon which has the appearance of a beast. It is one of the Three Archangel Digimon assigned the highest rank, just like the Seraph Digimon Seraphimon. Its primary duty is to defend the Digital World's "Kernel". Angel Digimon, which are positioned at the ultimate "Virtue", have the aspect of their being easily stained by its antithesis of "Vice" as a consequence of their extremity. It uses mighty lightning techniques, and their strike is thought to be divine punishment. Its Special Moves are firing a spear of lightning (Lightning Spear), and summoning a gigantic thundercloud,...

species.name: Cherubimon (Virtue)
species.profile: An Angel Digimon which has the appearance of a beast. It is one of the Three Archangel Digimon assigned the highest rank, just like the Seraph Digimon Seraphimon. Its primary duty is to defend the Digital World's "Kernel". Angel Digimon, which are positioned at the ultimate "Virtue", have the aspect of their being easily stained by its antithesis of "Vice" as a consequence of their extremity. It uses mighty lightning techniques, and their strike is thought to be divine punishment. Its Special Moves are firing a spear of lightning (Lightning Spear), and summoning a gigantic thundercloud,...
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Digimon Hurricane Touchdown!! Supreme Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

species.name: Chibick Sword
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Pride!! A Warrior's Pride!!"

species.name: Chibi Kamemon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon with a shell resembling a mouse. Its Special Moves are an arrow-shaped missile that it is able to guide itself until it hits the opponent (Pointer Arrow), and rolling the ball in its abdomen to charge forward, and then attacking with the helmet on its head ('met Tackle). It also has the ability "Koura Guard", which allows it to retract its whole body into its shell and reflect the opponent's attacks entirely. Incidentally, its helmet cannot fit into its shell.

species.name: Chibi Kiwimon
species.debut: Pendulum 4.0 Wind Guardians (mention in Kiwimon's profile and seen in Kiwimon's artwork)

species.name: Chibimon
species.profile: A Baby Dragon Digimon that evolved from Chicomon. It has a torso, hands, and feet—unusual for a Baby Digimon—and so is able to grip objects with both of its small hands, and move while hopping about with both feet. It has a voracious appetite and especially likes sweet foods. Also, as it is very fond of sleeping, it will fall asleep the moment you take your eyes off of it. Its Special Move is ramming into the opponent while hopping about (Hop Attack).

species.name: Chicchimon
species.profile: A Chick Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft, yellow down. Since it cannot fly yet, it moves around by jumping while desperately flapping its tiny wings. It is frequently seen diligently using its tiny beak to groom the long feathers growing from its head, which seems to be an important aspect of it that can be considered its trademark.Its "Piyopiyo", which it emits when it senses that it is in danger, is an ultrasonic cry that could knock out even Childs if heard at close range. It quickly flees to protect itself while those who have heard its cry are incapacitated.

species.name: Chicomon
species.profile: A small, blue-colored, Dragon Digimon child. Although it is small and powerless, it has the potential to evolve to every Dragon Digimon. For that reason, it is a Digimon that is considered exceedingly valuable by tamers and researchers of Dragon Digimon. It is cherished due to its personality of friendliness and overflowing curiosity, characteristic of Baby Digimon. Just like other Baby Digimon, it spits acidic bubbles to attack, but as usual, their power is nonexistent.

species.name: Chikurimon
species.profile: A Digimon that lurks underwater or under the shade of rocks, it doesn't move around very much while it waits quietly in one place. Although it has a habit of attacking those that come near, it is never belligerent and won't attack those that stay away from it. Because it proliferates abnormally when the temperature exceeds 30°C, Chikurimon can often be seen thickly crowded into lakes or around rocks with the coming of summer, and Digimon that come to drink water are often attacked. Its "Final Chikurimon", which sacrifices itself just as the name suggests, is the final Special Move of a...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xrosroad!! The Boys' Paths Cross"

species.name: Chimairamon
species.profile: A Composite Digimon for which each part that composes its whole, such as its arms, legs, body, and tail, was put together by synthesizing various Digimon. How this kind of synthesis was performed is shrouded in mystery. In contrast to Mugendramon, who was synthesized from the metal parts of several varieties of Digimon, it was combined from organic parts, and whether it is Mugendramon's prototype, or it was built to use against Mugendramon, is still uncertain. However, the one thing that is known is that, because of Chimairamon's terrifying combat instinct, it is nothing but a powerful...

species.name: Chiropmon
species.profile: A Mammal Digimon whose appearance resembles a hood-wearing bat. Possessing remarkable information gathering and analytical capabilities, it is rumored to be a Digimon that was originally born from software used for intelligence gathering, analysis, and parsing by intelligence agencies. It is able to flap its wings almost soundlessly, allowing it to gather and analyze information without its target noticing. However, since Chiropmon bases its actions on things it has an interest in, the information it gathers is often no more valuable than a broad range of trivia. It has the ability to emit...

species.name: Cho·Hakkaimon
species.profile: A feminine Digimon clothed in a pig costume. It was originally an Angel-species Digimon, but it committed a crime that incurred the wrath of Ofanimon and was banished from heaven, and that's when it took on its current appearance. As it is normally optimistic, it doesn't mind that it was changed into this appearance, and it has a very cheerful personality, but if it gets hungry it will be voracious enough to start getting all worked up, and it will take on a ferocious personality. If it becomes starved, it will go completely out of control. Its "" weapon is equipped with boosters, and...

species.name: Chocomon
species.profile: A Digimon that grew up from Cocomon. Although the personalities of the lively Gummymon and the docile Chocomon are opposites, they get along very well and always act in unison. The two are effectively of one mind and body, so much so that should one be separated from the other, it would weaken from loneliness. Its Special Move is spewing out a lot of adhesive bubbles (Double Bobble).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Digimon Hurricane Touchdown!! Supreme Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

species.name: Choromon
species.profile: A super-tiny Machine Digimon which has red eyes that act as photosensors. The appearance of it moving around restlessly seems very cute, but because it is carrying nothing but a simple program that moves in reaction to bright lights, if its surroundings go dark it becomes completely unable to move. The reason why is not understood, but when it is in a good mood, it discharges electricity from the tip of its tail. Its Special Move is releasing iron grains to cause temporary disorder in the opponent's AI (Jamming Powder). It flees while the opponent is confused by this technique.

species.name: Chronomon: Destroy Mode
species.kanji: クロノモン デストロイモード
species.profile: The berserk form of Chronomon. It is a legendary monster that is said to have abandoned its role of maintaining the stability of space-time, and risen in revolt against the system that governs time. While it was restoring space-time, the various forms of malice in the Digital World flowed into Chronomon all at once, corroding it like a virus, and causing it to run wild. By abusing the power of time that Chronomon originally possessed, it hacks into memories engraved into the Digital World, downloads a variety of techniques to itself, and then goes on a rampage.Its Special Move is forcibly...

species.name: Chronomon: Holy Mode
species.kanji: クロノモン ホーリーモード
species.profile: A God Man Digimon that is also said to be a materialization of the system that governs time. The flow of time in the Digital World is truly vague, and disturbances in time occasionally occur due to conflicts between powerful Digimon or cataclysms. It is Chronomon who appears on those occasions, tasked with restoring space-time. Once it restores space-time, the fact that it manifested also disappears along with the space-time disturbance, so no one has seen Chronomon. For that reason, Chronomon's existence is only mentioned in a few legends.Its Special Moves are sacred flames that incinerate...

species.name: Chrysalimon
species.profile: An Adult Digimon whose appearance resembles a chrysalis. In order to evolve into a stronger Digimon, the Child-level Keramon entered a chrysalis-like state and began conserving its energy. As a result, it is completely unable to move, but it is protected by its tough shell, and can attack the opponent with the tentacles extending from its back. In some cases, it can evolve to Perfect without becoming an Adult, but it is able to evolve to a stronger Perfect by evolving to Chrysalimon. Its Special Move is destroying the opponent's configuration data with the tentacles extending from its back...

species.name: Citramon
species.debut: Digimon Data Squad: "A Birthday Kristy Will Never Forget!"

species.name: Clavis Angemon
species.kanji: クラヴィスエンジェモン
species.profile: An Angel Digimon that protects the "Zenith Gate" separating the Digital World from the outside world. The "Zenith Gate" is sealed by 360 doors, and "" held by Clavis Angemon acts as the master key to every door. "" is a special key that only Clavis Angemon can handle, so one could say that Clavis Angemon itself is a part of the key. It is said that through the power embedded in the key, Clavis Angemon is able to wield offensive power so great that it could cause the Digital World's collapse, but only against enemies attempting to break through the doors.

species.name: Clear Agumon
species.profile: A subspecies of Toy Agumon whose whole body is made up of unique, clear plastic blocks. It is a very rare Digimon, and is said to have been created by a child just like Toy Agumon, but is difficult to find, and it has been estimated that the likelihood of doing so is one thousandth that of Toy Agumon. Its personality is just like Toy Agumon's, and despite being cowardly, it possesses a heart of justice that cannot turn a blind eye to evil. Its Special Moves are spitting out a toy flame (Precious Flare), and similarly, launching a toy missile from its mouth (Dream Missile).

species.name: Climbmon
species.profile: An Insect Digimon that evolved via bouldering course data. The pickaxes on its arms are used not only for piercing things such as cliffs, but also for tapping and driving the kunai-shaped pitons it carries in the underside of its wings into sturdy rocks. Skillfully using its pickaxes and pitons, it clings onto any dangerous spot, and moves quickly and brilliantly like a ninja.It specializes in ambush tactics where it creeps up stealthily on the enemy using its mimicry technique "w=Topographic isolation", in which it blends itself into its surroundings. Its Special Moves are a long-range...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Clockmon
species.profile: The protector of time that governs the computer's timer. It manages the "Time" and "Space" of all computers and networks, and it is able to freely advance and rewind time between the years 1900 and 1999. Because it possesses an extremely dangerous, terrifying ability, it always maintains a neutral standpoint and doesn't participate in the conflict between Vaccines and Viruses. For that reason, it is said that if it ever tilts toward either side of the balance, the Digital World will collapse. Its Special Move is destroying the "time" flowing through the opponent's body (Chrono Breaker). It...

species.name: Coatlmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mythical Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Light". It is an incarnation of the sun and wind that has the appearance of a white winged snake. Although it is a very sacred being, it is said that if you attack it carelessly and incur its wrath, it will cast a deadly curse on you. However, it will never personally challenge anyone to a battle due to its calm disposition. Its Special Move is constricting the opponent with beams of light, generated by coiling its body into a spiral, until they stop breathing (Freeze Wave).

species.name: Cockatrimon
species.profile: A Giant Bird Digimon with two overdeveloped legs. Because it has continued to live on the ground for so long, it cannot fly through the air, and has evolved a body that is suited for land. For that reason, its body became even larger, and its leg strength has developed tremendously as well. Its wing parts have completely degenerated, and in battle, it spreads them wide along with its tail to intimidate the enemy. Although its disposition is violently ferocious, it doesn't do well in battles that consume too much energy due to its need to sustain its large build. Its Special Move is "Petra...

species.name: Cocomon
species.profile: An extremely rare Digimon, which is born in pairs from a single Digitama. Why only Zerimon and Cocomon are born as twins is currently unknown. What's more, they are not restricted to always being born as twins, and there have been cases where a Zerimon and Cocomon are each born from a single Digitama. Compared to the extremely energetic, one-horned Zerimon, the three-horned Cocomon has a relatively docile personality. Like other Baby Digimon, it spits acid bubbles to intimidate opponents.

species.name: Coelamon
species.profile: An ancient fish Digimon that possesses gigantic claws and a hard outer skin. When the Computer Network was being repaired after being disrupted by a malicious hacker, this Digimon was discovered in the Net Ocean, and as its body structure is extremely primitive, it has fins that have developed like hands and feet. Based on this fact, it is conjectured that primeval Digimon that originated in the Net Ocean experienced many evolutions and took on terrestrial forms, and increased their numbers into various strains. Its Special Move is falling upon the opponent with its gigantic claws (Variable...

species.name: Commandramon
species.profile: An infantry Digimon belonging to the mechanized "D-Brigade". The "D-Brigade" is a mechanized brigade composed of Dragon type Cyborg Digimon, and the missions assigned to this special force are never made public. The surface of Commandramon's skin has been modified with a special texture that detects its surrounding colors in real-time, and is capable of displaying a variety of camouflage patterns. As a result, it is said that most of Commandramon's 'targets' do not even notice Commandramon's presence before being silenced. Its Special Moves are firing its hand-held assault rifle (M16...

The blue-skinned Coredramon is said to be the evolved form of a Dracomon that ingested large quantities of a rare gem called " ", which is mined only in mountainous regions with very high altitudes, and is able to fly at high speed with its developed wings to survive in the steep mountains. Its Special...

species.name: Coredramon (Green)
species.profile: Digimon bearing the name "Dramon" always have Dragon-factor data in their Digicore, and the higher the percentage of that data, the more the shape of their body resembles a Dragon-type; however, Coredramon's Dragon-factor data has reached 100%, so it is undoubtedly a pure-blooded Dragon Digimon. The green-skinned Coredramon is said to be the evolved form of a Dracomon that ingested large quantities of a rare gem called " ", which is mined in dense woodland with trees over a century old. Although this type of Coredramon is not good at flying, it has highly developed leg strength, allowing it...

species.name: Coronamon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon born from fusing with solar observation data. It has a strong sense of justice and a pure, innocent personality. Its Special Moves are releasing continuous punches with its fists heated by the power of flame (Corona-knuckle), and concentrating the power of flame in its brow while exhausting all of its body's stamina, then firing it at the opponent as a flaming shot (Corona Flame). Also, it can either defend itself or ram the opponent while its body is clad in flames (Petit Prominence).

species.name: Cotsucomon
species.profile: A Digimon that was born already wearing a leather hat. It looks stronger than the average Baby level due to its equipment, but because it is made of a soft material, it barely offers any defensive protection. It is extremely vigilant, and will retreat into its hat at the slightest provocation. Its Special Move is poking at the opponent with the brim of its hat (Kottsun).

species.name: Cougarmon
species.profile: A Mammal Digimon with a body resembling a wildcat. It is a rare Digimon that has been confirmed to inhabit the mountainous regions of the Eastern Digital World. Since it lives in cold mountains with high elevation, it is covered in highly dense fur suitable for keeping itself warm, and possesses remarkable defensive power against attacks from intruders. Although individuals of a relatively gentle nature are often seen, it also has a side such that it will aggressively eliminate those that intrude its territory. It inflicts damage on enemies with its "Ruthless Claw", a blow from its claws...

species.name: Craniummon
species.profile: The Digimon which best understood decorum among the Royal Knights. It is a perfectionist, and competes with the other Royal Knights Digimon for the top two mission completion rates for Yggdrasill's orders. When fighting with an opponent, its policy is always to defeat it with one-on-one combat, and if the opponent is a formidable enemy, its delight is supreme. Craniummon's armor had its code modified by Yggdrasill, and was changed into Black Digizoid. It has become possible for it to generate a weapon and shield from its armor by accessing its data. Its Special Move is firing a sonic wave...

species.profile: A select number of Royal Knights will sometimes recruit Digimon from where they are dispatched to as allies in order to execute their assigned missions. The way they obtain these allies varies depending on the nature of the mission, but Craniummon is said to acquire allies as its subordinates by challenging Digimon it recognizes as formidable to one-on-one combat and making them submit. This is a form where Craniummon recruited Enbarrmon as its mount after defeating it during a certain mission. It seems that the perfectionist Craniummon had its eyes on Enbarrmon's mobility in order to carry...

species.name: Crescemon
species.profile: A Demon Man Digimon with a flexible body, allowing it to perform nimble movements as it attacks its enemies. It excels in battling elegantly, and its power is said to double when it is exposed to moonlight. Its Special Move is entrancing the enemy with its dance-like steps, after which it closes the distance and slashes with the weapons, , that it wields in both hands (Lunatic Dance). It is also capable of combining its two weapons to transform it into a bowgun. It can use its weapon when in this form to perform two techniques: firing an arrow of ice (Ice Archery), and firing an arrow made...

species.name: Crys Paledramon
species.kanji: クリスペイルドラモン
species.profile: A Dragon Man Digimon that only a select few Paledramon are said to be able to evolve into. Its developed icy shell has changed into armor that covers its entire body, drastically raising its defensive and offensive power.Thanks to the icicles mounted on its wings, it now remains unaffected even when facing the hottest of Digimon. In addition, it can also control air currents due to the cold air it blasts from its thrusters, allowing it to fly at higher speeds even during snowstorms.Its Special Moves are tearing the enemy to pieces with the ice claws equipped to both of its arms, and then...

species.name: Cthyllamon
species.profile: Cthyllamon inhabits the depths of the Net Ocean, and is known by the alias " " due to the fact that only the skull pattern on its chest can be seen floating eerily in the dark sea. It has a crafty and cunning disposition; instead of actively fighting on its own, it employs aquatic Digimon of a lower Level than itself by brainwashing them. It shares many similarities with Marin Angemon, such as its appearance and the fact that it is rarely ever seen, but the relationship between the two remains unknown.Its Special Move "Ocean Hell", in which it steals the opponent's fighting spirit with an...

species.name: Culumon
species.profile: A small Digimon shrouded in mystery that is unable to evolve or attack, unlike other Digimon. As it is friendly and loves to play, it will appear out of nowhere as long as there is fun to be had. It has a habit of adding "Culu" to the end of its sentences. Rumor has it that it possesses the ability to help other Digimon evolve.
species.debut: Digimon Tamers: "Guilmon is Born! The Digimon that I Created"

species.name: Cupimon
species.profile: A Small Angel Digimon that evolved from Puttimon. It likes benevolence and loves making everyone happy, contrary to when it was a Puttimon. In particular, it is referred to as the "", and it specializes in bringing about feelings of "Love" in every person. It is always flying around the Digital World's skies, sprinkling love on everyone while making them feel happy. It is said that even a large Digimon with great fighting spirit will cease battling once it encounters Cupimon. Its Special Move is generating a ring of light from the protuberance on its calvaria and throwing it at the opponent...

species.name: Curimon
species.profile: A Baby Digimon characterized by the single horn on its brow and its frill. It is so active that before it is even born its Digitama bounces, and after hatching it moves around vigorously. The horn on its brow and the frill on its head are still immature and soft, and although they cannot be used in battle yet, they help it to keep its balance while moving around and protects its body when it bumps into things. It heroically threatens approaching enemies by producing bubbles.
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Gammamon Dim Card)

species.name: Cutemon
species.profile: A mischievous and peppy but timid Fairy Digimon that lives in cold areas.Although they may look like large rabbit-ears, it has not ears, but a kind of sense organ with which it can sense the approach of other Digimon in no time. Thanks to this, it is extremely rare to catch sight of Cutemon, because it will immediately hide itself. If you do happen to catch sight of one, it is either a rare fortune, or Cutemon is mischievously luring you into a trap. Its trademark muffler is beyond imagination with its insulating properties, as it is very warm. If you are able to obtain one, you can call...

species.name: Cyberdramon
species.profile: A Dragon Man-type Cyborg Digimon whose body is clad in a unique rubber armor, with which it can endure any attack. When Virus Digimon break out on the Computer Network, it suddenly appears out of nowhere and annihilates them all. However, it is a lone warrior that is not affiliated with the group of justice, the "Virus Busters", and its true colors are shrouded in mystery. As for its unique rubber armor, not only does it have excellent defensive ability, but it also has a feature it unleashes that amplifies its offensive ability. Its Special Move is producing a super-oscillatory wave from...

species.name: Cyberdramon (2010 Anime Version)
species.zh: 电子龙兽 / 电子龙兽（2010动画版）
species.profile: An otherworldly Digimon rumored to have turned up from another world. Since both its language and thinking patterns are completely different, it is regarded as fundamentally impossible to communicate with Cyberdramon. It is dangerous, with extreme combativeness befitting its otherworldly appearance. Because its goal in battle is to acquire a lot more energy, it is a Hunter that tries to prey on any Digimon that meet its eyes. Also, because it is able to sneak up on its enemies by taking on the colors of its surroundings, Cyberdramon is very difficult to capture. It makes sport of the...
