species.name: Cyclomon
species.profile: A one-eyed Dragon Man Digimon with an abnormally developed right arm. It was originally a stalwart dragon warrior, but its right eye was crushed by the warrior Leomon, and it became an oni of revenge. In order to defeat Leomon, it has strengthened and enlarged its right arm, and it is on the lookout for a chance to take it down. For the sake of revenge, it has lost its pride as a warrior, leaving it as nothing more than a warrior obsessed with bloodshed. Its Special Move is its ultra-high-temperature "Hyper Heat", which can melt anything.

species.name: Dagomon
species.profile: A wicked god Digimon referred to as the "". It is thought to have evolved from a computer virus that would infect computers aboard ships, messing up their bearings and course. It bundles up its innumerable, multiplying tentacles and takes on a humanoid appearance, but its true form is a strange evolution of a Mollusk Digimon. Its Special Move is throwing its trident with tremendous physical strength (Forbidden Trident). For its defeated opponents, it holds the rosary around its neck and adopts a pose similar to mourning.

species.name: Daipenmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Ice that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors and acquiring unknown abilities. Although its wings have degenerated, by flapping the gigantic "" hunk of ice held in its right hand and the "" held in its left, it seems it can momentarily fly in the air. It's free from care because it is able to manufacture the and the on its own even if they melt away. Its Special Moves are dipping the from its right hand in blue syrup, then striking the opponent (w=Blue Hawaii (drink) Death), and dipping the from its left...

species.name: Damemon
species.profile: Damemon was born by coincidence when the waste data drifting through the Digital World randomly combined. Since "No good, no good!" is its favorite phrase, it has a bad habit of criticizing anyone and everyone without reading the room, regardless of the situation. Although it is the most "No good, no good!" itself, it somehow gets by with the help of its partner, Tyutyumon. It's only together with Tyutyumon that Damemon can finally be said to be a decent-performing Digimon. Tyutyumon stays in the "" on the back of Damemon's head, and takes Damemon to various places to go play. When the two...

species.name: Darcmon
species.profile: A low-ranking Angel Digimon which has the appearance of a woman. It is in the advance forces of Angel Digimon, and its figure which always cuts through the vanguard to battle is said to almost be a "". Its Special Move is a magnificent sword technique using its slender blade "" (Baptême d'Amour).

species.name: Dark Knightmon
species.profile: Dark Knightmon is the fused figure of Skull Knightmon and Deadly Axemon, who have exchanged cups of brotherhood. Dark Knightmon, who brings the older brother's ingenuity together with the younger brother's mobility, has become a first-class warrior. The skills of Dark Knightmon, who can use the "" it wields to thrust, slash, sweep, or throw as the situation calls for, are very advanced, and it is said there are few people powerful enough to fight Dark Knightmon fairly to its face and defeat it. While Dark Knightmon possesses that much competency, it will use any means to achieve its goals...

species.profile: A Digimon whose whole body is covered in flames of darkness that burn quietly. As it is the form of a Flare Lizamon that evolved into a Virus-type, it has a cool-headed personality. Its Special Move is incinerating the enemy's spirit with flames of darkness (Dread Fire).

species.name: Dark Maildramon
species.kanji: ダークメイルドラモン
species.profile: A form of Maildramon, who is Knightmon's servant and acquired the power of "Miracles", that found righteousness in evil after abandoning justice. Its Chrome Digizoid armor has been dyed a dark color, and it is looking for a heart of darkness in its master, Knightmon. If it is a Knightmon with a strong evil heart, then it will be obedient to them, but if it senses even a shred of conscience, it will crush even its own master under its bulk. Its Special Move is flapping its tattered wings, causing dark bullets to rain down (Dark Wing).

species.name: Dark Superstarmon
species.kanji: ダークスーパースターモン
species.profile: Produced from the observational data of a black hole, it is a Digimon steeped in darkness. It has left behind its dreams and its wishes, and it appears to be so heavily burdened by its past that it uses its sunglasses to shut out all light. Its Special Moves are attacking with the exploded fragments of a supernova (Dark Explosion), using a black fog that covers everything in darkness (Schwarz Nebel), and creating a hole that swallows the surrounding bodies (Dark Hole).

species.name: Dark Tyranomon
species.profile: A Dinosaur Digimon whose body was corroded by a vicious computer virus. Although it was originally a Tyranomon-species Digimon, it was infected by a vicious computer virus, causing a bug in its flesh's configuration data and transforming it into a frenzied Digimon. Its body turned black, its arms grew sturdier than Tyranomon's, and its offensive power grew. It identifies anything reflected in its eyes as an enemy and starts attacking, becoming completely frenzied. With its Special Move "Fire Blast", a super-powerful jet of flames, it transforms all of its surroundings into a sea of flames.

species.profile: The true form of Ballistamon, who was Olegmon's subordinate. It was created to be Olegmon's strongest weapon, but with Shoutmon's help, it was able to become Ballistamon.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Cheerful Pirate, Appear! The Voyage to Gold Land!!"

Although this is information that stubbornly remains part of the rumor mill, it is said that a Tankdramon, shot down during an operation to eliminate a "target" designated "Codename: BAN-TYO", was retrieved and evolved to Darkdramon at the D-Brigade research facility it was left at. It seems that on the verge of its evolution, a large quantity of "Dark Matter" was applied, and after its evolution it ran wild and broke out, so currently even the D-Brigade cannot secure Darkdramon's whereabouts....

Even if you try to resist, it is considered difficult to maintain your sense of self if you are glared at by Dark Knightmon, who exists within its chest. According to one theory, it appears to be planning on destroying all good, in order to fill the world with evil and obtain a world...

species.kanji: デッドリーアックスモン

It faithfully obeys its sworn brother Skull Knightmon, and battles with faith in its sworn brother in order to obtain victory. It shows off lightning-speed movements fast enough that they earned it the alias "", and its top speed is so fast that it leaves afterimages. However, fine maneuvers are its weak point, so not only are its linear movements easily read by its opponent, it easily collides with obstacles too. However, if you see...

species.profile: An evolution of Meramon, this Digimon's body is cloaked in blue, high-temperature flames. The flames that arise from its body blaze brightly in blue, as these flames burn hotter than Meramon's. Its offensive and defensive abilities have risen considerably, which in conjunction with the strength of its flames, bestow upon this power-type Digimon tremendous destructive power. Although Flame Digimon tend to be weak against Aquatic and Ice-Snow type Digimon, fighting the strength of Death Meramon's flames with them is as futile as pouring water on a hot stone. species.profile: An Undead Digimon of the Prototype Digimon "DORU Series" that was experimented on in search of further evolutions, and was said to, at the time of the experiment, resemble its Adult form. By continuously preying on the Digicores of other Digimon, it is active despite its deceased condition, and is attempting to evolve. Its Signature Move is "Cannonball". Its Special Move is impaling the opponent with its steel arms and ripping out their Digicore (Metal Cast).

species.name: Death-X-DORUgoramon
species.profile: A figure of the Prototype Digimon "DORU Series", experimented on in search of further evolutions, that achieved its ultimate form through "Death-X-Evolution". It is called the "" because its own activity is dependent on the Digicores of other Digimon, and is nothing but a threat to them. By continuously preying on the Digicores of other Digimon, it is active despite its deceased condition, and since it stores vast amounts of Digicore information within its body, its entire body is covered in restraints, and so it is barely able to function as a single Digimon. Its Special Moves are blasting...

species.name: Death-X-DORUguremon
species.profile: An Undead Digimon of the Prototype Digimon "DORU Series" that was experimented on in search of further evolutions, and was said to, at the time of the experiment, resemble its final form. By continuously preying on the Digicores of other Digimon, it is active despite its deceased condition, and hungers for a vast amount of Digicores in order to evolve. Since it instinctively sniffs out Digicores, the eye and snout portions of its head are covered in armor, and the sharp tips of the blades on its tail and wings are used to skewer many Digimon, allowing it to prey on their Digicores...

species.name: Death-X-mon
species.profile: Since it doesn't have its own Digicore, this type of program cannot be classified as a Digimon, and although it appears solid, it has no actual substance. If it detects a Digicore it will absorb it into its body and disassemble it, then reassemble it in a perpetually repeating set of processes named "Process 0" through "Process F". Although it is a simple program, it is conjectured that defeating it is within the realm of impossibility. Unless there are Digicores nearby, it will go into stasis, but as long as there are Digicores it will not cease.

species.name: Deathmon
species.profile: Like Demon, it was originally a high-ranking Angel Digimon, but it fell to the Dark Area and is now one of the Demon Lord Digimon. Despite being a Demon Lord Digimon, it differs from other Fallen Angel and Devil Digimon in that it does not dedicate itself to performing evil deeds, but instead it simply maintains a neutral position as a silent observer. However, it is a terrifying Digimon, and it is told that when the impending final battle arrives, its whitened appearance will change to jet-black darkness, and it will transform into a god of destruction. Its Special Moves are an arrow of...

species.name: Deathmon (Black)
species.profile: Like Demon it was originally a high-ranking Angel Digimon, but it fell to the Dark Area and is now one of the Demon Lord Digimon. Even though it is a Demon Lord Digimon, it is different from other Fallen Angel and Devil Digimon in that it does not run the whole gamut of wickedness, but instead does its utmost to carefully maintain a position of neutrality. However, it is a terrifying Digimon, and it is told that at the time of the approaching final battle, that whitened appearance will change to jet-black darkness, and it will transform into a god of destruction. species.name: Decker Greymon

Decker Greymon's comprehensive combat strength is equivalent to that of a battalion composed of 324 combat-type Digimon, so even if a hypothetical group of enemies tried to lie in wait for it, with its great firepower and tenacious defensive power, and its ability to cover ground without trouble from any kind of rough terrain, it will trample the enemy line in a violent assault. It is worth mentioning that...

species.name: Deckerdramon
species.profile: Deckerdramon can be said to be a natural enemy of all Flying Digimon. With the terrifying "" equipped on its back, it also conceals the ability to shoot down any kind of Flying Digimon with a variety of anti-aircraft missiles. It also poses difficulties for flying-type Digimon, in that its low height makes it hard to detect from high altitudes. Its aircraft kill-rate swells particularly while it is in terrain filled with obstacles, where it is difficult to discern the source of its attacks. In terrain with few obstacles, Deckerdramon spreads a smokescreen from its smoke-producing fangs...

species.name: Deltamon
species.profile: A Composite Digimon fused from three Digimon. Although each of them had existed as separate Digimon, they were forced to fuse by a computer bug, which resulted when a computer went out of control after being struck by a powerful electromagnetic storm. It is said that since this Digimon, which possesses three heads and two tails, specializes in tripartite attacks that capitalize on its body's traits, it is even able to fight against three Digimon at the same time. However, as each of them was originally a vicious Digimon, they may be united in seeking destruction but they otherwise lack...

species.name: Delumon
species.profile: Even though it appears to be a Bird Digimon at first glance, it is a strange Digimon with verdant, lush vegetation growing from its back. Like Kiwimon, it possesses some of the characteristics of plants and is not able to fly. It is very prideful and believes itself to be nobility, but in truth, it finds the fact that it cannot fly agonising. That said, as expected of a Digimon that has evolved until the Perfect level, it is a capable Digimon with high combat ability. It boasts of the crown it wears on its head, and its beak that shines gold. Its Special Move is firing curious objects...

species.name: Demon
species.profile: A Demon Lord Digimon that leads the many Devil and Fallen Angel Digimon. Like Devimon, Demon was originally an Angel Digimon, and a particularly high-ranking one. However, because it raged in fury or rebellion, against a being of goodness in the Digital World (perhaps the very human that created the Digital World), it was deleted to the Dark Area (the graveyard of deleted data). It has vowed to one day conquer the Digital World, in revenge against the being of goodness. Also, it is plotting to secretly revive the "Super Ultimate Digimon," who led the rebellion and was the strongest among...

species.name: Depthmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Aquatic Beast Man Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Sincerity". It specializes in underwater activities due to the power of the Digimental, and it is capable of moving swiftly like a fish. Also, its armor is highly resistant to water and pressure, so it is able to dive deeper into the ocean than its fellow Aquatic Beast Man, Hangyomon. It may even contend with Whamon for first place in terms of diving ability. Its Special Move is a frothy bomb which explodes on contact (Bubble Bomb).

species.name: Devidramon
species.profile: An Evil Dragon Digimon that is known and feared as the "". As a demon beast that was summoned from the Dark Area by the messenger of darkness, Devimon, there are no other Digimon as evil as it is. Although it is a Dramon-species Digimon, its limbs are unusually developed, so it cuts the opponent to pieces with its elongated arms, and flies about the darkness with its sturdy legs and wings. Its personality is the epitome of wickedness, and it does not hold a shred of compassion in its heart. Any opponent it glares at with its four burning, crimson eyes becomes unable to move, and has their...

species.name: Devimon
moves: Touch of Evil/Evil Touch/Black Talon/Evil Wing/Death Claw
species.profile: A Fallen Angel Digimon whose body is clad in jet-black cloth. Although it was originally a shining Angemon-species Digimon, by falling to the Dark Area, which exists in a spatial distortion of the Digital World, it became a fallen angel. As proof of that, the Mark of Evil surfaced dramatically on its chest. It has a cunning and fiendish personality, but it also possesses an outstanding intellect. It is said that those who have stared into its two eyes, which shine a deep crimson, are mind-controlled and completely dominated by Devimon. Its Special Move "Death Claw" is extending both of its...

species.name: Diablomon
species.profile: It repeatedly absorbs all the data on the Network in order to evolve and grow larger, and is depleting the Digital World to the brink of destruction. A Diablomon that has absorbed a lot of data becomes convinced that it is an all-knowing and all-powerful being, and it takes pleasure in destruction and slaughter. However, when this Digimon congregates in great numbers, its raison d'être is made clear; as that ultimate goal is to hijack a military computer and try to destroy the Real World as well with a nuclear strike, this is a terrifying Digimon. Its Special Move is firing a powerful shot...

species.name: Diablomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: It repeatedly absorbs all the data on the Network in order to evolve and grow larger, and is depleting the Digital World to the brink of destruction. A Diablomon that has absorbed a lot of data becomes convinced that it is an all-knowing and all-powerful being, and it takes pleasure in destruction and slaughter. However, when this Digimon congregates in great numbers, its raison d'être is made clear; as that ultimate goal is to hijack a military computer and try to destroy the Real World as well with a nuclear strike, this is a terrifying Digimon. Its Special Move is firing a powerful shot...

species.name: Dianamon
species.profile: One of the Olympos XII, this God Man Digimon presides over water and ice, and is able to fight even when its surroundings are at absolute zero. Just as the moon has two sides (light and dark), its personality is of a two-sided nature, and its beauty conceals terrifying power. Its Special Moves are conjuring an illusion using the mysterious power of the moon, and cutting down those it's deemed as enemies in an instant (Crescent Harken), and pulling out a sleek, sharp, long and dazzling arrow of ice from the protuberances on its back, then firing it (Arrow of Artemis). It also uses "Goodnight...

species.name: Diarbbitmon
species.profile: An astute Beast Knight Digimon that protects the nature-rich land inhabited by many Beast Digimon. It has a gentle personality and prefers spending its time quietly while interacting with the Digimon around it. If an enemy that threatens the land appears, it will draw its two cherished swords, "" and "", and drive the enemy back with its nimble movements. Even though Diarbbitmon is usually well-mannered, it will invoke its rage against those who ravage the land, and chop them up until not even a trace of them remains; it will also keep pursuing their allies until they are annihilated.Its...

species.name: Diatrymon
species.profile: An Ancient Bird Digimon that possesses powerful leg strength, and is called a living fossil. Its wings do not have sufficient surface area for flight, but to compensate, it is endowed with powerful, muscular legs and is capable of sprinting at speeds exceeding 200 km/h. Also, it has an extremely ferocious personality, and has a habit of regarding anything that moves as an enemy and swooping down on it. Not only that, the feathers that cover its whole body contain metal, making it difficult to inflict damage on Diatrymon without using a considerably powerful attack. Its Special Moves are a...

species.name: Digitamamon
species.profile: The ultimate Digimon which has the appearance of a "Digitama", the beginning and end of all Digimon. It is said that Digitamamon, who is at the apex of evolution, will not evolve from normal Digimon, and will never evolve unless it fuses with data from another dimension. It is covered in an egg-shaped exoskeleton that renders all attacks meaningless. Its Special Moves are destroying the enemy's spirit (Enigma) and an orb of darkness (Nightmare Syndrome). All Digimon who suffer these attacks have their vital functions brought to a halt.

species.name: Digmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon which evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Knowledge". The "Digimental of Knowledge" has the attribute of "Earth", and those that don this Digimental wield the power to manipulate the earth. As can be seen from its unique form, it never loses to any Digimon in underground battles. Its Signature Move is impacting the ground with its spinning drills, causing a fissure (Big Crack). Its Special Move is rapidly spinning the drills on its snout and both of its hands, performing a simultaneous attack with its drills (Gold Rush).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: "Digital Gate Open" or St-133 (Starter Ver. 3)

species.name: Dijiangmon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon with a grotesque appearance, whose whole body is covered in leather. Since it doesn't speak nor try to express anything with its body, it usually just stands at a spot in an eerie silence. Generally speaking, it has no interest in self-expression, and is an evil Digimon that specializes only in robbing others of life.It slips into crowds of Digimon from out of nowhere and sends out a signal, in a manner similar to telepathy, that stimulates their combat instinct and causes the Digimon to fight each other, bringing about chaos.Its Special Moves are blowing the enemy away...

species.name: Dinobeemon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon which Jogress-evolved from Stingmon and XV-mon. A chimera of a dragon and an insect, this Digimon possesses the name . It is hard to classify its species as either a Dragon type or an Insect type, but its Insect nature is especially pronounced. It flies through the sky with its four wings and accurately perceives the opponent with the compound eyes on its head, enabling it to choke the life out of its opponent without fail. Also, Dinobeemon possesses a considerably ferocious personality. Its Special Move is the in which its nimble movements leave behind afterimages while...

species.name: Dinohumon
species.profile: A Dragon Man Digimon with the appearance of a humanoid lizard. It lives in an area that has not yet become a modernised civilisation, where all of the tribesmen are valiant combat dragons who possess the makings of a warrior. It has great muscle strength, allowing its to swing its greatsword, Akinakes, with ease. Its Special Move is doing dance-like movements and cutting the opponent with the blades on its arms and (Lizard Dance).

species.name: Dinorexmon
species.profile: This carnivorous Dinosaur Digimon is named the "" due to the strength it possesses far in excess of other Dinosaur Digimon, as well as the unparalleled ferocious nature it displays in battle. It seizes the opponent with its talons, which are almost half as long as its body, then snaps and brandishes its gigantic jaws at them to end their life. Its exceedingly brutal behaviour gives it a battle style that flourishes in a world where only the fittest survive, and is probably the reason it is called the "King". Also, partly due to it fighting with other Dinorexmon, it is said that their...

species.name: Dinotigermon
species.profile: Injured Digimon have become its prey. It is an Ancient Beast Digimon which took in the metal elements of the earth, super-hardened its whole body, and evolved from one of the few Saber Leomon which have repeated and survived endless battles, where the weak are food for the strong. Its movements are not swift compared to Saber Leomon, but it possesses almost twice as much tough flesh and physical strength, and with its big, sharp, sword-like fangs, it forcibly brings down even Digimon larger than itself and which possess thick skin or armor. Other Digimon fear Dinotigermon, who possesses...

species.name: Divemon
species.profile: A Digimon that evolved via data studying the swimming styles of top swimmers. Although it has a merman-like appearance, it is capable of moving bipedally on land. Its swimming speed is top-class even among Aquatic Digimon, and its four eyes never lose sight of its underwater prey. Contrary to its ferocious appearance, it has a fair play spirit that pursues beautiful swimming.Its Special Moves are slashing the enemy with the sharp fins all over its body (Fillet Blade), and hurling pressurized water like a blade (Ripple Edge). Its "Liquid Veil", which is invoked when Divemon is active on...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Dobermon
species.profile: A Hunter Digimon that was originally a Virus Digimon, but was converted to a Vaccine by a mutation. Similarly to Snimon, it is a brutal Digimon that exists solely to hunt Virus Digimon despite being a Vaccine, and it can't be controlled by an ordinary Tamer. Its Special Moves are a howl that seals the opponent's abilities (Grau Lärm), and a black beam that pierces the opponent's body and destroys its Digicore (Schwarz Strahl).

species.name: Dobermon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Hunter Digimon that was originally a Virus Digimon, but was converted to a Vaccine by a mutation. Similarly to Snimon, it is a brutal Digimon that exists solely to hunt Virus Digimon despite being a Vaccine, and it can't be controlled by an ordinary Tamer. Its Special Moves are a howl that seals the opponent's abilities (Grau Lärm), and a black beam that pierces the opponent's body and destroys its Digicore (Schwarz Strahl).It has become a more ferocious, uncontrollable mad dog. Dobermon is considered ferocious but highly intelligent by nature, and is said to be the best Beast Digimon for...

species.name: Dodomon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon whose whole body is covered in the tough fur "". It exhibits an aggressive personality immediately after being born, and despite its fangs not yet being grown, it threatens enemies by opening its mouth wide and doing a biting motion. Because of this behaviour, it often gets defeated by other Digimon, which explains why this Digimon is so rare. If an opponent approaches, it attacks by spitting "Chīsana Tetsuryū" from its mouth.

species.name: Dogmon
species.profile:
A Puppet Digimon that was produced from an American cartoon TV database. Because its body is very soft and strong, and can expand and contract like rubber, it completely absorbs every attack. Although its appearance gives off the impression that it is very dangerous, it is a harmless Digimon with no malice or aggression. Its Signature Move is inflicting damage to the opponent's sense of hearing with a great howl, making them lose their fighting spirit (Distem Howling). Its Special Move "Ultra Kamitsuku" is an intense technique in which it snaps at them with its sharp fangs.
*Dogmon was...

species.name: Dokimon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Dokugumon
species.profile: A cursed Digimon in the shape of a spider, whose entire body has been parasitised by a computer virus. While it was originally a spider-type, it had a docile personality typical of insect-type Digimon; however, at some point, it was drawn into a powerful electromagnetic storm and infected by a computer virus that had been circulating around the Network. Since then, it has become but a lump of poison, or in other words a computer virus, that corrodes anything it touches. Not only that, special mention has to be given to its great movement speed, made possible thanks to its eight legs. No...

species.name: Dokunemon
species.profile: A Larva Digimon whose appearance is very similar to Kunemon. Like Kunemon, it is being studied in order to solve the mystery of Insect Digimon, but unlike Kunemon, it has a timid personality, and because it usually lives hidden in forests, it is difficult to find, and so research has not progressed. In addition, it carries a very potent toxin, and it is dangerous to even touch it. Its Special Moves are jumping and scattering a neurotoxin from its beak that paralyzes the enemy (Worm Venom), and charging and then stabbing the enemy with the horn on its tail (Poison Ride).

species.name: Dominimon
species.profile: A Dominion Digimon also known as a phantom. It acts on its own accord without being bound by the angelic chain of command. If a powerful enemy emerges, it will join forces with Clavis Angemon and Slash Angemon to defeat it. It is a rare species that suddenly manifests akin to a mutation when the balance between light and darkness in the Digital World is disrupted, and so very few have ever seen it. With a personality that values its entire race over any individual, it doesn't treat its own life as being that important, and will launch a death-defying special attack to get out of a...

species.name: Dondokomon
species.profile: A festival-loving Digimon that will appear out of the blue wherever there is a commotion and pound out a heated rhythm, livening the place up. Its unique rhythm, as well as its beats that will shake one's body to the core, stimulate the listener's nerves and gets them completely excited. Although it is sure to get people fired up at competitions, if by some chance Dondokomon shows up at a brawl, it will definitely grow into a battle royal which swallows up even the excited onlookers, causing a catastrophe. Although its sole intention is to provide its support, once it sounds its "Dondoko...

species.name: Don Shoutmon
species.profile:
The "" which possesses a furious soul brought forth by the burning fighting spirit of two Digimon. It swings its down rhythmically to strike its opponents, causing a percussion of shrieks to resound across the battlefield.
Don Shoutmon is, simply said, a burning hot Digimon, and its irrepressible fighting spirit causes it to rush even into conflicts it's not involved in, worsening the situation. If there's a petty quarrel in the west, it goes and starts a fist-fighting rumble, and if there's a trivial dispute in the east, it goes and starts a feud of wounds. Wherever Don Shoutmon goes,...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars Big Digimon Collection Poster

species.name: Done Devimon
species.profile: A form of Devimon that took in negative data to its limit and became an Ultimate. Its mental state is between normal and abnormal, and once it is angered, its intelligence vanishes, and it attacks in a ferocious manner. Digimon that are attacked by a berserk Done Devimon disappear without a trace.Its Special Moves are piercing the opponent's entire body (Destroy Claw), a destructive energy wave emitted from its mouth (Ultimate Flare), and crushing the opponent with its two arms, which materialize as a result of its overflowing negative data (l=Miasma-spew).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure:: "The Final Stage, Done Devimon"

species.name: Dorbickmon
species.profile: The general of the Fire-fury Army of the "Big Death-Stars". It leads a multitude of dragon Digimon in perfect order, and destroys its enemies with its overwhelming battle strength no matter the combat situation. It excels in both power and speed, and its keen intuition honed by its wealth of combat experience allows it to adapt to any situation in battle. Its personality is one that prefers to see flames of destruction surge across the battlefield; as such, it stirs up strife whenever it comes across a peaceful area. Not only that, it revels in the sight of other Digimon and even the world...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "To a New World! The Fire Rage General's Dragon Land"

species.name: Dorbickmon Darkness Mode (Dragon Army)
species.profile: Its offensive and defensive abilities have improved dramatically! It also gained the ability to fly.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Stand Up, Kihira! The Xros Heart Rescue Strategy"

species.name: Dorbickmon Darkness Mode (Flare Lizamon)
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "To a New World! The Fire Rage General's Dragon Land"

species.name: Dorbickmon Darkness Mode (Huanglongmon)
species.kanji: ドルビックモンダークネスモード
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "To a New World! The Fire Rage General's Dragon Land"

species.name: Dorimon
species.profile: A Lesser Digimon that can run very quickly, as long as it is going straight. Dorimon often remain wild as they hate to be domesticated, and approaching one is risky as it will recklessly charge and perform a ramming attack. Its ears have grown sharp and hard, doubling as horns and inflicting a little damage on whatever it rams into, though it can't turn when going at speed. Its Special Move is spewing an iron bead out of its mouth while charging at the opponent (Metal Drop).

species.name: DORUgamon
species.profile: A ferocious Beast Dragon Digimon that possesses the disposition of a beast and a dragon, it is such a heavyweight that most Digimon run away just at the sight of its shadow. Although it exhibits the ferocity of a wild beast in battle, it also has the intelligence of a dragon, and is usually very docile. Because it has an old-style Interface on its brow, it is presumed to be an evolution of a "Prototype Digimon". Its Special Move is firing a large iron sphere from its mouth, smashing the opponent (Power Metal). With its Signature Move, "Cannonball", it is able to fire an iron sphere even...

species.name: DORUgoramon
species.profile: DORUgoramon is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a Digicore". It is a form that had even the Digicore's own creativity miraculously released through the Interface on its brow, and evolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the potent life-force data of the legendary beast, the "Dragon", within its Digicore, the form created by its Digicore is a mighty avatar of "Destruction", and is an incarnation of the "". Its Special Moves are putting its body and soul into a terrifying assault (Brave Metal), and releasing a destructive shock wave (DORU Din).

species.name: DORUguremon
species.profile: A colossal Beast Dragon Digimon whose form was released through the Interface on its brow by the potent life-force data of the legendary beast, the "Dragon", which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore, and that holds the alias of "". With its overwhelming stature it can demolish any dauntlessly courageous Digimon, and even the attacks of the "Nightmare Soldiers" are deflected with one sweep of its wing. It is highly intelligent, and won't reveal its existence carelessly, so it is difficult to even detect it. Its Special Moves are firing a supermassive iron sphere more than ten...

species.name: Dorulumon
species.profile: A faithful Beast Digimon with a chivalrous spirit. It usually sticks to rocky, mountainous areas, and often acts alone without flocking with others.The drill on its head is a hardened portion of its hairs, and its "Drill Buster", which rapidly spins the drill and then shoots it, boasts unerring accuracy. It specializes in using "Hit and Away" tactics as its strategy, where it runs around while on land at high speed to confuse the opponent before inflicting a single blow.Its "Dorulu Tornado", which enlarges the drill on its tail and then raises a tornado, is a threat not only in ground...

species.name: Dorulumon + Starmons
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Stingmon, The Hero of the Digimon Jungle"

species.name: DORUmon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated Interface on its brow, presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. The personality of natural Combat Species Digimon manifests particularly strongly within it, so its combat instinct is high; it often barks and bites at everything as a result, though it apparently feels a sense of attachment to something after biting it. The data that is said to have been hidden within the deepest parts of its Digicore during an experiment is the potent life-force data of the legendary beast, the "Dragon", and it is...

species.kanji: ドットシャイングレイモン

species.name: Doumon
species.profile: An onmyouji Digimon that is versed in Onmyoudou and freely uses every technique in battle. Its spellcasting ability is particularly high, and it specializes in attacks using talismans and spells. Like Taomon, it is a being that lives and lurks within the darkness, but unlike Taomon, it specializes in death curses and assassinations. Not only that, it is able to turn its talismans into shikigami and command them. Its Signature Move is wreathing its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonating them (Jugonsatsu). Its Special Move "Kimontonkou" is a terrifying technique in which it...

species.name: Dracomon
species.profile: An ancient, pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that is said to be the "Progenitor" of all Dramon-type Digimon. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build, and both its power and its quick wits are top class among Child Digimon. Although its personality is ferocious, Dracomon can show its gentle side only to the others it has recognized. It has wings, but it is unable to fly because they are not sufficiently developed. Also, it has a nature whose primary trait is wanting to collect "shiny things", with an especially strange attachment to gems and...

species.name: Dracomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An ancient, pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that is said to be the "Progenitor" of all Dramon-type Digimon. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build, and both its power and its quick wits are top class among Child Digimon. Although its personality is ferocious, Dracomon can show its gentle side only to the others it has recognized. It has wings, but it is unable to fly because they are not sufficiently developed. Also, it has a nature whose primary trait is wanting to collect "shiny things", with an especially strange attachment to gems and...

species.name: Dracomon + Cyberdramon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Glorious DigiXros, Seize it! Our Future!!"

species.name: Dracumon
species.profile: The Dark Area's most mischievous Digimon. For the sake of a prank, it will meet the challenge unflinchingly even if it is accompanied by some risk. It once nearly got itself killed trying to graffiti the faces of all four of the Four Holy Beasts...(it's unknown whether it succeeded). It was once a bloodsucking Digimon, but these days it forgets to suck blood, and it seems it's trying to play some kind of trick on the Royal Knights. It is said that those who look into the "Eye of Nightmare" cast from the evil eyes on the palms of its hands have their hearts completely dominated by Dracumon....
species.debut: Bx-165 (Digitalize Booster Pack) or Digimon Accel Evil Genome

species.name: Drimogemon
species.profile: A Digimon that moves underground at high speeds with the gigantic drill attached to its snout. It is an extremely rare Digimon to come across because it is always digging deep underground. Although it has a meek, shy personality, it is fairly mischievous, and sometimes it takes the favorite bones that Garurumon has buried underground and hides them in different locations. Its Special Moves are attacking the enemy with its gigantic drill (Drill Spin), and throwing the bone it stole from Garurumon (Crusher Bone).

species.name: Duftmon
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "Power Equals Justice! Beast Knight Duftmon"

species.name: Duftmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon that is acknowledged even by the other Royal Knights as their foremost strategist. It has the invaluable ability to lead the Royal Knights, who each possess a dogma that they believe in. When it goes into personal combat it changes into "Leopard Mode" and races across the battlefield. Its Special Moves are the , a beam sword which it swings downward in an overhead arc (Aussterben), and the , which fires explosive energy (Ernste Welle).The Chrome Digizoid armor covering its body has converted into the highly elastic "Brown Digizoid", enhancing Duftmon's flexible...

species.name: Duftmon: Leopard Mode
species.kanji: ドゥフトモン：レオパルドモード
species.profile: In "", its Special Moves are causing towering pillars of bedrock to appear from the ground, tossing the opponent (Wolkenkratzer), and running across the land and flying through the sky, tearing the opponent apart from every angle (Blockade). Also, the spherical tip of Duftmon's tail generates globe-shaped energy mines that become its weapon "Eroberung", which it strategically encircles the opponent with.

species.name: Dukemon
species.profile: This Holy Knight Digimon is called one of the "Royal Knights" alongside Omegamon and Magnamon. The Royal Knights are Digimon assigned the highest rank of Network Security, so it is absolutely impossible to violate Security in their presence. It is a living contradiction, being a guardian deity of the Net despite being a Virus attribute, and if by any chance its balance is lost, it is possible for it to become a dangerous being. It is clad in holy armor refined and constructed from 99.9% pure Chrome Digizoid, and it wields the holy lance "Gram (mythology)" in its right hand and the holy...

species.name: Dukemon: Crimson Mode
species.kanji: デュークモン：クリムゾンモード
species.profile: A hidden form of Dukemon whose body is clad in armor that shines crimson. Because it has fully released its power, its armor portions possess the heat to dye them red. For that reason, it is unable to maintain for a long duration. Within its chest is its Digicore, which sealed the "Digital Hazard", and when it discharges all the power in its body, a pinnate energy emission can be distinguished coming from its back. It wields a divine lance of light, "", and a divine sword of light, "", energy weapons that have no physical form. Its Special Moves are cutting the opponent to pieces with its...

species.name: Dukemon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: This Holy Knight Digimon is called one of the "Royal Knights" alongside Omegamon and Magnamon. The Royal Knights are Digimon assigned the highest rank of Network Security, so it is absolutely impossible to violate Security in their presence. It is a being containing contradictions, as it is called a guardian deity of the Net despite being a Virus attribute, and if by any chance its balance is lost, it is possible for it to become a dangerous being. It is clad in holy armor refined and constructed from 99.9% pure Chrome Digizoid, and its right hand can become the holy lance "" while its left...

species.name: Duramon
species.profile: As it continues to sprint forward, this Perfect level Digimon is a step closer to crossing into the world on the other side. Although it knows not what future awaits it, it continues training and tempering its swords to cut through any obstacles that stand in its way. When it transforms itself into a weapon, it uses the characteristic greatsword on its back to unleash countless varieties of attacks. Its Special Moves are slicing the enemy with the blades on both arms (Grasslash), and firing a beam attack from its chest, which deals massive damage and carves a '20' mark into the enemy if it...

species.name: Durandamon
species.profile: A Digimon possessing the ultimate holy blade, it evolved by honing its sword to its best ability and attaining data on 'legendary swords' found in mythology and video games. Boasting strength that puts it among the strongest Legend-Arms capable of transforming into swords, it is said that wielding Durandamon in sword form will surely bring about victory. Its slashing attacks are fierce enough to cut through any sort of defense, although there have been records that only the strongest of the Legend-Arms Digimon capable of transforming into shields are able to withstand Durandamon's...

species.name: Duskmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Darkness which bears the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors. The regret of various extinct species of Digimon and the "Forbidden Data" on the Net transformed into intense dark energy, and coalesced into Duskmon. The dark energy exists in order to oppose the light of holy beings, and the one who possesses power over Light is the flip side of the same coin. It has a thoroughly evil personality, so it is both callous and cruel. It is the possessor of demon lord-like dignity that is overflowing with perfectionism and confidence. It is invincible in...

species.name: Dynasmon
species.profile: One of the holy "Royal Knights", it possesses the powers of the wyvern. It is a unique being among the Royal Knights, in that it serves the lord who embodied its own sense of justice with deep, unquestioning loyalty. For example, for the sake of its own justice, it won't hate its lord even if they are called "Evil". For that reason, it has a strong spirit of chivalry and bushido, with a character that honors devotion, fidelity, and courtesy. With its tenacious, dragon-like power, and dragon armor made from high-purity Chrome Digizoid, it boasts unparalleled strength. Its Special Moves are...

species.name: EBEmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that was artificially created from a Vademon that was captured, and had its configuration data analyzed and improved. In a certain country's facility, called "Area 51", it seems they were using and building extraterrestrial technology, but the truth is shrouded in mystery. Its Special Move "Brain Rupture" is firing a cracking program into the opponent's brain with the gun it holds in its left hand, then absorbing all the data stored in their brain. Its "Planet Destroyer" is a technique that releases all of its accumulated power and fires it off from the gun in its right...

species.name: Ebi Burgamon
species.profile: A Digimon that took in food data. Maybe because it consists of the selected ingredient data, it is a Digimon with a pure heart. Ebi Burgamon is a variant species of Burgamon, and has taken in the ingredient data of fresh shrimp. Its Special Moves are its "Fresh Shrimp" and "Hot Cutlet", which produce smells savory enough to stop the opponent in their tracks.

species.name: Ebidramon
species.profile: A nonconformist of the Dramon-type which has a tough, shrimp-like shell and gigantic pincers. If one is misled by its outward appearance and makes light of Ebidramon, they will become prey of the offensive ability characteristic of the Dramon-type. Its Special Move is swooping down on them with its two pincers (Twin Neptune).

species.name: Ekakimon
species.profile: The Digimon with the greatest passion for art amongst everyone in the Digital World. Its body is made up of vibrant colored pencils, and it is always drawing pictures that it likes no matter the time and place. The pencils can also be used for its attack "Colorful Change", which changes depending on the colors used. The attack "Colorful Change" turns fire-elemental when red is used, water-elemental when blue is used, grass-elemental when green is used, and so on and so forth. Not only that, it is able to draw tiny Ekakimon and cause them to materialize into "Mini Mini Ekakimon", which it...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Resurrect! The Appearance of all Seven Death Generals!!"'s Eyecatch

species.name: El Doradimon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon that once wandered into the research data for ancient ruins on a neglected computer, and over a long period time unified with that data. Once its head, arms, and legs are retracted, it looks indistinguishable from the ruins of an ancient fortress. The enormous quantity of research data it holds has turned it into a slow-witted Digimon with a large build; nevertheless, bringing it down is likely a difficult task, even if it is attacked by scores of Digimon. It is the very definition of an impregnable Digimon. Its Special Moves are charging the opponent with its large body...

species.name: Elecmon
species.profile: A Mammal Digimon that retained Tunomon's mammal-like elements as it evolved. It's very curious and lively, and inherited its prank-loving personality from Tunomon. Also, Elecmon possesses nine tails, and during battle, it fans them out like a peacock's feathers to intimidate its opponent. Its Special Move is "Sparkling Thunder".

species.name: Elecmon (Violet)
species.profile: An Elecmon that evolved into a Virus-type. It has an unpleasant personality that bullies indiscriminately, and dextrously uses its tails to strike the enemy. Its Signature Move is unleashing a nine-hit combo with its nine tails (Tail Dusk). Its Special Move is generating electricity with the static produced by rubbing its tails together, causing interference through jamming waves (Jamming Thunder).

species.name: Elephamon
species.profile: An Armor-level Cyborg Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Miracles". It is a Super Digimon that overwhelms other Digimon with its large build and extreme power, capable of moving at high speeds contrary to its appearance thanks to its gigantic ear turbines. Although it is unable to fly in the air using its turbines, their hovering function allows it to move by slightly floating above the ground, so it can even travel on water. While it has a very gentle personality, it is a Digimon with a strong sense of justice, so it can be said that Elephamon is terrifying being...

species.name: Elizamon
species.profile: A Reptile Digimon characterized by its frill, which is soft like fabric. Its ears, which look like ribbons, are so good at picking up noises that they can react to even the slightest of sounds in their surroundings. It usually prefers inhabiting quiet areas, and folds its ears to shut out noise when sleeping. A species with an elegant personality, it is often regarded as cute, along with its frill and ears, but it also has a ferocious side where it spreads its frill wide and leaps at invading enemies.Its Special Moves are mincing the opponent while rapidly spinning its frill (Frilled...

species.name: Enbarrmon
species.profile: An Undead Digimon that can race across anywhere—like the sea or the sky—just as it does on land. It has a rough temperament and is extremely belligerent, and since it does not move in herds, it is rarely ever seen. Although it bestows the powerful "never die" protection upon its rider, befitting for an Undead-type, it is said that only those Enbarrmon recognizes as its master are able to mount it. Also, the shockwaves generated by Enbarrmon once it reaches its maximum speed cause heavy damage to the surroundings it dashes through.Its Special Moves are rushing through the sky and charging...

species.name: Entmon
species.profile: A Plant Digimon with a body woven and fused together from dead trees. Its whole body has rotted away in places, and mold grows on parts where the bark has been exposed. Its body is packed with a large number of insects, serving as the muscles that move its body around. It is very terrifying to see the insects spill out of the joints all over its body each time it takes off with its dead leaf wings.Its Special Moves are skewering the enemy with its sharp stake-like tusks (Dryad Stinger), and spewing a black miasma which causes the opponent's body to completely wither up (Blasted Disaster)....

species.name: Eosmon (Adult)
species.profile: An artificial Digimon that was created based on a certain Digimon. The prevailing view that the Child level is the final form of artificial Digimon has been refuted due to the passion of researchers with the changing times, allowing them to evolve to the Adult level. Because Eosmon lacks emotion and moves according to the researcher's instructions, its good or wicked actions are down to the researcher.Its transparent, panel-shaped wings are used in its "Mirror Guard", where it spreads them to protect itself or the target, and in its "Mirror Dust", where it detaches them and sends them...

species.name: Eosmon (Perfect)
species.profile: The form Adult-level Eosmon evolved into when a problem occurred as it was carrying out a mission. It deploys even more transparent panels, and has acquired high-speed movement with its enormous wings and high offensive power with its gigantic hands. In addition, it can also create illusions by using them as mirrors to bewilder the enemy. It transforms into its by rearranging its transparent panels, and attacks the enemy.Its Special Moves are crushing the enemy with its gigantic hands (Beat Press), unleashing an electric attack from its antennae (Hexa-thunder), and throwing the panel-shaped...

species.name: Eosmon (Ultimate)
species.profile: An Ultimate-level Eosmon that was born after several of the Eosmon that were created formed a single collective entity as a result of a researcher losing control when things didn't go as planned. It will destroy any obstacle, and act violently just as instructed. It is able to generate new Perfect-level Eosmon from its swollen tail, increasing its subordinates.Its Special Moves are a beam fired from its chest (w=Aurora (mythology) Stream), slashing the enemy by teleporting (Cutting Edge), and enlarging the panels that it protects itself with, causing them to rain down over the enemy,...

species.name: Erlangmon
species.zh: 真君兽<small> - From "<small>(清源妙道真君)</small>", which is a title given for the Chinese deity "<small>(二郎神)</small>" in . "<small>(真君)</small>" means "True Lord".</small>
species.profile: A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It acts in accordance with its conviction to rid all Digimon of their wicked hearts, and others refer to it as an upright Digimon due to the way it is honest.A master that wields the as freely as its own limbs, it is also accompanied by its sentient treasure tool "", which resembles the head of a giant dog, and cherishes it as its companion, appearing anywhere in an instant regardless of the situation when summoned, and excelling in surprise attacks. In addition, Erlangmon also has a transformation ability that...

species.name: Erlangmon: Blast Mode
species.kanji: イーランモン：ブラストモード
species.zh: 真君兽：疾风形态 <small>/</small> 真君兽BM<small> - From "<small>(清源妙道真君)</small>", which is a title given for the Chinese deity "<small>(二郎神)</small>" in . "<small>(真君)</small>" means "True Lord".</small>
species.profile: The awakened form Erlangmon puts on display after unleashing its power to the utmost limit only when eliminating enemies that it is incapable of defeating, even if they are observed with its third eye. It wears a transformed as armor, and the third eye above its head has the power to see through everything.It fights while "observing" all things, including the opponent's thoughts as well, with its awakened third eye, and tears the enemy to pieces with the , which has turned into a gigantic energy form. It is safe to say that its fighting style, which can even foresee the future, is...

species.name: Espimon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that immediately flies in to investigate whenever it catches wind of gossip or suspicion circulating in the Digital World. It will boldly go undercover in order to find out the truth, even in places inhabited by dangerous Digimon. When it toggles its eyes to , it is able to clearly see objects several kilometers away. Also, it activates its "", which applies an optical camouflage to its body, by pressing the switch on its abdomen, and blends in with its surroundings, allowing it to perform reconnaissance without being discovered. Its Signature Move is the self-propulsive,...

species.name: Etemon
species.profile: An unidentified Digimon that suddenly appeared in the Digital World. It calls itself the "", and its fighting strength is beyond imagination. And, well, it's rumored that it pulls the strings of the mysterious Digimon "Monzaemon". It is dressed in its reinforced which can endure every attack, and even today it bustles about the whole world for the sake of its unending battles. Its Special Move is breaking the opponent's heart and making their fighting spirit vanish (Love Serenade), and a dark sphere that consumes everything it touches (Dark Spirits).

species.name: Evilmon
species.profile: A strong-willed Small Devil Digimon that abhors losing. For that reason, it is a coward that needles and torments the weak without getting into direct combat. Though it seems to be considered as the source of the Dark-species Digimon that inhabit the Dark Area, there are still many mysteries surrounding it. Its Special Move is subjecting its target to an unwakeable nightmare using a supersonic wave that it emits from its mouth (Nightmare Shock).

species.name: Ex-Tyranomon
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that sneaks around within a Tyranomon-shaped plush toy. The reason why it is a Tyranomon plush toy is unclear, but it is likely that the mysterious Digimon that is stealing away inside just broke into the plush toy that was closest. However, this plush toy possesses power rivaling that of Monzaemon at its limits and the defensive power of an impregnable fortress, so ordinary Digimon and the like are completely unable to oppose it. However, like Monzaemon, if nothing is pulling its strings, then it is nothing but an ornament. Its Special Moves are "Pretty Attack", which...

species.name: Examon
species.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's sacred guardians, the "Royal Knights". As it is a Digimon which possesses an extraordinary data size, traditional digital tools were unable to completely render it, and its existence was discovered because it finally became possible to render it with the use of state-of-the-art digital tools. Though it belongs to the Royal Knights, it is simultaneously a being which stands at the top of all Dragon Digimon, and holds the alias of "". It possesses the gigantic, sentient wings "Excalibur" and the gigantic lance "". The is a unique set...

species.name: Examon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's sacred guardians, the "Royal Knights". As it is a Digimon which possesses an extraordinary data size, traditional digital tools were unable to completely render it, and its existence was discovered because it finally became possible to render it with the use of state-of-the-art digital tools. Though it belongs to the Royal Knights, it is simultaneously a being which stands at the top of all Dragon Digimon, and holds the alias of "". It possesses the gigantic, sentient wings "" and the gigantic lance "". The is a unique set of wings...

species.name: Exermon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Eyesmon
species.profile: A Digimon capable of concealing itself in shadows. The more data it accumulates, the stronger it becomes, and its power surpasses even that of Perfects depending on how much it has stored. It possesses many eyes, and does not turn a blind eye to any of the enemy's movements. Its Special Moves are cursed beams fired from all of its eyes (Janengan), and transforming the data it has accumulated into objects and using them both offensively and defensively (Gugen).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure:: "The Jet-black Shadow Invades Tokyo"

species.name: Eyesmon: Scatter Mode
species.kanji: アイズモン：スキャッターモード
species.profile: The scattered form of Eyesmon. It monitors social networking services where large volumes of data flow, and consumes and accumulates larger data. Their power is weak due to them being scattered about, but once they sense that they are in danger, they will converge into one and counterattack. Its Special Moves are cursed beams fired from its eyes (Janengan), and entering the enemy's shadow and controlling its movements (Kageshibari)
species.debut: Digimon Adventure:: "And to the Digital World"

species.name: Fairimon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Wind which bears the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors. It freely manipulates the atmosphere to display mirages to its opponents, and specializes in attacks that generate "Kamaitachi" made from vacuums. However, it is more proficient in information warfare than in actual combat ability. Although it has an innocent personality brimming with curiosity, and is a gossipy, talkative troublemaker, because it has no ill will for the person, it isn't really hated. It is thoroughly optimistic, and is the possessor of a strong heart that cuts its way...
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "My Painful Kick! Female Warrior Fairymon" or St-626 (Starter Ver. 7)

species.name: Falcomon
species.profile: A Bird Digimon that lives on 3000m-tall mountains. As its wings are not very developed, it's not so much able to fly as it is able to glide; to make up for that, it is able to run about craggy mountains at great speed with its powerful legs. Because it has a rough temperament, you must be careful because if you approach carelessly, you will get fiercely attacked. Its Special Moves are scratching the opponent with its wing claws (Scratch Smash), and an attack it unleashes using its powerful leg strength (Falco Rush).

species.name: Falcomon (2006 Anime Version)
species.kanji: ファルコモン（２００６アニメ版）
species.profile: A subspecies of Falcomon whose wings have developed to allow it to fly freely in the air, in contrast to normal Falcomon, who possess powerful leg strength. Despite its ability to fly, it seems to be obsessed with making its appearance from above by flying in on a kite, like a ninja. Its Special Moves are scratching the opponent with the claws on its wings (Scratch Smash), and repeatedly throwing 4-point shuriken made out of hardened feathers (Shuririnken). Furthermore, it also specialises in dropping small bombs from above while it is riding its kite (Uchitake Otoshi).
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "I Will Protect Chika! Piyomon's Decision!"

species.name: Fangmon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon that lives deep in the heart of the forest, and preys upon those who lose their way. It is said that it is definitely the data of the Big Bad Wolf that appears within many fairy-tales, become a Digimon, and once it sets its sights on a prey they will never escape, as it sometimes goes so far as to disguise itself as someone dear to its prey in order to get closer. It has a heretical existence among Dog and Wolf-species Digimon, and if Garurumon is a being of the light, then Fangmon is a being of darkness. Its Signature Move is stealing things like weapons and items...

species.name: Fantomon
species.profile: A Reaper-like Digimon holding a gigantic sickle and chain. It is a higher class of Ghost Digimon compared to Bakemon, so when a person is possessed by Fantomon they are in their last moments, and it comes upon them when they die completely. There is a crystal shaped like an eyeball hanging from its neck, and similar to Mammon's crest, it is able to foresee everything with its power of clairvoyance, in order to perceive those that are close to death. It is said that the interior of the cloth which conceals its body leads to a separate dimension from the Digital World, and its Special Move is...

species.name: Fenriloogamon
species.profile: Fenriloogamon is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a Digicore". It is a form that had even the Digicore's own creativity miraculously released through the Interface on its brow, and evolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the data of the warg from real-world mythology within its Digicore, the form created by its Digicore is an "Ultimate Demon Beast", clad in silver armor and wielding an inexhaustible supply of magical power. The magical blue flames that envelop its whole body are kept under control at its own volition, and despite having an extremely high burning...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet BE (BEMemory Digimon Seekers Loogamon Dim)

species.name: Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi
species.kanji: フェンリルガモン：建御雷神
species.zh: 芬里尔魔狼兽：建御雷神
species.debut: Vital Bracelet BE (BEMemory Digimon Seekers Loogamon Dim)

species.name: Filmon
species.profile: A Beast Man Digimon with many large spikes sprouting out of its body. It has red claws that can pierce through anything, and yellow quills that inject energy into whatever they stab. It has a carefree personality, the kind that likes to collect soft material to help it to sleep comfortably in its nest or search for its favorite foods.Its Special Moves are skewering the enemy with its quills and injecting energy into them that destroys their data (Lightning Stinger), and slashing with the claws on both hands without stopping (Crimson Slash).

species.name: Firamon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon with the alias "". It guards a certain ruins site located in the Digital World, and is also a caring leader-figure. Its Special Moves are cloaking its entire body in flames and attacking by diving down from the air (Flame Dive), as well as tearing the enemy apart with its powerful, flame-covered front limbs (Fira Claw). Not only that, it is also capable of concentrating all of its energy into its forehead, and firing a flaming bomb (Fira Bomb).

species.name: Fla Wizarmon
species.profile: A Demon Man Digimon that Armor Evolved with the "Digimental of Courage". It is full of confidence and shows its true face, the exact opposite of Wizarmon, who is shy and does not show its uncovered face. It wields two matchstick-like staffs, which further enhance the effectiveness of its fire sorcery (high-level programming language). Its Signature Move is "Magic Ignition". Its Special Move is changing its surroundings into a firestorm (Fire Cloud).

species.name: Fladramon
species.profile: An Armor-level Dragon Man Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Courage". The "Digimental of Courage" has the attribute of "Flame", and those that don this Digimental have their combat ability rise like blazing flames, allowing them to perform attacks on enemy Digimon with intense power. Its Signature Move is driving its fiery fists into the enemy (Knuckle Fire). Its Special Move is changing its entire body into a flaming rocket, and pulverizing the enemy (Fire Rocket).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: "The One who Inherits Courage"

species.name: Flamon
species.profile: A Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when Agnimon lost its power. It is missing the "Combat Instinct" that Digimon naturally possess, and moreover, it has lost power. However, it is a being that has inherited a Spirit of the legendary Ten Warriors who possess ultimate strength, so although it has lost power, ordinary Adult-class Digimon aren't a match for it. If anything, it has kindness inappropriate for a Digimon and is similar to a Child Digimon, counterbalancing its mischievous part. Its Special Move is firing off an aura of flames (Baby Salamander).

species.name: Flare Lizamon
species.profile: A Flame Dragon Digimon whose entire body is wrapped in flames. It is a hot-blooded Digimon that possesses both a heart that burns like fire and the power of a dragon. Although the flames throughout its body are generated by its high-temperature skin combusting, its skin has remarkable regenerative abilities, and so Flare Lizamon is able to continue burning till its last breath. In addition, the claws on both its arms have become extremely hot from being scorched by the flames covering its body, so the opponents it tears apart suffer double damage from being both lacerated and burned. Its...

species.name: Flaremon
moves: Crimson Wave of the Beast King
species.profile: Although its regal mane and imposing manner may be intimidating at first glance, this strong-willed Beast Man Digimon will brave any hardship for the sake of its comrades. Its Special Moves are concentrating flames and the spirit of a lion into its fist, and firing it as an energy wave in the shape of a lion (Gurenjūouha), as well as dishing out a mad flurry of grappling moves using its blazing punches and kicks to strike the enemy repeatedly (Kurenai Shishi no Mai). Not only that, it is able to unleash from its mouth together with a roar a purifying shockwave that burns everything down,...

species.name: Floramon
species.profile: A rare Digimon that evolved like a reptile but is categorized as a Plant type, much like Palmon. Its whole face has the appearance of a flower, and its head is usually protected by its petal-styled shell like a helmet. When intruders are not around or when it's in a good mood, the petals on its head and both of its arms open up wide. It sees Palmon as its rival, and has a very prideful personality. Its Special Move is producing allergy-inducing pollen from the flowers on both of its arms (Allergy Shower). Those who suffer this technique, even larger Digimon, will become unable to maintain...

species.name: Flybeemon
species.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Knowledge". It is a mythical Digimon that is said to have evolved in a mutant-like manner due to the power of the Digimental when Kunemon emerged in large numbers. Honeybeemon and Butterflamon are also species of Flybeemon, so it is extremely rare to encounter. It is very territorial, and will try to repel those that intrude its territory, even if they are an Ultimate. Its Special Moves are rapidly vibrating the wings on its back and sending out an electric shock (Fly Spark), and firing the hardened stinger...

species.name: Flymon
species.profile: An Insect Digimon that possesses gigantic, baleful wings. With its gigantic wings it is able to fly about at extremely high speed, and it generates a great Howling Noise called buzzing while in flight, completely numbing the sense of hearing of those who hear it. Its body is protected by a hard shell, and it pinches the opponent between its large talons and brings death with the super-powerful stinger on its tail. Although the evolutionary processes of Insect Digimon are still unclear, it is thought that it evolved from a Kunemon-species, guessing by the appearance of its face. Its Special...

species.name: Footmon
species.profile:
The most sportsmanly Digimon in the Digital World. It loves sports, and likes soccer most of all, so it is always practicing dribbling and shooting with balls of light. Its dream is to create a soccer league to compete with fellow Digimon. Its Special Moves are placing a ball of light on the ground and shooting it at the enemy (Lightning Shoot), and lifting the ball high up in the air and shooting it (Lightning w=Bicycle kick). 
* A winning entry in the Digimon Xros Wars Original Digimon Contest.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "For the Future of the Digital World! The Friendship with the Death Generals!"'s Eyecatch

species.name: Frimon
species.profile: A Lesser Digimon possessing a frill on its neck. Its frill was made from a hardened portion of its hairs, and by covering its body with the frill when danger approaches, it can be used as "Armor" to protect its body. Since it is extremely full of curiosity, it has a habit of responding to anything that moves, but because it also responds to its own tail, it chases after it, and is often observed spinning in place. Increasing the centrifugal force in its long tail (Shippo Binta) is a power in itself, and it occasionally seems that even a Child Digimon will instantly faint if it is hit cleanly.

species.name: Frogmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mutation Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Purity". Those who evolve with the "Digimental of Purity" often evolve into a Mutation-type, and Frogmon itself has several mysterious devices equipped to its body. Although this Digimon was only discovered recently, analysis of the data comprising its body has confirmed that it is a species from an old generation of Digimon. Its translucent mask is very soft, and reduces the energy of the enemy's attacks to near zero. The wheels attached to its back allow it to fly through the air, and it can apparently...

species.name: Fros Velgrmon‎‎
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Blizzard Fang Dim Card)

species.name: Frozomon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon that inhabits areas with heavy snowfall and removes snow vigorously. Contrary to its reliable side that rescues those who get lost in snowstorms and the like, it is also a troublesome Digimon who uses all its strength to eliminate those that get in the way of its rescues, even if they are Babies. It is a specialist when it comes to cold regions who is capable of not only removing snow, but also melting ice with its red-hot sword.Its Special Moves are unleashing a punch attack with its enormous right arm while charging (Removal Blow), and piercing the enemy using heat from...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Blizzard Fang Dim Card)

species.name: Fufumon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon with an extremely light body that has floated through the air since it was born. When its life is threatened by an assault from a larger opponent, it will thrust at them with the horn on its head to intimidate them with all its might, but because the horn is very soft, the thrust will not injure the opponent. Though it is easy for opponents to target it because it floats very slowly through the air, but if they approach it spit "Chīsana Tetsu no Toge" from its mouth to attack.

species.name: Fugamon
species.profile: A Digimon whose form resembles that of the Oni from Eastern legends. It belongs to the same family as Orgemon, sporting the same violent, battle-loving personality. The attacks dealt using its well-developed muscles pack extraordinary power, and bring about absolute destruction. Its Special Move is spinning its , using it to mow everything down (Evil Hurricane).

species.name: Fujinmon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon bestowed with the name of the Fūjin of Oriental folklore. As a Light Fighter that battles with light movements, it specializes in close combat. Its Special Moves are cutting the enemy to pieces with the same cutter-type arm as Justimon (Critical Arm), and knocking the enemy away with strong winds (Marut Cyclone).

species.name: Fujitsumon
species.debut: Pendulum 2.0 Deep Savers (mention in Octmon's profile and seen in Octmon's artwork)

species.name: Fukamon
species.profile: A Smoke Digimon with virtually no mass, like a cloud, that floats lightly through the air. It doesn't move that much on its own accord, but since it travels around by going with the wind, it widely inhabits the continent of the Eastern Digital World. On stormy days, it is said to take shelter behind objects or large Digimon so that it doesn't get blown away.When it senses that it is in danger, it spews out clouds with its "Koun" and then flees.

species.name: Fumamon
species.profile: A ninja Digimon that has mastered the excellent assassination technique of . It makes its living as an assassin, disposing of its targets upon receiving a request. It specializes in melee attacks that capitalize on its outstanding physical ability, but since it also utilizes projectile weapons such as shuriken, it has attack styles that leave few openings, even at mid and long-range. It will relentlessly pursue its designated target, even if they escape, so the only way they can save themselves is by defeating Fumamon. It is able to freely control the trajectory of the "" shuriken attached...

species.name: Funbeemon
species.profile: An Insect Digimon that belongs to the mysterious "aerial, covert honey base, Royal Base". Although its daily life differs from that of other Insect Digimon, it is a strong, dedicated worker due to its personality being so cheerful. It always gets along with Plant Digimon like Palmon or Lilimon. Because the base is usually under construction, it has the duty of carrying home data left on fields of flowers or vegetation, little by little, to use as raw materials, causing it to be classified as a Virus-species. Also, because the base is defended by powerful Digimon, making it impossible to...

species.name: Fusamon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. Although it is a Digimon brimming with curiosity that loves to move around, it spends most of its time sleeping due to it tiring easily. When danger draws near, it will emit a high-pitched, threatening cry called "Puppy Noise".
species.debut: Vital Bracelet BE (BEMemory Digimon Seekers Loogamon Dim)

species.name: G-Cutemon
species.kanji: グレイテストキュートモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "X7 of Bonds! The Great Battle with Gravimon!!"

species.name: Gabumon
species.profile: Although it is covered by a fur pelt, it is clearly a Reptile Digimon. Due to its extremely timid and shy personality, it always gathers up the data that Garurumon leaves behind and shapes it into a fur pelt to wear. That fur pelt of Garurumon, who is feared by other Digimon, thus plays a role in safeguarding and protecting Gabumon. When it is wearing the fur pelt, its personality does a complete 180° shift. Its Special Move is "Petit Fire".

species.name: Gabumon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: Although it is covered by a fur pelt, it is clearly a Reptile Digimon. Due to its extremely timid and shy personality, it always gathers up the data which Garurumon leaves behind, and shapes it into a fur pelt to wear. Because it is wearing the fur pelt of Garurumon, who is feared by other Digimon, it fills the role of safeguarding itself as a result of protecting its body. When it is wearing the fur pelt, its personality does a complete 180° shift. Its Special Move is "Petit Fire".Although it was originally classified as a Reptile-type, it became a Beast-type itself by taking in the fur...

species.name: Gabumon (Black)
species.profile: A Gabumon who evolved to a Virus-species. The fur pelt it wears was made by gathering up the data of a viral Garurumon. Although it is violent, it turns cowardly and timid when its pelt is removed, just like the Vaccine-species, and its true face is still a secret. Its Special Move is spitting out a small fireball (Petit Fire).

species.name: Gabumon -Yujo no Kizuna-
species.profile: The strong bond between Gabumon and its Partner, it is a legendary, final evolution that was achieved after countless possibilities. The undying "Friendship" of its Partner turned into elegant armor which covers its body, and appears as proof of the trust coursing through both of them. It is able to fly by generating photon light wings on its back, but it can also transform into its , which is its Partner's favorite vehicle, and ride fast together.Its Special Moves are causing a downpour of iron to rain down from the on its arms (Full Metal Machine Gun), and purging the and unleashing an...

species.name: Gaioumon: Itto Mode
species.kanji: ガイオウモン：厳刀ノ型
species.profile: The form of a Gaioumon defeated in battle that acquired new strength after unimaginable training. The oni data sleeping within its Digicore has awakened, and its fighting style has changed to Ittō-ryū. Having mastered "", kenjutsu passed down in the Eastern Digital World, Gaioumon specializes in "silent" swordplay in which it instantly cuts down its opponents without even making a sound. Once prepared for battle, it is almost impossible to approach Gaioumon without leaving any openings.Its Special Moves are restricting the opponent's movements with a tornado unleashed from the "" (Senpū...

species.name: Galgomon
species.profile: A Beast Man Digimon that evolved from Terriermon and is a Hunter Digimon skilled in hunting. Despite its outward appearance, it uses attacks of unparalleled accuracy and its nimble movements to reliably bring down the opponent. Its leg strength is strong enough for it to jump sky high, and it is also able to spread out its ears to glide. Although it usually has a cheerful personality, it gets out of hand once it is angered. It is obsessed with its cherished "D-VI'S 503xx" jeans. Its Special Moves are the vulcans on both of its arms (Gatling Arm), and getting under the opponent's bosom, then...
