species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Digimon Hurricane Touchdown!! Supreme Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

species.name: Gammamon
species.profile: A very rare, young, white Ceratopsian Digimon that was recently discovered. Gammamon's evolution is said to be linked to a "digital signal that came from extragalactic space". The two hard horns that grow from its brow are weapons that are useful for offense and defense. It is also capable of levitating, and flying for a short period with the tiny wings on its back. It rarely shows its emotions, but it seems that once you reach out to it, it will gradually grow attached to you.Its Special Move is charging with its two horns (Horn Attack). In addition, its "Breaclaw", which it unleashes with...

species.name: Ganemon
species.profile: An old, gentlemanly Digimon in the shape of a 10-yen coin. It loves money, and for the sake of money will use its eloquent way with words to swindle any opponent, no matter who they may be, out of their wealth. Not only that, it uses the Zenimons it keeps in its trunk to collect money. Using its mustache as a radar, it is able to detect the locations of Zenimons that have obtained money, so that it can come over to retrieve them. It eats the money it has collected for its own gain, which causes its body to grow larger in size. Its Special Move is tossing its money to attack (Gold Bowling);...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Approach! The Human World's Last Day, D5"'s Eyecatch

species.name: Ganimon
species.profile: A Crustacean Digimon that stuck the metal data dissolved in the Net Ocean to its body, greatly enhancing its combat ability. For offense, it uses the gigantic blade on its left foreleg and the grip of its strong right foreleg, and for defense, its spine-covered shell inflicts damage to attacking opponents, so it has substantial self-confidence when it comes to battle. Its weak points are its joints and belly, but because it's also aware of that, it never shows that chink in its armor. It likes to entrap its opponents, and has a rascally personality. Its Special Move is aiming its left...

species.name: Ganimon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Crustacean Digimon that stuck the metal data dissolved in the Net Ocean to its body, rapidly enhancing its combat ability. It attacks with the gigantic blade on its left foreleg and the grip of its strong right foreleg and defends with the spine-covered shell that covers itself, inflicting damage to attacking opponents, so it's a confident person with substantial self-confidence in battle. Its weak points are its joint parts and its belly, but because it's also aware of that, it never shows that chink in its armor. It likes to entrap its opponents, and has a rascally personality. Its...

species.name: Gankoomon
species.profile: A Digimon who acceded to the "Royal Knights" because it is a Holy Knight Digimon. Although it is said to have taken up residence in the southwestern edges of the Digital World, it rarely stays in the same place, so it journeys across the Digital World while going around and putting a stop to unusual phenomena and signs of chaos, taking along the next-generation Huckmon as its companion. Unlike the other Royal Knights who rarely show their faces, it actually steps down and acts, and there are many Digimon it counts as bosom friends. In order to pass on its own title as a Royal Knight to...

species.name: Gankoomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Digimon who acceded to the "Royal Knights" because it is a Holy Knight Digimon. Although it is said to have taken up residence in the southwestern edges of the Digital World, it rarely stays in the same place, so it journeys across the Digital World while going around and putting a stop to unusual phenomena and signs of chaos, taking along the next-generation Huckmon as its companion. Unlike the other Royal Knights who rarely show their faces, it actually steps down and acts, and there are many Digimon it counts as bosom friends. In order to pass on its own title as a Royal Knight to...

species.name: Ganvivormon
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 20th Anniversary Memorial Story Project (Unreleased Digimon)

species.name: Gaogamon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon that resulted as Gaomon's physique grew larger, and its claws that were once protected by gloves have grown fully. Although it is a quadruped, its powerful legs also allow it to stand up to attack like a bear. Its Special Moves are approaching the opponent at a speed faster than the eye can see and unleashing its "Dash Double Claw", and biting the opponent with its sturdy teeth, not letting go until they collapse (Gaoga Hound). It can also release a powerful vortex of wind from its mouth in one breath (Spiral Blow).

species.name: Gaomon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon that is thought to be a subspecies of the sharp-clawed Gazimon-species. With its keen movements, it specializes in "Hit and Away" attacks. The gloves on its hands appear to be protecting its claws until they are fully grown. Its Special Moves are utilising its powerful legs and rolling into the opponent's chest (Rolling Upper), and its "Double Backhand" that it unleashes while spinning. Also, it can move nimbly to unleash a high-speed barrage of punches (Gao Rush).

species.name: Gaossmon
species.profile: A tiny Digimon strong only in competitive spirit, and in any case it barks a lot.It is also quick to flee, and extremely swift. Although it is almost impossible to track it down after it runs into the bushes, it will soon begin to bark, giving away its location. Since it specializes in running on land, it dreads water and is totally incapable of swimming. In fact, it can't even cross a 10 cm deep brook, and Gaossmon have occasionally been found nearly drowned and passed out in a puddle of water.Its Special Moves are a medium-temperature jet of flames (Kilo Flame), and an intense headbutt...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Rival!! The Blue Hound Kiriha!!"

species.name: Gargomon
species.profile: An Armor-level Demon Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Light". It was originally a Devil-type Digimon, but its power was suppressed using restraints, and there are instances where it is employed as a familiar for Angel Digimon. It is said that once it is freed from those restraints, it will exhibit tremendous power. Its Special Move is summoning a giant demon statue, and attacking the enemy (White Statue).

species.name: Garudamon
species.profile: A Bird Man Digimon that has gigantic talons and wings that let it dance freely through the sky. Garudamon honors justice and order, and is a guardian deity of the land and wind that loves nature. Its intelligence and combat ability are the highest among Bird Digimon, and it is admired due to it being said that only chosen Digimon can evolve to it. It is thought that if the order of the Digital World is disturbed, it will suddenly appear out of nowhere, and quell the source of the unrest. Also, it is matchless friends with the hero Leomon, who possesses the same will. Its Special Move is...

species.name: Garudamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Bird Man Digimon that has gigantic talons and wings that let it dance freely through the sky. Garudamon honors justice and order, and is a guardian deity of the land and wind that loves nature. Its intelligence and combat ability are the highest among Bird Digimon, and it is admired due to it being said that only chosen Digimon can evolve to it. It is thought that if the order of the Digital World is disturbed, it will suddenly appear out of nowhere, and quell the source of the unrest. Also, it is matchless friends with the hero Leomon, who possesses the same will. Its Special Move is...

species.name: Garummon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Light which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. It is capable of moving at extremely high speed, perhaps because it was discovered on an optical communication Net, so it slips through the bullets to get close to the enemy, and then its sharply-pointed claws and fangs tear through those it considers evil without wasting its breath. As the possessor of a righteous heart becoming of the name of Garmr, who fights with the war god Týr at Ragnarök in Norse mythology, its feelings of hatred for evil are stronger than that of others. Although it...
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "An Uncontrollable Beast Spirit!? Garummon's Evolution" or Bo-721 (Booster 15)

species.name: Garurumon
species.profile: Covered in blue, white, and silver-colored fur, it is a Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a wolf. That fur is as hard as "Mithril", which is said to be a legendary rare metal, and since the blades growing from the tips of its shoulders have sharp edges, anything that touches them is cut to pieces. As it possesses a furious combat instinct and muscles honed in freezing lands, as well as carnivore-like agility and the accuracy to reliably bring down its targets, it is a being feared by other Digimon. However, it is extremely intelligent, and it faithfully obeys those whom it...

species.name: Garurumon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: Covered in blue, white, and silver-colored fur, it is a Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a wolf. That fur is as hard as "Mithril", which is said to be a legendary rare metal, and since the blades growing from the tips of its shoulders have sharp edges, anything that touches them is cut to pieces. As it possesses a furious combat instinct and muscles honed in freezing lands, as well as carnivore-like agility and the accuracy to reliably bring down its targets, it is a being feared by other Digimon. However, it is extremely intelligent, and it faithfully obeys those whom it...

species.name: Garurumon (Black)
species.profile: A Virus attribute Garurumon. The blades extending from its shoulders are so sharp that they slice apart anything they touch. It loves collecting bones and burying them in the ground, though there appear to have been cases of these bones being quietly stolen away by prank-loving Drimogemon. Its Special Move is breathing blue, high-temperature flames from its mouth (Foxfire).

species.name: Gattai Ancient Volcamon
species.kanji: 合体エンシェントボルケーモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Dorulumon, Run Like the Wind!"

species.name: Gattai Lilithmon
species.profile: Lilithmon and Blastmon, former executives of the Bagra Army and members of the Three Head Officers, DigiXros. They possess monstrous power.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Brother, Why!? The Nightmare of Enemy General Yuu"

species.name: Gawappamon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that fused from the data of a music player and the legendary animal, "Kappa". It is always listening to its favorite music in bright and cheerful spirits, but it sheds tears if the disc-like part on its head is damaged. Its Special Moves are rapidly spinning the disc on its head, then shooting it off (DJ Shooter), and a striking technique released from its extensible hands (Gawappa Punch). Also, it surprises the enemy with its mysterious dance "Gawappa Rapper".

species.name: Gazimon
species.profile: A Mammal Digimon with large, sharp claws. It is bipedal, which is rare amongst Mammal types; it is likely that as it continued to use its forelegs like arms, it evolved to grow claws on its forelegs, therefore resulting in its bipedalism. It has an extremely aggressive temperament despite its small size, and it never warms up to humans. Although the claws on its forelegs are very effective at attacking, they are also surprisingly suited to digging holes, which it always does as it enjoys watching other Digimon fall into its pitfalls due to its mischievous personality. Its Special Move is...

species.name: Gazimon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Mammal Digimon that grows large, sharp claws. It is bipedal, which is rare amongst Mammal-types; the claws on its forelegs likely evolved to allow its forelegs to be used as arms, therefore causing its bipedalism. It has an extremely aggressive temperament despite its small size, and it never warms up to humans. Although the claws on its forelegs are very effective at attacking, they are also surprisingly suited to digging holes, which it always does as it enjoys watching other Digimon fall into its pitfalls due to its mischievous personality. Its Special Move is breathing poisonous gas...

species.name: Gekkomon
species.profile: A brightly colored Reptile Digimon that inhabits the tropical rainforests of the Digital World. Since the surface of its body acts as camouflage in its tropical rainforest habitat, it is difficult to find despite its gaudy appearance. Its fingers and toes have organs that allow it to stick to anything, and because it lives its life clinging to things such as trees or boulders, it rarely descends to the ground. Although personality varies from individual to individual, most of them are of a curious and cheerful nature. Its Special Move is striking with with its freely-extendable tongue...

species.name: Gemmon
species.profile: A mysterious Digimon with a distinctive white appearance and a gemstone on its forehead.

species.name: Generamon
species.debut: Second Original Digimon Contest (Digimon Web) (Unreleased Digimon)

species.name: Geo Greymon
species.profile: A unique Digimon that is conjectured to be a subspecies of Greymon. Its entire body as well as the carapace on its head have also developed to become like lethal weapons, giving it a more aggressive appearance. Its Special Move "Mega Flame" is spewing ultra-high-temperature flames from its mouth and reducing everything to ashes. It can also charge its "Mega Flame" to the limit within its mouth, then fire it with explosive power as "Mega Burst". Furthermore, its "Horn Impulse", in which it charges with its gigantic horns and pulverizes the opponent, is also a powerful attack.

species.name: Gerbemon
species.profile: A trash can from a desktop computer which gained life and evolved into a Mutation Digimon. Unlike Scumon, which mutated from discarded scum data, this Digimon is the trash can itself. Until now garbage Digimon were said to be the absolute weakest, but with the arrival of Gerbemon that conventional wisdom will probably be reversed. Also, the trash can can act like a black hole, so that anything that is sucked into the trash can disappears from the Digital World without a trace. Its Special Move is a vile attack in which it fires from its bazooka, constructed from empty cans fastened together...

species.name: Geremon
species.profile: A Mollusk Digimon belonging to the same species as Numemon. Although its offensive power is low, it makes up for that with its ferocity, which is such that it will attack no matter who the opponent is. The opponent would then turn the tables on it, as expected, but its obstinacy leads it to immediately forget such instances and continue to endlessly start fights with tough opponents. Its Special Move is spreading a noxious stench coming from within its body (Hyper Smell).

species.name: Gesomon
species.profile: A Digimon in the shape of a squid which inhabits the depths of the Net Ocean. Although it is feared as the "", it is highly intelligent and will not harm Digimon outside of its territory. However, if anyone appears to cross into its territory even for a moment, it will attack them like a fierce, raging god. Its specializes in the "Hit and Away" attack style, in which it inflicts a single blow as it withdraws from the spot. Its Special Moves are a barrage of attacks that capitalizes on its many legs (Devil Bashing), and powerful squid ink that will completely numb the vision of its targets...

species.name: Gesomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Digimon which has the shape of a squid and inhabits the depths of the Net Ocean. Although it is feared as the "", it is highly intelligent and will not harm Digimon outside of its territory. However, if they seem to cross into its territory even for a moment, it will attack them like a fierce, raging god. Its attack style specializes in "Hit and Away", in which it inflicts a single blow as it withdraws from the spot. Its Special Moves are a barrage of attacks that capitalizes on its many legs (Devil Bashing), and powerful squid ink that will completely numb the opponent's vision for a...

species.name: Ghilliedhumon
species.profile: A Digimon that inhabits forested areas and specializes in sniping. Its skill as a hunter is very high, blending in with the forest using the that covers its whole body and sniping without revealing its location to its prey. Although it is a Digimon with a calm disposition, it has a strong attachment to its territorial hunting grounds, so those who carelessly step into Ghilliedhumon's hunting grounds will be sniped without warning. Since it prefers making slow movements that can mask its presence and the sounds it makes, it is poor at moving swiftly. Ghilliedhumon's eyes have a special...

species.name: Ghostmon
species.profile: A Ghost Digimon that is often witnessed flying over graveyards. Although it doesn't like to show its face due to its timidness and shyness, it is a kind-hearted Digimon that helps those in need, while turning invisible so as not to be noticed by them.When it is forced into battle, it moves about cunningly using its "Little Plasma", in which it fires weak energy shots from its palms, and "w=Jack-o'-lantern Raid", where it turns invisible moments before charging and crashing into the enemy, then striking them from behind while they are still in a state of confusion.

species.name: Giga Breakdramon
species.kanji: ギガブレイクドラモン
species.profile: Giga Breakdramon A giant mechanical Digimon that is said to be the ultimate destructive Digimon. Its special move is called "Infinity Boring", in which it fires out the drills all over its body!
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Robot Club's Dream, Pinochimon's Temptation"

species.name: Giga Seadramon
species.profile: As a successful elaboration on Metal Seadramon, it demonstrates the fastest speed of movement and strongest ability for interception under the sea. In order to further expand its sphere of influence, the Crack Team constructed this massive Digimon in absolute secrecy and endowed it with the ability to control the sea and possession of a cruising range which covers the vast Net Ocean. Its overall length exceeds even that of Whamon, and since Digimon belonging to the Crack Team, such as Chaosdramon, can be loaded in its interior, it is no longer a lone Digimon, and it seems possible to say...

species.name: Giga Waru Monzaemon
species.kanji: ギガワルもんざえモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Sweets Zone! The Sweet-toothed Digimon Battle!"

species.name: Gigadramon
species.profile: A dark dragon Digimon developed at the same time as Megadramon. As a combat dragon that was armed to the teeth by further remodeling, its existence is the epitome of a fiendish computer virus. Its Signature Move is waging attacks with the on both of its arms (Guilty Claw). Its Special Move is firing countless organic missiles (Genocide Gear).

species.name: Gigasmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Earth which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. It is an earth giant that materialized by coalescing soil from the ground and the components of the atmosphere. At the moment of its materialization, it quenched at a high temperature, and its skin changed to one of super-hardness surpassing that of ceramics. Its personality and thoughts are just as arrogant as Grottemon's. Due to it becoming gigantic, it has become more overconfident and its tactics are also extremely violent. Fundamentally, because it makes light of its opponents, it...
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "The Five Legendary Warriors VS The New Warrior!"

species.name: Gigimon
species.profile: A four-legged Baby Digimon that grew from Jyarimon. Its physical features resemble those of Tokomon, and powerful fangs also line the interior of its mouth. However, unlike Tokomon, who evolves into the Mammal-species, Gigimon, who evolves into the Dragon-species, has a rough personality and is ferocious despite its small size. There are more than a few even larger Digimon who were deceived by its appearance and suffered a counterattack. Its Special Move is snapping at the opponent (Hot Bite). Its body temperature is hot, just like Jyarimon, and it is said that it leaves burns on the areas...

species.name: Ginkakumon
species.profile: Ginkakumon is a taciturn boy giant that is feared as one of the "" alongside its big sister Kinkakumon. The that it carries on its back is Kinkakumon's drink, and it's said that the inside is connected to somewhere in a different dimension, and that Digimon who are hurled to this different dimension are converted to alcohol. It is always worrying for its big sister Kinkakumon out of love. It warmly watches over even Kinkakumon's misbehavior, and if there is an unscrupulous fellow approaching its big sister, it throws them with enough power to shake a mountain. If Kinkakumon is aboard the...

species.name: Ginkakumon Promote
species.kanji: ギンカクモンプロモート

species.name: Ginryumon
species.profile: A Beast Dragon Digimon whose entire body is clad in sturdy, Japanese-styled armor. Despite what its appearance may suggest, it has a light body that allows it to glide gracefully in mid-air, and it fights while parrying enemy attacks with its tough yet smooth armor. It does not cower before any enemy Digimon and excels at attacking with exceptional breakthrough ability, using its courage at parrying enemy attacks using its own body, and eyesight that allows it to detect enemy attacks right before they hit. It is hypothesized to be a "Prototype Digimon" due to the outdated Interface on its...

species.name: Giromon
species.profile: A Digimon who patrols within the Computer Network while floating lightly in the air. Also known as the "", it repels Digimon who try to enter the Network illegally. It is a truly frightening Digimon; the moment it judges someone to be an enemy, it will fend them off with all the attacks it is able to muster, and it is said that if it is driven into a predicament, it will completely annihilate the intruder by blowing itself up. Its Special Move is a super-powerful hand grenade (Deadly Bomb).

species.name: Gizamon
species.profile: An Aquatic Mammal Digimon with fins on its hands and feet to paddle through water. It is more suited for life in the water than on land, and although it swims about quickly in the water with its fins and sturdy hind legs, on the ground it moves about with weak, frog-like hops. When on land it has a very timid disposition, but when in the water it displays its natural, ferocious personality. Its Special Move is coming at the opponent with its sharp, blade-like dorsal fins (Spiral Edge).

species.name: Gizmon: AT
species.profile: A Digimon with no sense of self that was artificially remodeled to execute missions as ordered. Its Special Moves are "AT Laser", "AT Helix" and "AT Hacking", which are more powerful than all of Gizmon: PT's.
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "The Heartless Past Revealed! Gizmon: AT"

species.name: Gizmon: XT
species.profile: A Digimon with no sense of self that was artificially remodeled to execute missions as ordered. Its Special Moves are "XT Laser", "XT Helix" and "XT Hacking", which are more powerful than all of Gizmon: AT's.
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "Smash Kurata's Ambition, Yatagaramon takes Flight"

species.name: Gladimon
species.profile: A novice Warrior Digimon that is active on the front lines of the battlefield. It moves quickly due to having a small physique and being lightly equipped, and cuts its way into enemy lines as a scout. It also specializes in tactics where it creates formations in collaboration with its comrades, so its combat ability when in a platoon is high as well. It is said that only those who continue to win on the battlefield evolve into great warriors. Its Special Moves are performing a spinning slash with the rapiers in its hands (Wheel Rush), and mincing the enemy with its long arms as if it were...

species.name: Goatmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Hope". This Digimon, which has the appearance of a large black goat, has had the duty of guarding treasures and ruins since ancient times. It is programmed to capitalize on its special characteristics, erect powerful barriers, and protect important data. However, because it is a goat, it seems that some of them are troublesome in that they completely eat document data. The thief Digimon Harpymon is undoubtedly its natural enemy. Its Special Move is generating special ultrasonic waves from the bell hanging...

species.name: Goburimon
species.profile: A mischief-loving, impish Digimon with the appearance of a small oni. Cunning but lacking courage, it never acts alone; instead, it always attacks in groups while hiding in the shadows of trees or buildings. However, once outnumbered, they run away at full speed just like baby spiders dispersing. Whether to make up for it, its intelligence is a little higher than other Child Digimon. Its Special Move is throwing Mach speed fireballs at the enemy (Goburi Strike).

species.name: Gogmamon
species.profile: An Ore Digimon with an enormous body. It is said to have a small population at present, and mostly lives in solitude deep inside caves. It hardly ever eats in a conventional manner, instead building up energy by occasionally leaving the cave and taking in light through the crystals covering its body.It reliably eliminates intruders into the cave with its "Giant Grater", in which it grinds the enemy with the crystals on its arms, and its "Curse Reflection", where it fires the light energy it has accumulated from the tips of its crystals.

species.name: Gokimon
species.profile: Its black-lustered body is exactly like the very cockroach that everyone hates. It moves around stealthily and nimbly, and runs away even faster. Although you can hardly expect it to have offensive or defensive ability, it shines best when it comes to a protracted war due to its immeasurable stamina. Its Special Move is scattering trash (Dream Dust).

species.name: Gokuwmon
species.profile: Gokuwmon, who was born from within the boiling magma of Boot Volcano, extracted data from numerous databases to serve as models in its pursuit of strength, becoming a Combat Digimon that awakened to the combat instinct it was born with. Although it is journeying across the Digital World to challenge formidable enemies and satiate the craving engraved inside of its heart, if it encounters an opponent that it judges to be strong it will insolently request a battle, regardless of the situation. However, due to the "Sun Wukong" which was placed on Gokuwmon's head by Sanzomon when it was born,...

species.name: Gold Numemon
species.profile: A subspecies of Numemon whose whole body shines gold, it also specializes in aerial attacks as a result of gaining wings. It takes in gold data from mines in the Digital World, and has more defensive power than Numemon. One would have expected it to have grown fond of cleanliness with it shining gold, but its Special Move is continuously throwing gold poop (Gold-w=durian Rush). Also, in its "Gold Excrement", it throws gigantic poop.

species.name: Gold Numemon (Ultimate)
species.profile: A subspecies of Numemon, its whole body is gold. It was born from a Numemon that discovered the Goldine Mine and took in its elements.

species.name: Gold V-dramon
species.kanji: ゴールドブイドラモン

species.name: Golem Jiji Kamemon
species.kanji: ゴーレムジジカメモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Glorious DigiXros, Seize it! Our Future!!"

species.name: Golemon
species.profile: A Rock/Mineral Digimon that was discovered from the digital analysis of an ancient curse. Ancient, forbidden incantations spelling "plague", "curse", and "misfortune" are carved onto its back, and it seems those incantations protect it from the gas that it emits. About 90% of its body is composed of rock data, and it survives by fastening its arms and legs. It is an emotionless Digimon that will not take action without being ordered to.

species.name: Gomamon
species.profile: A Marine Beast Digimon that became able to move on land, and is covered in temperature-maintaining fur. The short, white fur that covers its body gets longer as it grows, and furthermore, it's said that it turns brown when it grows up. Its personality is a naughty-boy type that fiddles with everything it sees. The red fur growing along its back from the top of its head moves according to Gomamon's emotions, and when it gets angry the fur bristles. Gomamon's claws are strong enough to easily break through solid ice, so you'll have a painful experience if you take it lightly. Its Special Move...

species.name: Gomamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Marine Beast Digimon that became able to move on land, and is covered in temperature-maintaining fur. The short, white fur that covers its body gets longer as it grows, and furthermore, it's said that it turns brown when it grows up. Its personality is a naughty-boy type that fiddles with everything it sees. The red fur growing along its back from the top of its head moves according to Gomamon's emotions, and when it gets angry the fur bristles. Gomamon's claws are strong enough to easily break through solid ice, so you'll have a painful experience if you take it lightly. Its Special Move...

species.name: Gorimon
species.profile: A Power Digimon endowed with the arm strength to crush anything and the leg strength to crush things underfoot no matter how hard they are. However, it surprises the opponent with light movements that aren't expected from its physique, and seizes the opportunity to add to the attack with the on its right hand. It found its aesthetic in "Hit and Away". Its Special Move "Power Attack" is super-powerful.

species.name: Goromon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Titan of Dust Dim Card)

species.name: Gottsumon
species.profile: An Ore Digimon that is clad in ore data from the fields that has high defenses. With its mischievous and cheerful personality, it brings low generation Digimon along with it as if it were a ringleader, and is a live wire that jumps about in the system. It is sometimes a bit selfish, and once it is angered, it goes on a violent rampage like a volcanic eruption, becoming unstoppable. The ore data it expresses varies depending on the conditions and place of its origin, and it has the potential for various evolutions. Its Special Move is shooting super-hard ore from the top of its head (Angry...

species.name: Gottsumon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An Ore Digimon that is clad in ore data from fields, and has powerful defensive ability. With its mischievous and cheerful personality, it brings low generation Digimon along with it as if it were a bully, and is a live wire that jumps about in the system. It is sometimes a bit selfish, and once it is angered, it goes on a violent rampage like a volcanic eruption, becoming unstoppable. The ore data it expresses varies depending on the conditions and place of its origin, and it has the potential for various evolutions. Its Special Move is shooting super-hard ore from the top of its head...

species.name: Grademon
species.profile: A Warrior Digimon with a pair of swords that is called the "" due to the way it cuts into the vanguard with dauntless courage. When it uses its "" with its twin-sword style, a godly speed is brought to those sword techniques, but due to the cursed swords it becomes impossible for it to control itself, and it can't fight and still retain its sanity. Although its overall power is, after all, inferior, its sword techniques surpass even the Holy Knight Lord Knightmon, of the "Royal Knights", and it is said that its royal blue mantle is proof of the honor that was bestowed for its achievements...

species.name: Grademon (Vice)
species.profile: A corrupted form of Grademon, its entire body consumed by darkness. Its special moves are "Cross Blade", where it swiftly brandishes its dual swords to slash enemies before it into a cross in an instant, and "Grade Slash", where it strikes its dual blades down forcefully from midair onto the enemy's head, crushing them in a single blow.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Taiki and Kiriha VS the Bagra Army, A Complete Showdown!"

species.name: Gran Kuwagamon
species.profile: The ultimate form of Kuwagamon-species Digimon. It is an especially evil being among Insect Digimon, and if you happen to stumble across Gran Kuwagamon within the Digital World, you won't be able to do anything but curse yourself. Because it inhabits the depths of the Digital World's forests, and is only active at night, it is called the "". Also, its greatest rival is Herakle Kabuterimon, and the battle between these two continues without ever ending. Its Special Move is cutting through all of the surrounding space (Dimension Scissor).

species.name: Grand Dracumon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon that is considered the king of vampire Digimon. It has kept a castle in the Dark Area since ancient times, and it boasts of such power that even the Seven Great Demon Lords cannot interfere with it. It has a gentlemanly demeanor, and because of the "Charm" effect within the voice Grand Dracumon exudes, there have been anecdotes that it has led many of the Angel Digimon who have come to subdue it into falling down. It is told that it possesses an undying body, and although it is said that it is connected to the details of how the Dark Area came to be within the Digital...
species.debut: Bx-168 (Digitalize Booster Pack) or Digimon Accel Evil Genome

species.name: Grand Generamon
species.kanji: グランドジェネラモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Resurrect! The Appearance of All Seven Death Generals!!"

species.name: Grand Locomon
species.profile: An Ultimate Vehicle-species Digimon that evolved from Locomon. It broke through the limits on the speeds sought by Locomon, and so it rushes about within the Network at super-speeds. It has an extremely strong competitive spirit and the personality of reckless types, and since its power is also incomparable, those who suffer Grand Locomon's assault are smashed to smithereens. Although Locomon was not able to run when there wasn’t any rails, when Grand Locomon is in a place where there aren't any rails, it is able to just produce rails to run on itself. Its Special Move is crashing into the...
species.debut: Bo-682 (Booster 14) or Digimon Tamers: The Runaway Digimon Express

species.name: Grandis Kuwagamon
species.kanji: グランディスクワガーモン
species.profile: Only the strongest few among the evil Gran Kuwagamon, called the "", have evolved into it, and if you come across Grandis Kuwagamon, you can call yourself lucky to some extent. Its presence is concealed like dense fog, and it is the rarest species among Insect Digimon. It takes pride in being a Virus-species, and according to one theory, it is said to be a warrior in league with Black War Greymon, who preaches its own justice as a Virus-species. The "" on both of its arms are capable of damaging even the hardest of shells or metals, so it deepens the wounds and eventually brings down the...

species.name: Grandis Kuwagamon Honey Mode
species.kanji: グランディスクワガーモンハニーモード
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Power is Being Sucked Up! The Hunters of Honey Land"

species.name: Grappu Leomon
species.profile: A grappler Beast Man Digimon that took in the data of various fighting games, then formulated its own original secret techniques to crush the opponent. Although it rapidly spins the turbines on both of its arms and feet to unleash myriad techniques, the turbines rotate by blowing the fighting spirit emitted by its Digicore into them at one go, and they can't run on mediocre emotional strength. Grappu Leomon inherited the data of the "King of Beasts", Leomon, and so that strong will of justice rapidly spins the turbines to their extremes. Its Special Moves are rapidly spinning the turbines...

species.name: Gravimon
species.profile: The general of the Earth-god Army of the "Big Death-Stars". It is a tactician that has the ability to freely manipulate gravity, and with that ability it has the ingenuity to survey the entire situation and control the course of the battle at will. The beauty of its plots are even said to be "ingenuity, as if gushing forth", so it makes sport of the enemy army by weaving formulaic tactics together with creative schemes. God Beast Digimon account for the majority of its army, which has overwhelming strength in terms of military power. Because it enjoys stimulating tactics, it uses the...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "To a New World! The Fire Rage General's Dragon Land"

species.name: Gravimon Darkness Mode
species.kanji: グラビモンダークネスモード
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "X7 of Bonds! The Great Battle with Gravimon!!"

species.name: Great Gryzmon
species.profile: Calling itself the strongest martial artist in the Digital World, it is a Digimon whose motto is to "entertain spectators above all in battle". Its performance in combat captivates the surrounding Digimon watching on, livening up the battlefield. It is also a hard worker that always trains so that it can live up to its audience's expectations. In addition, a match against Pile Volcamon, who is considered to be its eternal rival, is a big event that draws in many spectators.Its Special Moves are tearing the enemy to pieces with its flaming claws (Tōkonsō), and igniting the poison mist it...

species.name: Grey Knightsmon
species.profile: The "", which added Metal Greymon's charging power to Dark Knightmon's superior combat techniques. If Grey Knightsmon appears on the battlefield, it will mow anyone down with its , no matter how sturdy their defensive formation is.Its Special Moves are charging the enemy, armed with the (Gigas Spiral), and incinerating them with a giant tornado of flames (Hell Incinerate). It has "Death Destroyer", in which it fires dark shots from its two cannons.

species.name: Greymon
species.profile: A Dinosaur Digimon whose cranial skin has hardened so that it is covered in a rhinoceros beetle-like shell. It is an extremely aggressive Digimon, with a body like a lethal weapon covered in sharp claws and gigantic horns. However, it is highly intelligent, and if you're able to tame it then there probably isn't any monster as strong. Its Special Move "Mega Flame" is spewing extremely high-temperature flames from its mouth and reducing everything to ashes.

species.name: Greymon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Dinosaur Digimon whose cranial skin has hardened so that it is covered in a rhinoceros beetle-like shell. It is an extremely aggressive Digimon, with a body like a lethal weapon covered in sharp claws and gigantic horns. However, it is highly intelligent, and if you're able to tame it then there probably isn't any monster as strong. Its Special Move "Mega Flame" is spewing extremely high-temperature flames from its mouth and reducing everything to ashes.As a Combat Species, Greymon, the most outstanding among Dinosaur Digimon, has become even more aggressive. Although it has a relatively...

species.name: Greymon (2010 Anime Version)
species.profile:
A Tyrannosaurus-type Dinosaur Digimon. As a Digimon specializing in offensive power, its combat instinct is extremely high, and its cruel, brutal nature is such that it will not stop battling until it annihilates the opponent, so ordinary Digimon cannot even approach it as they are repelled by the abnormal fighting spirit it exerts on its surroundings.
Its "Mega Flame" is a jet of flames that incinerates its surroundings, and its "Blaster Tail" allows it to strike enemies from any direction within 360° of itself. It possesses "Horn Strike", an effective assault technique for both approach...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xrosroad!! The Boys' Paths Cross"

species.name: Greymon (Blue)
species.profile: A Virus attribute Greymon with a bluish-black body. While it has been called a 'feral Greymon', befitting its more violent disposition, it is in no way a lone wolf and possesses enough intelligence to work together with its allies as a team. Its Special Move is a blast of high-temperature flames spewed from its mouth (Mega Flame).

species.name: Greymon + Skull Knightmon
species.debut: Spy Tour on Anime Production Studio!! ~Until "Digimon Xros Wars" is Made~ (Unreleased Digimon)

species.name: Griffomon
species.profile: A fusion Digimon which possesses the head, wings, and forelegs of a Bird Digimon, and the body of a Beast Digimon with a snake-like tail attached to it. Although it is able to fly about the skies with its wings, it is said that it usually inhabits desert regions and mountain caves. Also, Griffomon's offensive power is extremely great, and because it makes sport of enemies with its keen movements, it is extremely difficult to defeat Griffomon. To make the best use of those abilities, it serves as a guard defending against illegal penetrations of the Internet, and is used for the security of...

species.name: Grottemon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Earth which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. Various weapons and armor are brought to life from its large hands and thick fingers, and its craftsmanship is practical yet artistic. The that it wears and its main weapon, the , are both of the handmade Grotte-brand. It prefers to act alone since it hates being ordered about, however its artisan pride is such that once it recognizes someone's true merit, it will obediently abide them, and immerse itself in its own work. Although it's not very intelligent, its pride towards its work is...

species.name: Groundramon
species.profile: An Earth Dragon Digimon with giant arms on its back. The arms on its back are said to be wings that mutated, allowing it to more efficiently dig through the ground. It usually lurks within the tunnels it carved deep underground, and seldom comes to the surface. Also, as Groundramon tends to prefer to inhabit veins of the rare Huanglong Ore, it has been discovered that it is very likely to find the elements of Huanglong Ore comprising the scales covering its body. Its personality is extremely ferocious, and as most people lose their life when they encounter one, it is one Digimon for which...

species.name: Growmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Demon Dragon Digimon that is called the "". The childishness it had when it was Guilmon has vanished, and it evolved into a wilder, more brutal Digimon. Also, although it is a Virus Digimon, it may battle for justice depending on how it was raised by its Tamer, because it will be faithfully obedient. Growmon's roar has the power to shake the solid earth, and before battle it raises its voice to an offensive roar to intimidate the opponent. Its Signature Move is developing plasma along the blades on both of its elbows, then striking the opponent (Plasma Blade). Its Special Move is spewing...

species.name: Growmon (Orange)
species.profile: A Growmon that became an orange-colored Data-type. Compared to the Virus-type, its usual personality is calmer, but it will quickly become agitated if something occurs. Its Special Move is spewing out a powerful blaze with a roar (Exhaust Flame).

species.name: Gryzmon
species.profile: Contrary to its ferocious appearance, which its prominently massive body and potentially lethal fangs and claws contribute to, this Beast Digimon has the spirit of an honorable martial artist. In spite of its large body, it nimbly dodges the opponent's attacks or turns them aside, not needing to rely on its own attacks due to the exceptional grappling sense it possesses. Though Gryzmon never starts fights, the moment someone angers it, it will stand on its hind legs and knock them down with its heavyweight forelegs, "Bear claw (pastry)". Its power is such that it is able to inflict a mortal...

species.name: Guardromon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon that protects the Computer Network's defensive barrier. It was originally a Digimon that repelled anyone illegally entering the Network's defensive barrier alongside the "Net Keeper" Giromon. However, a malicious hacker who noticed its ironclad defensive ability infected Guardromon with a computer virus, and used it to protect themselves from the Vaccine justice group, the "Virus Busters". Basically, Guardromon only has program commands for "defending", so even if its position changes, it does not pose a huge problem for it as long as it can defend against intruders. Its...

species.name: Guardromon (Gold)
species.profile: A form that Guardromon defending Chrondigizoit mines transformed into in order to withstand repeated, relentless raids by illegal miners. Guardromon's armor is said to be the result of it taking in the Chrondigizoit dust data floating in the air. Its armor is more durable than that of a normal Guardromon, and its Special Move "Destruction Grenade" has also succeeded in slightly raising its output. But in exchange, its armor became heavier, causing its movements to be sluggish overall.

species.name: Guidemon
species.debut: Digimon Next: "Welcome to the Digimon Net Game!!"

species.name: Guilmon
species.profile: A Digimon whose appearance resembles a dinosaur that still retains its youth. Although it is still a Child, its potential as a "Combat Species"—something which all Digimon naturally possess—is very high, and beneath its surface lies the ferocious personality of a carnivorous beast. The mark depicted on its abdomen is called the "Digital Hazard", which is inscribed on those that have the potential to cause massive damage to computer data. However, as long as this ability is used peacefully, it is also possible for it to turn into a guardian of the Digital World. Its Signature Move is...

species.name: Guilmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Digimon which has an appearance like a dinosaur that still retains its youth. Although it is still a Child, its potential as a "Combat Species", something which all Digimon naturally possess, is very high, and it hides the ferocious personality of a carnivorous beast. The mark drawn on its abdomen is called the "Digital Hazard", which is inscribed on those that have the potential to cause massive damage to computer data. However, as long as this ability is used peacefully, it can probably become a being that protects the Digital World. Its Signature Move is destroying rocks with its...

species.name: Gulfmon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon of darkness that emerged from the depths of the Dark Area. This demon beast's towering size, supported by its four sturdy legs, is akin to that of a mountain, and its lower body houses a "Maw" large enough to swallow all. Not only that, it is said that the Maw's opening is connected to the depths of the Dark Area, and that those who are sucked in have their souls (Digicores) smashed to pieces and are no longer able to escape. Its power is mighty, and it is also said that it has the ability to destroy the world in seven days. Its Signature Move "Black Requiem" is a...
species.debut: Digimon Tamers: The Adventurers' Battle or St-403 (Ultimate Battle Deck 2)

species.name: Gulus Gammamon
species.profile: A ferocious Digimon that evolved when the evil heart hidden within Gammamon was unleashed. It rejects interference from those around it and is only interested in fighting, and once it catches an opponent that comes into sight, it will not stop attacking them until they breathe their last breath. It puts up ferocious battles where it attacks regardless of whether its limbs get broken.Its Special Moves are crushing the enemy with the flames of darkness it amasses in its hands (Dark w=49 Pales), and hurling those flames of darkness while maintaining their power (w=666 Desdemona). In addition,...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Gammamon Dim Card)

species.name: Gumdramon
species.profile: A Digimon which possesses a flexible that can extend anywhere. Its body is also very soft and elastic, and it moves around dynamically using its whole body like a spring. It is also able to fly at its running speed with its tiny wings. Its personality is very mischievous, so it's a showoff. In order to attract attention, it dives right in the middle of any kind of dangerous situation and rages around, not stopping until it stands out from everyone. Its potential is concealing its considerable, unfathomable power, but is inhibited by the "Sun Wukong" it wears on its tail. Its Special Moves...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Us, the Digimon Hunters!"

species.name: Gummymon
species.profile: A Digimon that grew up from Zerimon. As it inherited an exceedingly energetic personality from Zerimon, it is both cheerful and lively. Although it is growing, it's squishy because its body tissue is as unstable as usual, but just like Zerimon, parts of its horn have hardened and it intimidates the opponent with headbutts. Its greatest change from Zerimon is that it has a body and ear-like objects coming out of its head. Its Special Move is spewing out a lot of adhesive bubbles (Double Bobble).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Digimon Hurricane Touchdown!! Supreme Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

species.name: Gundramon
species.profile: A large Digimon with a massive quantity of firearms. Possessing outstanding firepower, Gundramon, Magna Kidmon and Beel Starmon are collectively known as the "Three Musketeers" by many Digimon. Furthermore, Gundramon is part of the Crack Team, and is positioned for use in combat just like Mugendramon. It is faster than Mugendramon, and has high maneuverability such that it instantly moves within firing range. The burning smell of cartridges permeates through the 100% full metal comprising its body, so it is a bitter, hard-boiled Digimon.Its Special Moves are picking off the enemy's vitals...

species.name: Gurimon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Gammamon Dim Card)

species.name: Gururumon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon that is very similar to Garurumon. As a fiendish Digimon that lives in the dark, it is a nuisance who causes trouble everywhere. Its Special Move is high-temperature flames spewed from its mouth (Chaos Fire).

species.name: Gusokumon
species.profile: A Crustacean Digimon that lurks at the bottom of the ocean, at a depth that light fails to reach. It is also known for being a long-lived Digimon, capable of long-term biological activity while consuming a miniscule amount of energy. Weak, injured Digimon that occasionally sink to the bottom of the ocean turn into its prey. It barely ever moves on its own accord.In addition to fighting back against intruders that draw near with the sharp "" on its forelimbs, when facing a large number of enemies, it defends itself by firing countless "", small fish-shaped biological weapons, from its back....

species.name: Gyukimon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon with an ox-like upper body and a spider lower body. With a brutal and insidious personality, it is a monster that chases after those who see it for days, and launches surprise attacks from behind every night. Despite its large build, it skillfully uses its spider legs to move quietly without making a sound. The bells hanging from the tips of its horns emit a sound only when it attacks, so those who have seen Gyukimon will constantly be frightened by the sound of the bells. The dissonance produced by the bells disrupts the opponent's senses, allowing Gyukimon to attack...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Ryudamon Dim Card)

species.name: Habakirimon
species.profile: A bizarre God Man Digimon with four arms. It is a being with godlike power that appears in folktales, passed down solely through oral tradition, within a certain school of swordsmanship in the Eastern Digital World. It is widely recognized that in ancient times, a Digimon—known as the "" in the Eastern Digital World—destroyed and recreated the world, but according to oral tradition, the had a trusted retainer, and it is said that Habakirimon was that retainer. Serving its master, Habakirimon is said to have been involved in the destruction of the world, making full use of its immense power....

species.name: Huckmon
species.profile: A Small Dragon Digimon that shines a cool white. Its unfettered and restraint-hating, adventure-loving way of life is likely due to Gankoomon's DNA. It faces the rigorous trials imposed by Gankoomon with an air of composure. It has a masterful sense of combat due to its lineage, and because of its training with its chaperones, the Sistermon sisters, it can more than hold its own in battle against its opponents even if they're a Perfect. It specializes in close combat that capitalizes on its keenness, cutting the opponent to pieces with its sturdy claws (Fif Slash), rotating its tail like a...

species.name: Hagurumon
species.profile: A mutant Machine Digimon shaped like a gear. There are countless gears built into its body, and the gears are constantly rotating. For that reason, if even a single gear is missing, all of the gears in its body stop rotating, and it becomes unable to maintain its vital functions. Hagurumon possesses the special ability to send a computer virus to its opponents in order to manipulate them at will, and that ability is exploited by fiendish Digimon. However, because Hagurumon itself doesn't have any sense of self, it doesn't even know it is being misused. Its Special Move is burying a black...

species.name: Hagurumon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A mutant Machine Digimon shaped like a gear. There are countless gears built into its body, and the gears are constantly rotating. For that reason, if even a single gear is missing, all of the gears in its body stop rotating, and it becomes unable to maintain its vital functions. Hagurumon possesses the special ability to send a computer virus to its opponents in order to manipulate them at will, and that ability is exploited by fiendish Digimon. However, because Hagurumon itself doesn't have any sense of self, it doesn't even know it is being misused. Its Special Move is burying a black...

species.name: Hangyomon
species.profile: An Aquatic Beast Man Digimon clothed in a wetsuit. It has a cheerful personality, and is always swimming around the "Net Ocean". Its specialty is moving underwater, and in battle it uses the high-speed, underwater mobility on its back and a fighting style that capitalizes on its speed. Its Special Move is stabbing the enemy with its cherished harpoon, "" (Strike Fishing).

species.name: Hanimon
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that primarily inhabits ruinous areas in the Eastern Digital World. Its appearance strongly resembles that of a haniwa, and its body is made of clay. It looks sturdy, but it is more brittle than what it is made out to be due to it being composed of clay data. Although it instantly forms cracks and becomes chipped, it can occasionally be seen meticulously repairing itself.Despite having an appearance where you cannot tell what it is thinking at first glance, its personality is gentle, and it is also friendly towards other species. However, it absolutely hates the hair on its...

species.name: Hanumon
species.profile: A legendary Beast Man Digimon covered in golden-colored body fur. Although there have been many sightings of it reported in the Central Asian area of the Network, evidence proving its existence has not been found as of yet. It is extremely rare, and is said to be treated as a phantom Digimon by a group of people due to its exceptional skill in repelling malicious computer viruses and similar entities. There have also been rumors of it circling the Network at high speed while riding atop something resembling a cloud or puff of smoke. Its Special Move is further hardening its metallic body...

species.name: Harpymon
species.profile:
An Armor-level Mythical Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Light". Possessing wing-arms and a female upper body, it is a thief Digimon that is called the "" from how it steals valuable data (treasure) from databases (ruins). It shows up like a gale, seizing treasure and attacking with its large talons. Although its power is lacking, the continuous attacks unleashed using its speed are terrifying. Its Special Move is manipulating the wind, generating a vacuum blade (Wind Seeker).
*Harpymon was adopted from a winning Digimon entry in the "Digimon Web Dot-art...

species.name: Hawkmon
species.profile: A very polite Bird Digimon that is always calm, cool, and collected. Similarly to V-mon, it is a descendant of a special species that flourished in ancient times, so it is able to borrow the power of the "Digimental" to pseudo-evolve to an Armor-level Digimon. Its Signature Move is violently pecking with its beak like a woodpecker (Beak Pecker). Its Special Move is using the feather ornament on its head like a boomerang (Feather Slash).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: "Digital Gate Open" or St-116 (Starter Ver. 3)

species.name: Heavy Leomon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon with the heaviest build, rare even among the various Leomon families. Its power is the greatest among Machine-types thanks to its charging power, so it is difficult to stop Heavy Leomon from charging head-on. The source of Heavy Leomon's charging power is its passionate fighting spirit, and its strength doubles the more its fighting spirit burns. In addition, unlike a weapon made solely for fighting, it has a kind heart in that it also carries out rescue operations, so if there is a Digimon that needs help, it will firstly rush over to them, and then remove any obstacles...

species.name: Heavy Metaldramon
species.kanji: ヘヴィーメタルドラモン

species.name: Helloogarmon
species.profile: A Digimon in a chaotic state, overflowing with an enormous amount of magical power, whose form was released through the Interface on its brow by the sinister magic data of the mythical warg, which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. That enormous amount of magical power is transformed into magical flames, which keep spewing forth endlessly. The ultra-high-temperature magical flames have consumed even Helloogarmon itself, so nearly its entire body has been replaced by those flames. It has also lost its sense of self, and its sole governing principle is to incinerate everything...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet BE (BEMemory Digimon Seekers Loogamon Dim)

species.name: Herakle Kabuterimon
species.kanji: ヘラクルカブテリモン
species.profile: An Ultimate Insect Digimon that evolved with the data of Kabuterimon- and Kuwagamon-species Digimon. It has a gigantic horn and scissors, and it can be said that its form perfectly compensates for the weaknesses of those two types of Digimon, which had opposing natures. Its body shines gold, and it has regained and strengthened the flying ability which Atlur Kabuterimon had lost, so it rushes about the Digital World at supersonic speed. Having now accomplished this Ultimate evolution, there are probably few beings who can rival Herakle Kabuterimon. Its Special Move is an enhanced version of...

species.name: Herakle Kabuterimon (X-Antibody)
species.kanji: ヘラクルカブテリモン（X抗体）

species.name: Herissmon
species.profile: It is brimming with curiosity and will lose sight of its surroundings once it finds something to fixate on, although it is also highly cautious and will make its hard, needle-like quills stand on end when it is afraid, curling up into a ball until no sign of danger remains. However, it gets very attached to those it has warmed up to, and will show them its favorite treasures that it keeps stashed in its fur. It seems to have a habit of going on guard whenever it spots a Tailmon, due to having been bullied several times in the past. Its Special Moves are attacking the opponent by shooting...

species.name: Hexeblaumon
species.profile: A legendary Magic Knight Digimon that only those who have mastered ice sorcery (a high-level programming language) are said to be able to evolve to. It protected other Digimon until the very end when the Digital World was visited by an ice age long ago, and was later rumored to have moved to another dimension, "Witchelny".It excels in the art of manipulating the cold, and creates various things with ice. It starts with weapons such as swords and hammers, and then other tools such as restraints that restrict the enemy's movements, and is also capable of erecting a barrier to defend itself...

species.name: Hi Andromon
species.profile: An Ultimate Cyborg Digimon that was perfected by improving the incomplete Andromon. The percentage of Chrome Digizoid parts which compose its body has increased, and it is impossible to miss the extent of its gains in offensive and defensive power from this, compared to Andromon. Additionally, while the Bio-Synapse circuits which govern its thinking were incomplete when it was an Andromon, by adding Chrome Digizoid parts to them, it has become self-aware and thus capable of executing its objectives. Because it is both a Vaccine-species and a Cyborg, its attacks against Virus-types are not...

species.name: Hi-Commandramon
species.profile: A heavy infantry Digimon from the mechanized "D-Brigade". It is said that many of those that have not been chosen in "Selection-D", a special selection test that screens through 100 Commandramon, evolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a "shield", defending Commandramon assault troops with its enormous build and protective shield. The surface of its skin has been modified with a special texture similar to Commandramon's, and has the function of displaying its surrounding colors in real-time. Its Special Moves are firing from its multi-grenade launcher (DCD Grenade), and...

species.name: Hi-Vision Monitamon
species.kanji: ハイビジョンモニタモン
species.profile: As the newest model of Monitamon, it outdoes Monitamon in fighting strength, analytic power, and intelligence-gathering ability, and is an Ace of Monitamon that displays unique abilities. Due to the fact that it always has a grasp on all of the latest information in the Digital World, as well as governing the legion of Monitamon to always lead them to triumph, it holds the alias of "", and the deep trust of the Monitamon. It performs detailed analysis of its collected information and transmits polished tactics to the Monitamon, but its sole flaw is that it sometimes gets too passionate and...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Dunce Monitamons, Keep at it!"

species.name: Hippogriffomon
species.profile: A mythical beast Digimon which has the appearance of a chimera. It is said it will become a Griffomon if it evolves, but the details are not clear. Its intelligence is not as high as Griffomon's, and since its being is closer to that of a beast, its personality is also ferocious. Its Special Move is spewing out an extremely high-temperature wind (Heat Wave).
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: Revival of the Ancient Digimon!!

species.name: Hisyaryumon
species.profile: A Beast Dragon Digimon clad in thick, shining scalemail and who soars the skies unbounded, taking this form when the fierce combat data of the "dragon" and "general" that lay slumbering in the depths of its Digicore was released by the Interface on its forehead. It has great mobility, allowing it control over nearly the entirety of the vast Net airspace. Its demeanor is usually sagacious and calm, akin to a god; however, the moment the crystal-like orbs it holds in both hands are scratched, its wrath will be incurred, turning it into a god of anger that will attack with all its might. Not...

species.name: Hiyarimon
species.profile: A Lesser Digimon that evolved from Yukimi Botamon. The fluffy cilia it once had are now gone, and instead the surface of its body is always covered with snow. It lives mostly in snowy mountains, and its body melts when exposed to sunlight, so it is active after sunset. It seems that the bigger the icicle is that hangs from the tip of its beak, the more energized it is.Its Signature Move is spewing cold breath (w=Diamond Dust).
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Blizzard Fang Dim Card)

species.name: Holsmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". The "Digimental of Love" has the attribute of "Wind", and those that don this Digimental soar through the sky by flapping their wings like a gust of wind running through the air. In aerial combat, its speed and all of its attacks are superior to enemy Digimon. Its Special Moves are unleashing a shock wave from its wings (Mach Impulse) and spinning its body to generate a gigantic tornado (Tempest Wing). Its Signature Move is a cursed beam, fired from a sharp glance of its eyes (w=Udjat Gaze).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: "Digital Gate Open" or St-123 (Starter Ver. 3)

species.name: Holy Angemon

species.profile: An Archangel Digimon with eight shining, silver wings. Holy Angemon's mission in the Digital World is to act as a law enforcement officer, and it has the duty of supervising and surveying the masses of Angel Digimon. Furthermore, while it usually takes the form of a priest and acts as the spokesperson for the essence of "Light", which tries to preserve the order of the Digital World, when the Digital World is shrouded by the essence of "Darkness", it changes into its to fight off evil. In its , it consigns the opponent to oblivion with the on its left arm and the holy sword Excalibur it...
