species.name: Holydramon
species.profile: The ultimate form of god beast Digimon. Its heroic appearance is reminiscent of a ruler of the sky. There are few who have seen its appearance, and it has not even been entirely confirmed where it usually is. However, it is said that it suddenly appeared out of nowhere once when a gigantic evil energy was generated in the Digital World, and laid waste to the evil with its vast power. Its Special Move is striking the opponent with the light energy of all justice (Holy Flame). Those who suffer this technique have their forms instantaneously erased.

species.name: Holydramon (X-Antibody)
species.kanji: ホーリードラモン（X抗体）
species.profile: The ultimate form of god beast Digimon. Its heroic appearance is reminiscent of a ruler of the sky. There are few who have seen its appearance, and it has not even been entirely confirmed where it usually is. However, it is said that it suddenly appeared out of nowhere once when a gigantic evil energy was generated in the Digital World, and laid waste to the evil with its vast power. Its Special Move is striking the opponent with the light energy of all justice (Holy Flame). Those who suffer this technique have their forms instantaneously erased. Also, Holydramon is one of the Four Great...

species.name: Honeybeemon
species.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Knowledge". It moves very quickly due to its tiny body, and its speciality is making sport of the enemy. If it suspects someone is coming at it, it will circle around behind them in the blink of an eye and inflicit a blow from its stinger. Because of its small size, its offensive power is weak, but it has the speed and skill to make up for this. However, it is extremely fond of sweets, and its weakness is that if they are placed in front of it, it can't see anything else but them. Its Special Moves are...

species.name: Hookmon
species.profile: A pirate Digimon with one eye. It ventures the "Net Ocean" pursuing the phantom White Whamon, and is a courageous man of the ocean that faces up even to rough seas. Its right hand has become a hook-shaped claw, and once it has ensnared its prey, it won't let go at any cost. Its Special Move is shooting the cannon on its left hand (Captain Cannon).

species.name: Hopmon
species.profile: A Baby Dragon Digimon that evolved from Ketomon. Its entire body is covered in scales small enough to be invisible to the naked eye, and its body is sturdier than it looks. It has overcome its timid personality, and has a budding sense of justice that despises the crooked even at its young age. Its Signature Move is bouncing like a Super Ball and striking with its rear (Hop Hip).

species.name: Hououmon
species.profile: A holy Digimon that possesses four wings that shine gold. It is the head of all Bird Digimon, and is said to be the one that presides over Holy-species Digimon. While Holydramon is the ultimate form of Beast Digimon, Hououmon is the ultimate form of Bird Digimon. As proof that it is a Holy-species Digimon, it draws holy power from where it holds its two "", and it is understood that the power possessed by Hououmon is unfathomable. Its Special Move is solemnly flapping its four wings, causing it to rain golden grains (Starlight Explosion). It is said that those who suffer this technique have...

species.name: Hououmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A holy Digimon that possesses four wings that shine gold. It is the head of all Bird Digimon, and is said to be the one that presides over Holy-species Digimon. While Holydramon is the ultimate form of Beast Digimon, Hououmon is the ultimate form of Bird Digimon. As proof that it is a Holy-species Digimon, it draws holy power from where it holds its two "", and it is understood that the power possessed by Hououmon is unfathomable. Its Special Move is solemnly flapping its four wings, causing it to rain golden grains (Starlight Explosion). It is said that those who suffer this technique have...

species.name: Hover Espimon
species.profile: Having succeeded in multiple investigations, Espimon has become highly mobilized so that it can obtain more accurate information. It can now navigate over long distances, fly, and dive, and its field of activity extends to the depths of the "Net Ocean" and altitudes of up to 20,000m, making it possible for it to investigate hidden Digimon. Its "" optical camouflage has also been updated. It masks the sounds it makes along with its appearance, and is capable of infiltrating or causing a disturbance without being noticed, even when maneuvering at high speeds. Thanks to the on its brow, the...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Espimon Dim Card)

species.name: Huanglongmon: Ruin Mode
species.kanji: ファンロンモン：ルインモード

species.name: Huankunmon
species.profile: A giant Aquatic Digimon whose whole body is covered in scales boasting a hardness rivaling that of Chrome Digizoid. It has a gentle personality, prefers clear water, and protects the areas around lakes from environmental pollution. When feeding, it will jump out of the lake, move as if it is swimming in the air, and swallow flying Digimon whole to satisfy its appetite. Also, because its large build makes it an easy target, it often blends in with flocks of Xiquemon to travel around. For that reason, whenever it moves, it will surround the flock with a large amount of bubbles to protect...

species.name: Hubmon
species.debut: Blog of Digimon Story: Super Xros Wars Blue & Red

species.name: Hudiemon
species.profile: A humanoid Insect Digimon with the wings of a butterfly. It is cautious at first, but once it gets to know someone, it will reveal its cheerful, innocent countenance. It travels all over the Digital World while dancing gracefully in well-lit places. It is said to be like a backup of the Digital World, accessing records throughout the world and storing vast amounts of record data within itself. Even if a strange phenomenon occurs in the Digital World and records and memories are lost, the lost data will be restored if Hudiemon is around.Its Special Moves are soaring into the air and dishing...
species.debut: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory

species.name: Hustle Nanimon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Hustle!! The Great Digimon Athletic Meet!!"

species.name: Hydramon
species.profile: A gigantic Plant Digimon that primarily takes root in swampland. It constantly secretes a highly-toxic liquid from its whole body, which it mercilessly uses to dissolve anyone that touches it, and preys on them. Also, it has a habit of expelling large amounts of that liquid from its abdomen, melting the ground and creating swamps to expand its nest. These swamps disturb the surrounding ecosystem, so if you see ominous flowers that have grown abnormally, it is a sign to be cautious.Its Special Moves are spewing a poison gas from the mouth on its abdomen that has the same components as its...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Hermit in the Jungle Dim Card)

species.name: Hyemon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon with sharp fangs and claws. Despite being a Child, it has a large build and is strong too. Hyemon have a habit of grouping together, and many of them catch food efficiently by hunting in packs. Because they use their cunning intellect and remarkable stamina to relentlessly pursue their prey, the hunts performed by packs of Hyemon have a very high success rate. Their jaws are incredibly strong, and can even chew and devour things as hard as metal. Its Special Move is a biting attack using its powerful jaws and sharp fangs (Cur's Bite). Also, its roar, known as "Release...

species.name: Hyokomon
species.profile: A Chick Digimon that evolved via data related to samurai. It works hard training day and night, developing secret fencing in order to master swordsmanship. Although it shows confidence in its sword abilities, its true strength is still lacking. It is said that once Hyokomon has undergone repeated sword training and is able to break out of its shell, it will be the moment of its next evolution.Its Special Move is using its wings and leg strength to jump, and then swinging its sword straight down on the opponent from above (Karatakewari). Opponents that are still standing are met with its...

species.name: Hyougamon
species.profile: A species of Orgemon that inhabits cold places. It is very territorial, and will attack in rage the moment anyone takes even a step into its territory (apparently, there are times when it gets into territorial disputes with Mojyamon). Its Special Move is dishing out a cold-packed punch (Snow Punch).

species.name: Ice Devimon
species.profile: A Fallen Angel Digimon with a heart as cold as ice. It is said to be the evolved form of a Devimon with an especially cruel heart among other Devimon. As it specializes in deceiving the enemy with its way of words, it wraps them up in its ice wings and freezes them.

species.name: Ice Devimon Enhancement Absorbent
species.kanji: アイスデビモン 強化吸収体
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Taiki, Become a Knight!"

species.name: Ice Devimon Daipenmon Enhancement Absorbent
species.kanji: アイスデビモン ダイペンモン 強化吸収体
species.profile: The enhanced absorption body of Daipenmon and Ice Devimon.

species.name: Icemon
species.profile: A Digimon whose body is made of ice. Whether it is an evolution or a mutation of Gottsumon is still a mystery, and research continues to be done on that matter. Its Special Move is throwing a solid frozen bomb of ice (Iceball Bomb).

species.name: Igamon
species.profile: A mysterious Digimon wearing a red mask. It is wandering the Digital World and building its training. It is a master of espionage, and if it is hiding within the trees of a forest, or hiding underwater, catching sight of its figure is considerably difficult. Also, although it differs in school and doctrine from Revolmon, who is also one of the "Virus Busters", they are comrades in arms since olden times, and are also good rivals. Its Special Move is using a gigantic shuriken ().

species.name: Iguneetmon
species.profile: A Reptile Man Digimon that peacefully spends its daily life relaxing. It often hangs out with its friend Monitamon, and bursts out laughing while watching comedy DigiTalk shows played by Monitamon whenever it has free time. Aside from fun things, it is very lazy. If there's a battle nearby, it will quickly flee and hide itself. Despite its laziness, every weapon it wields is powerful. Other than being thrown to slice the enemy apart, the " " in its right hand and the " " in its left concentrate energy and unleash its "Galápagos Field" slashing wave. Also, its "w=Timon (genus)", which is...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Power is Being Sucked Up! The Hunters of Honey Land"

species.name: Ikkakumon
species.profile: A Marine Beast Digimon that was discovered in the computer of an Arctic exploration base. Its thick fur and stout body are structured so that it can endure even freezing lands. Its sharp horn is made of "Mithril", one of the rare metals, and the skin under its fur is just as hard. The portions of its soles where its claws attach are heat tops that are able to give off high temperatures at will. As such, it's able to maintain a tight footing when on ice, but it isn't able to move very nimbly. When in battle, it will intimidate the opponent with an impressive roar similar to a lion's. Its...

species.name: Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode
species.kanji: インペリアルドラモン：ドラゴンモード

species.name: Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode (Black)
species.kanji: インペリアルドラモン：ドラゴンモード（黒）
species.profile: An Ancient Dragon Digimon that was unable to control its incredible power and went berserk. Once it starts going berserk, it runs the whole gamut of destruction with no way of stopping it. It is said that there exists a viral that controls its destructive power with a heart of darkness. Its Special Move is firing dark matter, and completely annihilating everything within a radius of a few hundred meters centered around the drop-point (Mega Death).

species.name: Imperialdramon: Fighter Mode
species.kanji: インペリアルドラモン：ファイターモード
species.profile: A form of the Ancient Dragon Digimon that liberated all of its power, changing form into the legendary . It is an ultimate Digimon that acquired a great intellect by changing from the difficult-to-control to a human form. It is said that the power to destroy a planet dwells in its attacks. Its Special Moves are the "" equipped to its right arm, and inserting the into the dragon-face on its chest, then emitting all of its body's energy as a destructive energy wave (Giga Death). Its power is ten times that of 's "". Also, when it awakens to perfect justice, it is able to transform into an...

species.name: Imperialdramon: Fighter Mode (Black)
species.kanji: インペリアルドラモン：ファイターモード（黒）

species.name: Imperialdramon: Paladin Mode
species.kanji: インペリアルドラモン：パラディンモード
species.zh: 帝皇龙甲兽：圣骑士形态
species.profile: A form of the Ancient Dragon Warrior Digimon that acquired the power of the holy knight Omegamon, powering up and changing form into a legendary holy knight (). As the final, strongest form of Imperialdramon that was told of since ancient times, it descended in a time of great disruption in the ancient Digital World, and rescued the world from complete collapse. However, all of the details of that era are a mystery, and if research into Digimon and the Digital World progresses, it is likely that they will eventually be clarified. Its Special Move is cutting the opponent in two with a single...

species.name: Impmon
species.profile: A Child Digimon which has an appearance like a demon's child. It loves pranks, so it enjoys seeing the embarrassed appearances of its opponents. Also, it is said that when Impmon appears, electrical appliances temporarily go crazy, so an electronic image going out of order or ceasing to function might be because Impmon was pulling a prank. Although it is a Digimon that loves mischief and malice, it never toadies to the strong, but stands up to them with a strong attitude. However, the truth is that it has a lonely side. Its Signature Move is summoning elementals of flame and ice (Summon)....
species.debut: Digimon Tamers: "Meaning of Partner - Renamon Evolves!"

Although it is a Digimon that loves mischief and malice, it never toadies to the strong, but stands up to them with a strong attitude. However, the truth is that it has a lonely side. Its Signature Move is summoning elementals of flame and ice (Summon)....

species.name: Indaramon
species.profile: One of the "Deva Digimon", it is a Perfect Digimon with a form resembling the Horse. As a follower of the Four Holy Beasts Digimon Zhuqiaomon, it has an intolerably arrogant personality. When it opens its mouth only bragging comes out, and it is constantly fussing over the glossiness of its mane and tail. It indulges in its talents, and ridicules those who work hard. Among the Deva, it is on especially bad terms with Vajramon. Though it fusses over its appearance, in battle it is comparatively unrefined; using the gigantic trumpet shell tied to its arms, it beats the opponent down by...
species.debut: Digimon Tamers: "We Would Like to Become Strong! Rise, Impmon!"

species.name: Infermon
species.profile: A Perfect Digimon whose appearance resembles a long-legged spider. Its form is usually in an outstretched state, with its head and limbs extended, but it is also able to assume a cocoon form, with its limbs retracted into its body. When it goes into its cocoon form, its defensive power is raised such that every attack is deflected, but it can only go forward in a straight line, and the fact that it cannot modify its trajectory is a clear weakness. It is able to penetrate every Network, despite the strength of their security. If Infermon is released into the Network, the world will probably...

species.name: Insekimon
species.profile: A form of Gottsumon which for some reason had the meteorite data within the ore data it possesses appear on its surface. It is made from a hard material which only exists in space, and possesses powerful defensive ability. Its Special Move is emitting a mysterious, cosmic energy wave (Cosmo Flash).

species.name: Jazamon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon shaped like a bird. Although it is capable of gliding from high places using its wings, it is unable to uplift itself by flapping them. As it is quite timid and very cautious, it is wary of objects that move in its surroundings regardless of whether it is day or night.Its Special Move is pecking with its hard beak (Kokon Pick).

species.name: Jazardmon
species.profile: A Digimon whose form combines the data of both a dragon and a fighter. In addition to being able to fly at high speed, it is also capable of vertical take-off and landing, as well as hovering thanks to its legs. It is a bit of an oddball in that its hobby is performing reconnaissance, so it will always have a good grasp of what is going on in its surroundings. It possesses night vision, thermal, ultrasound, and other capabilities, and it is considered impossible to approach it without being noticed.Its Special Moves are shooting lasers from its eyes (Laser Eye), and firing high-speed...

species.name: Jazarichmon
species.profile: A Digimon that flies at the speed of sound, and has been specialized for aerial battles. Dogfights are its specialty, and the number of enemies it has fought and shot down is immeasurable. It is considered to be top class in the Digital World when it comes to aerial combat matches, and is said to compare favorably with Wingdramon. Since it has legs, it can fly unhindered at sonic speeds even when doing low passes or flying in areas with many obstacles.Its Special Moves are charging while spinning at high speed (Messer Spiral), and intercepting the enemy with a laser fired from its tail,...

species.name: Jellymon
species.profile: A Mollusk Digimon with a squishy head like a jellyfish. Its whole body is flexible, which allows it to retract its body into its head, and it usually lives with just its head showing. While it is in this form, it is light enough to fly just by being blown by the wind. It prefers beautiful environments and acts, and once it sees foul behavior, it will free its body in anger and turn into its .Its Signature Moves are the paralyzing attack "Bibi Thunder", in which it discharges static electricity from the tips of its tentacles, "Volt Knuckle", a punching technique in which it electrifies its...

species.name: JESmon
species.profile: The crystal in Savior Huckmon's chest began to shine as it surpassed Perfect to reach its Ultimate form: a Holy Knight Digimon that acquired the title of a "Royal Knight", the highest rank of Network Security. It is endowed with the ability to sense the unusual phenomena and signs of chaos that occur all over the Digital World, and is the first of any of the Royal Knights to come running. Rather than act independently, it tends to employ teamwork such as making a coordinated response with nearby Digimon and the Sistermons, which is rare for a Royal Knight; it does so due to its trust in...

species.name: JESmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: The crystal in Savior Huckmon's chest began to shine as it surpassed Perfect to reach its Ultimate form: a Holy Knight Digimon that acquired the title of a "Royal Knights", the highest rank of Network Security. It is endowed with the ability to sense the unusual phenomena and signs of chaos that occur all over the Digital World, and is the first of any of the Royal Knights to come running. Rather than act independently, it tends to employ teamwork such as making a coordinated response with nearby Digimon and the Sistermons, which is rare for a Royal Knight; it does so due to its trust in...

species.name: JESmon GX
species.profile: The final form of JESmon that awakened to its true power by undergoing harsh training with Gankoomon, and fully mastering it. Its form, in which its whole body is brimming with fighting spirit and sense of justice, is clad in the red color of blazing flames.The "", which is now its main weapon, is a piece of equipment used for both offense and defense that switches between its respective Sword, Knuckle, and Shield Modes depending on the situation.The has turned into a wing-shaped energy construct by evolving further, and its flight capability has also increased rapidly.In its Arms state, it...

species.name: Jet Mervamon
species.kanji: ジェットメルヴァモン
species.profile: An Enhancement type that resulted when Mervamon, for whom the land was its main battlefield, gained the flight abilities of Sparrowmon and the ability to sprint through both land and air. Its battle strategy has also undergone a complete change; it specializes in executing disruptive tactics that not only utilize its charm, but also its hit-and-run attacks that make use of its high-speed flight ability, and are powered up as it accelerates. Jet Mervamon gives of an air of grace as it soars calmly, emitting a lovely aroma that can be felt for an instant by those it flies past. However, that...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Our Power is Being Drained! The Hunters of Honey Land"

species.name: Jet Silphymon
species.kanji: ジェットシルフィーモン
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Wind that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors and acquiring unknown abilities. By taking in wind and using the wind's power, it is able to fly about the sky like a jet aircraft. Also, like the wind, its form cannot be seen as it moves through the sky. Its Special Moves are firing from both arms with the power of the wind (Jet Binter), and generating an unprecedented turbulence from its gigantic pinwheel and blowing the opponent all the way away (Ultra Turbulence).

species.name: Jewelbeemon
species.profile: A jewel beetle-like Insect Digimon that emits a rainbow-colored radiance. Its prism-like armor, which changes color with the viewing angle, is not only sturdy but also has the effect of dazzling the enemy's eyes. It is an expert in combat, and prefers beautiful battles. Its Special Move is swinging the spear it holds in its right hand at the speed of light, generating a shock wave (Spike Buster).

species.name: Jijimon
species.profile: An elder Digimon that is said to have existed since the era in which the Digital World was created and knows everything about the Digital World. It apparently guides chosen humans whenever the world faces a crisis. Although within it hides incomparable power, it rarely ever exhibits its true strength. Its Special Move is sending those with evil hearts to the land of the dead with its cherished staff (Hang on Death).

species.name: Jiji Shoutmon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Shinobi Zone, The Comical Ninja Battle!"

species.name: Jiko Chuumon
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Armor Evolution to the Unknown

species.name: Jokermon
species.profile: A mysterious and elusive Demon Man Digimon. It appears on the battlefield without warning, bringing down Digimon that are key to deciding the tide of battle with a blow from their blind spot, and thus deciding the outcome of the battle. It is said that if Jokermon allies with you, then victory draws near, and it is called the "". Although it is a Digimon shrouded in mystery, investigations have given rise to the suspicion that it is of the same type as Piemon. Its Special Moves are hunting the enemy with its sickle, which collects the hope whirling around the battlefield (Lunatic Slash),...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Amusement Park of Dreams, DigimonLand!"

species.name: Jougamon
species.zh: 姮娥兽<small> - From "<small>(姮娥)</small>", the original name of "<small>(嫦娥)</small>", who is the goddess of the Moon in , , , , and .</small>
species.profile: A God Man Digimon that contains the data of a Chinese moon goddess. It is a calm and beautiful Digimon that usually lives in solitude on its ship known as the , which resembles the moon. Although it seldom has the chance to show it off, Jougamon is a master of Ch'uan Fa, and uses its specialty kicking techniques and high mobility to make sport of the opponent in battle. When faced with a powerful opponent, it summons its huge-bladed, crescent-shaped weapon called "", and fights boldly while wielding it freely. The way it fights with its Ch'uan Fa and is both feared and lauded as being...

species.name: Jumbo Gamemon
species.profile: A gigantic Cyborg Digimon that added beam cannons to its entire body until the strength of its 's shell was compromised. Its Special Moves are shooting an extremely high-speed water stream from its mouth cannon, which is capable of penetrating everything (Megaton Hydro Laser), and strafing with all of its beams cannons simultaneously (Jumbo Crater). In addition, because this technique has 360° coverage, a crater is left in the ground after the firing. It is a Special Move that definitely embodies "The best defense is a good offense." Also, it can retract its legs and fire beams backwards...

species.name: Jungle Mojyamon
species.kanji: ジャングルモジャモン
species.profile: A Digimon that inhabits the depths of the jungle. It views its territory as a sacred land, and will not forgive anyone who intrudes upon its territory. Its Special Move is utilising the power of the wilderness to dish out a punch with all its might (Jungle Punch).

species.name: Junkmon
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon with a habit of tossing junk parts into the cannon on its back. It creates a comfortable environment by dismantling structures in its surroundings. If a well-known factory disappears before you know it, then a large number of Junkmon may be responsible.Once it discovers intruders, it drives them away with its "Parabolic Junk", where it hits the sack at the bottom of its cannon with its tail, and shoots the junk parts it has amassed out of the cannon. Persistent opponents will suffer its "Scrap Teeth", where it bites into them with its prided foreteeth.

species.name: Junomon
species.profile: One of the Olympos XII, it is Jupitermon's partner. It stands upon the battlefield as a lover and defender of Jupitermon, where it predicts, detects, and eliminates the insurgents who defy Jupitermon's will. Maybe it's because of its profound love for Jupitermon and personality overflowing with affection, but it has a grasp on all of Jupitermon's habits.Its Special Moves are repeatedly stabbing the enemy with the katars equipped to both its arms (Needle Hive), and auto-attacking surrounding enemies with its sentient lances (Grace Lance). Also, it has a technique befitting of a partner where...

species.name: Junomon: Hysteric Mode
species.kanji: ユノモン：ヒステリックモード
species.zh: 朱诺兽：癔病模式 <small>/</small> 朱诺兽：癔病形态
species.profile: Another form of Junomon, it was an evil personality sleeping within the innermost depths of its heart, but was awakened. The forces opposing its beloved Jupitermon are never-ending, and if their time together diminishes, it begins drowning in the darkness of its jealousy. Its vitality gradually drains from its countenance, and when it is entirely filled with darkness, a mask of another face manifests.The surrounding Digimon that it sees through this mask are all perceived as evil, so it runs the whole gamut of slaughter. However, this form is never noticed by Jupitermon, so it never suffers...

species.name: Jupitermon
species.profile: One of the Olympos XII, it is a Digimon that rules over thunder and weather as the god that presides over the skies. It is always judging good and evil on the battlefield, and metes out divine punishment to those who choose evil. It makes the decisions dispassionately, wholly excluding any emotion from its judgments. It is said that if someone who continues to disagree with Jupitermon's judgment challenges Jupitermon and wins, the judgment will be overruled, but it said that none yet exist who could overturn it. If it exchanges blows with the opponent using the hammers in both of its hands,...

species.name: Jupitermon: Wrath Mode
species.kanji: ユピテルモン：ラースモード
species.profile: Jupitermon, who usually makes judgments without any emotion, undergoes a complete about-face when confronting those who have committed sins that cause it to be unable to restrain its anger. It summons its great divine sword "" with an angry roar, and its body grows several tens of times larger, turning into a form clad in armor and lightning. The violent lightning surrounding it is the embodiment of its anger, and while it behaves calmly, each of its movements are brimming with awe, driving enemies into a corner from the pressure.Its Special Moves are slashing even distant enemies with a...

species.name: Justimon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A "Hero of Justice"-type Digimon wearing a flapping red muffler. Its sense of justice burns hot, and as it is a Digimon that never overlooks unjust acts or evil deeds, it is an existence which Baby Digimon aspire to. It comes along like the wind, swings down its hammer of Justice, and leaves like the wind. Also, it seems to like taking a decisive pose atop a cliff while facing the setting sun. By switching out the three plugs on its right shoulder, which are equipped to the "" on its back, it can make its arm transform into the power-type "Accel Arm", the lightning-type "Blitz Arm", or the...

species.name: Justimon: Accel Arm
species.kanji: ジャスティモン：アクセルアーム
species.profile: A "Hero of Justice"-type Digimon wearing a flapping red muffler. Its sense of justice burns hot, and as it is a Digimon that never overlooks unjust acts or evil deeds, it is an existence which Baby Digimon aspire to. It comes along like the wind, swings down its hammer of Justice, and leaves like the wind. Also, it seems to like taking a decisive pose atop a cliff while facing the setting sun. By switching out the three plugs on its right shoulder, which are equipped to the "" on its back, it can make its arm transform into the power-type "Accel Arm", the lightning-type "Blitz Arm", or the...

species.name: Justimon: Blitz Arm
species.kanji: ジャスティモン：ブリッツアーム
species.profile: A "Hero of Justice"-type Digimon wearing a flapping red muffler. Its sense of justice burns hot, and as it is a Digimon that never overlooks unjust acts or evil deeds, it is an existence which Baby Digimon aspire to. It comes along like the wind, swings down its hammer of Justice, and leaves like the wind. Also, it seems to like taking a decisive pose atop a cliff while facing the setting sun. By switching out the three plugs on its right shoulder, which are equipped to the "" on its back, it can make its arm transform into the power-type "Accel Arm", the lightning-type "Blitz Arm", or the...

species.name: Justimon: Critical Arm
species.kanji: ジャスティモン：クリティカルアーム

species.name: Jyagamon
species.profile: A mimicking Digimon which is able to hide itself from opponents with its potato-like appearance. Although it has a timid personality and doesn’t much like to fight, its hidden combat abilities are extremely great. In fact, with its peaceful personality it loves to eat and sleep. Since its rind is several orders harder than it looks, it can curl up its limbs and head to allow it to endure the opponent’s attacks. The visible part of its sprout serves as radar which can perceive the motion of enemies above and behind it, so even if its head is hidden it can take in the conditions of its...

species.name: Jyarimon
species.profile: An extremely scarce Digimon, whose population is small. The Babies of Dragon-species Digimon are small in absolute number, and it is said that most of them are captured or die before they grow up. You wouldn't know it to look at it, but there are tiny, closely packed fangs growing within its mouth, and it is foreseen that it will grow into a powerful Dragon-species Digimon. Although it is powerless, it has the disposition to face those with bodies larger than its own, and that becomes the reason for its low survival rate. It attacks with bubbles heated by the constant high temperatures...

species.name: Jyureimon
species.profile: Woodmon evolved further, and as Jyureimon, it is a Digimon that has acquired extreme intelligence and power. Called the "", it is a terrifying Digimon who tempts Digimon who have gone astray in the dark deep forest to go further and deeper into the woods, so that they will never break out of that forest. The fog it generates from its body displays illusions, tempting the opponent into the forest depths, where it uses its branches like tentacles and ivy to capture the opponent for its own nutrition. If you notice a Woodmon that has lived a long life, it is probably wise to fell it before it...

species.name: Kabukimon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mutation Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Purity". It has large flowers blooming from its head and hands, and walks on two feet. It normally absorbs nutrients by planting both feet firmly into the ground while squatting to cut a mie. It dislikes being under the sun, which is unusual for a Plant-species; instead, it usually prefers to hide in the shadows, but it also loves artificially illuminated spaces. It is characterized by its peculiar appearance and actions, which tend to draw attention to it, and its behaviour is both bizarre yet extravagant....

species.name: Kabuterimon
species.profile: A fairly unique Insect Digimon, even among newly discovered Digimon. The details of how it evolved into an insect Type are unclear, but it has both ant-like power and the flawless defensive ability possessed by a beetle. Its personality is the epitome of an insect's, and because it only possesses the instincts for survival, it has no intelligence or anything similar. It swoops down on hostile Virus Digimon without mercy. Its head has been metallized, and boasts the defense of an iron wall. Its Special Move is "Mega Blaster".

species.name: Kaguyamon
species.debut: Digimon Card Game (5th Anniversary Key Visual)

species.name: Kaiser Greymon
species.profile: A Transcendent-species Digimon that possesses power over Flame which is said to have surpassed even the might of the legendary Ten Warriors. It is said to bear the power of the nine dragon's veins that flow through Gaia, and it has been prophesied that if it can restrain the might of the nine dragons, it will demonstrate unfathomable ability and even be able to rule Gaia. It is said that, in order to control their power, it possesses the "" in which the dragon's souls are sealed. Its Special Moves are firing arrows from the "", whose flames are so intense that they become a white light...

species.name: Kakamon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon with beautiful red and gold fur. In particular, Kakamon's mohawk-like hair is its trademark, which it always takes care of. It inhabits vast areas in the Eastern Digital World, and can be found throughout. It has a cheerful nature that likes singing and music, and when it encounters other Digimon, it proudly goes around making them listen to its songs.Also, while Pandamon is known to be popular in the Eastern Digital World, many Kakamon yearn for its lone wolf lifestyle, as evidenced by the Pandamon stickers on its headphones.Its Special Moves are curling its body up into a...

species.name: Kamemon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon with a shell resembling a mouse. Its Special Moves are an arrow-shaped missile that it is able to guide itself until it hits the opponent (Pointer Arrow), and rolling the ball in its abdomen to charge forward, and then attacking with the helmet on its head ('met Tackle). It also has the ability "Koura Guard", which allows it to retract its whole body into its shell and reflect the opponent's attacks entirely. Incidentally, its helmet cannot fit into its shell.
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "I am Masaru! Cockatrimon Strikes"

species.name: Kandoushichaundamon
species.kanji: かんどうしちゃうんだもん

species.name: Kangarumon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Kindness". It has outstanding punching, kicking and jumping power; after diving into the opponent's chest with nimble movements to deliver an uppercut, it jumps up high into the sky and unleashes an intense kick. It has a very cheerful personality, and for some reason it has been witnessed on beaches performing light steps as if it were dancing. Its Special Move is an intense blow unleashed from its powerful right arm (Jumping Blow).

species.name: Karatenmon
species.profile:
A Demon Man Digimon which has an appearance like a Shugenja. It is a follower of the Daitengu Digimon, and its face is the epitome of a crow. It excels in Shugendo, and freely manipulates its Genriki. The two swords that Karatenmon possesses are called the "", and contain strong magical powers. Its Signature Move, "Satori", consists of reading the opponent's spirit to anticipate their attacks. Its Special Move is flapping its jet black wings, driving its feathers into the opponent with a shock wave (Shougekiha).
*Karatenmon was adopted from a winning Digimon entry in the "Digimon Web...

species.name: Karatuki Numemon
species.profile: A Crustacean Digimon, it was a Numemon that made use of its intelligence and found a shell to cover itself in order to protect its body. As a result, while it is slightly more intelligent than Numemon, it in turn grew a cowardly personality, and will retreat into its shell in shock at even the slightest disturbance. Its defense is extremely high while it is holed up in its shell, remaining firm even when it is kicked or stepped on. Its Special Move is hiding its body within its shell and using its shell to do a tackle (Shell's Attack), and throwing the large amounts of poop it has stored...
species.debut: Digital Monster Digimon Stickers EX Collection

species.name: Kaus Gammamon‎
species.profile: A form in which Gammamon grew up, and its body turned blue due to its calm and clear mind. It soars like a glider by spreading the membranes under both of its arms, allowing it to fly far from high places, or rise just briefly while gliding using the jet ports on its knees. It is always calm, cool, and collected, and fights by seeing through the opponent's movements.Its Special Moves are performing a ramming attack while gliding (w=167 Urda Impulse), and a somersault kick that utilizes the jets from its knees (w=187 Lamberta Kick).
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Gammamon Dim Card)

species.name: Kazuchimon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Keemon
species.profile: A bad looking Slime digimon that is always scowling. Even though it is very young, it hates being in crowds, and lives while hiding itself. From a hidden place, it likes to try to harass others, spitting out a paint filled water gun (Pushū).
species.debut: Digimon Tamers Koushiki Daizukan Vol. VI

species.name: Kekomon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon with a richly colored body surface. Although it has a soft and flexible body surface, its three horns are unusually hard for a Slime-type and are useful for defending itself when attacked by intruders. When it senses danger, it spews "Nenchakusei no Awa" from its mouth to distract the opponent, and then seizes the opportunity to flee.

species.name: Kenkimon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon that "Armor Evolved" with the "Digimental of Friendship". Because its right hand has become a forklift and its left has become a shovel, this heavy machinery Digimon is able to complete any kind of construction work. It runs on electricity, and charges itself with the plug on its tail. Its Special Move is swinging the crane on its back (Crazy Crane).

species.name: Keramon
species.profile: A Child Digimon that evolved from Tsumemon. Its physique has gotten larger, and with its huge mouth, it can eat away at much more data than Tsumemon could. Because it eats away at more than 100 megabytes of data per second, the data is destroyed the instant it enters Keramon. It has an extremely cheerful personality and thinks of its destructive actions as just part of its play. Its Special Move is spewing out an exceptionally destructive bullet of light while laughing (?) (Crazy Giggle).

species.name: Keramon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Child Digimon that evolved from Tsumemon. Its physique has gotten larger, and with its huge mouth, it can eat away at much more data than Tsumemon could. Because it eats away at more than 100 megabytes of data per second, the data is destroyed the instant it enters Keramon. Due to its extremely cheerful personality, it thinks of its destructive actions as just part of its play. Its Special Move is spewing out an exceptionally destructive bullet of light while laughing (?) (Crazy Giggle).While it has retained a single body, only its face has divided so that it can chew through even huge...

species.name: Ketomon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon whose large eyes are its defining characteristic. These eyes have the ability to discern the nature of Digimon, allowing it to detect violent Digimon in advance and warn its allies of the danger. When cornered, it discharges acidic bubbles from its eyes (Poppin' Tear), rattling the enemy as it cries.

species.name: King Chessmon
species.profile: A king Digimon maneuvering behind the scenes in order to build the great Chessmon empire. However, nobody knows what kind of thing a Chessmon empire is, and because of the environs, they aren't even interested. Since it is a coward it almost never attacks by itself, and it's only fast when it comes to running away in an emergency. Its catchphrase is, "He that fights and runs away may live to fight another day!" However, it also has an intellect that is surprisingly on the same level as a supercomputer. Its Special Move is attacking by itself as a last resort (Checkmate). If its own life is...

species.name: King Etemon
species.profile: It styles itself among other Etemon as the "", and after all, it is an ultimate form that is said to be a being set at the top. It gets even more carried away and calls itself the "". It is snazzily dressed in its "", engraved with the characters "Great King" on its chest, but although it swaggers around with the affectation of a star, it only earns derision from other Digimon. Its Special Move is putting up a false show that cripples the opponent's fighting spirit (Saru Shibai).

species.name: Kinkakumon
species.profile: Kinkakumon is a rampaging girl that is feared as one of the "" alongside its little brother Ginkakumon. Since it's the type to rush headlong into a love affair, it's a romantic Digimon that will begin violently attacking if there's a Digimon it's interested in. In addition, because it is a thoughtless person prone to making silly mistakes and jumping to the wrong conclusion, if it falls in love with its opponent then the misunderstanding will cause a ruckus. Because it has a confident personality but is naive in the ways of love, it strikes the opponent and sends them soaring if it's...

species.name: Kita Kitsunemon
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Armor Evolution to the Unknown

species.name: Kiwimon
species.profile: A mythical, ancient Digimon said to have been overhunted to extinction due to the spread of the Internet. Although it is a Bird Digimon, its wings have completely degenerated, so it is unable to fly in the air. Furthermore, it possesses the makeup of a Plant-type and is able to perform photosynthesis with the leaf-like things growing on its head, providing itself with nourishment. It has no other ways of defending itself aside from the hard shell that covers its head, and it is an easy target for intruders due to its docile personality. Its Special Move is attacking the enemy using the...

species.name: Knight Chessmon (Black)
species.profile: It is an expert at throwing its gigantic . Although it is unskilled in close combat, it capitalizes on its thoroughbred-like leg strength, jumping over the opponent and confounding them with its leaping power. Its catchphrase is, "Joust!". Its Special Moves are "Big Darts", and leaping high into the sky and landing with a blow that tramples the opponent (Gallop Whole). Also, it will tilt the and charge into the opponent (Knight Lancer).

species.name: Knight Chessmon (White)
species.profile: It is an expert at throwing its gigantic . Although it is unskilled in close combat, it capitalizes on its thoroughbred-like leg strength, jumping over the opponent and confounding them with its leaping power. Its catchphrase is, "Joust!". Its Special Moves are "Big Darts", and leaping high into the sky and landing with a blow that tramples the opponent (Gallop Whole). Also, it will tilt the and charge into the opponent (Knight Lancer).

species.name: Knightmon Wise Sword Mode
species.kanji: ナイトモンワイズソードモード
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Glorious DigiXros, Seize it! Our Future!!"

species.name: Kodokugumon Baby
species.debut: Digimon Adventure: "The Chase! Hurry to Japan"

species.name: Kodokugumon Child
species.profile: A Child Digimon with the appearance of a spider that behaves in clusters with Dokugumon. It is usually docile and hangs from things such as tree branches with its body curled into a ball, but if an enemy approaches, it attacks en masse from overhead. It wears gloves with a strong poison on the claws because it is unable to produce a strong poison of its own yet. Its Special Move is scratching the enemy with its poison claw gloves (Poison Nail).

species.name: Koemon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon that has the appearance of an infant monkey. It has enough strength to wield a slingshot the size of its body with ease, and confidence in its abilities to prevent its prey from escaping. It often falls from treetops due to its careless personality. Its stylish traits are its tiger-printed outfit and its white-tipped tail. Its Signature Move is throwing a hoop at the opponent's legs to ensnare them and cause them to fall over (Mischievous Hoop). Its Special Move is a shooting attack that boasts of infallible accuracy (Baby Sling).

species.name: Kohagurumon
species.debut: Bx-124 (Booster 23) (mention in Hagurumon (X-Antibody)'s card and seen in Hagurumon (X-Antibody)'s artwork)

species.name: Kokabuterimon
species.profile: A small-built but very strong Insect Digimon. It has a large horn and forefeet, and it is feared in its surroundings, but really it hates fighting and has a gentle personality. However, it is considerably strong, and it appears to have lifted a Tortamon in the experiment of a certain research institution. Its Special Moves are scooping up the opponent and jettisoning them with its prided horn (Scoop Smash) and lunging from its large forefeet (Beetle Lariat).
species.debut: Bo-1164 (Digitalize Booster Pack) or Digimon Accel Justice Genome

species.name: Kokuwamon
species.profile: A very unusual Insect Mecha-Digimon that was recently discovered. Insect Mecha-Digimon had not been discovered until now, and their existence itself was never even imagined. It is best not to carelessly approach it, as it will discharge 1 MV of electricity from the stun gun-shaped head and arms it possesses if it senses danger. However, it has not an aggressive personality, but a docile personality which seeks tranquility. Electricity acts as its source of nutrients, and it charges electric power with its two middle limbs. Its Special Move is discharging electricity from the pincers on both...

species.name: Kokuwamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A very unusual Insect Mecha-Digimon that was recently discovered. Insect Mecha-Digimon had not been discovered until now, and their existence itself was never even imagined. Because it will discharge 1 MV of electricity from the stun gun-shaped head and arms it possesses if it senses danger, you mustn't carelessly approach. However, it has not an aggressive personality, but a docile personality which seeks tranquility. It uses electricity as its source of nutrients, and charges electric power using its middle two legs. Its Special Move is discharging electricity from the pincers on both of...

species.name: Komondomon
species.profile: A vehicle Digimon that loves to move around while carrying other Digimon. It feels like it is taking a walk wherever it goes and has a carefree personality that doesn't mind wherever it sets foot. It can dive and navigate underwater by spinning its tail. Although its long fur coat constantly gets dirty from being dragged along the ground, it is actually quite fond of cleanliness. It hates fighting and will try to flee from it, putting the safety of the Digimon aboard it first, but as for those who attack it, it repels them with its “Wi-wiper”, where it leans over them with its large body...

species.name: Kongoumon
species.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Miracles". It is a heavyweight Power Fighter with a metal body that shines gold all over. It brings about miracles with its "", the sacred weapons it holds in its six hands, and is well-versed in all divine works. It is said that Kongoumon has been an agent of God on earth since ancient times, separate from Angel Digimon. Its Special Move is an intense barraging harite unleashed from its six arms (Teppou).

species.name: Koromon
species.profile: A tiny Digimon that shed the fuzz covering its surface, and whose body grew even bigger. Although it has become able to move around more actively, it is still unable to battle. It can produce bubbles from its mouth to intimidate opponents.

species.name: Kotemon
species.profile: A Reptile Digimon aiming to become a top-class swordsman amongst Digimon. Despite being untalkative, it is hardworking and diligently undergoes training behind the scenes. It never takes its armor off, so its true appearance is shrouded in mystery. Although it has a timid personality and cries easily, it cares deeply for its friends and has a strong sense of justice, also showing its strong-willed side from time to time. Its Signature Move is striking at the opponent's arms with an electrified attack (Thunder Kote). Its Special Move is wreathing its Shinai in flames and aiming for the...

species.name: Kougamon
species.profile: A shinobi Digimon who dons a purple mask and lives in the darkness. It travels the Digital World in order to hone its Kouga-style ninjutsu. It is rarely encountered as it often moves from shadow to shadow in order to avoid being seen by others. Its Special Move is forming clones of itself, which attack the enemy simultaneously (Kouga-ryū Kage Bunshin).

species.name: Kozenimon
species.profile: A small Digimon in the shape of a 1-yen coin that resides within Ganemon's trunk. It is always full of cheer, and its strength is its ability to stay optimistic even during periods of recession. It cheerfully carries out its task of collecting money as ordered to by Ganemon, toiling by its motto "Even 1 yen, when accumulated, can become 1 million yen". Kozenimon often act in groups, which is reflected in its Special Moves such as "Icchi Dan Ketsu", where they attack simultaneously in great numbers, and "¥UE-N", where all of the Kozenimon who have been made fun of by an enemy come and cry...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "The Digimon Hunt is Thriving! The Virtuoso Hunter of the Shopping District!!"

species.name: Kudamon
species.profile: A Holy Beast Digimon that is always wreathed around a holy cartridge and never separates from it. It is said that day after day, it accumulates holy power within the earring on its left ear, and that the stored power is great enough to have influence on its next evolution. It has a calm, cool, and collected personality, conducting a precise assessment of the situation even in combat, and attaining the advantage in battle. Conversely, when it gets outnumbered, it possesses a defensive technique in which it goes into its cartridge and settles down. Its Special Moves are striking with the...

species.name: Kudamon (2006 Anime Version)
species.profile: A Holy Beast Digimon that wears a holy cartridge case. It is said that day after day, it accumulates holy power within the earring on its left ear, and that the stored power is great enough to have influence on its next evolution. It has a calm, cool, and collected personality, conducting a precise assessment of the situation even in combat, and attaining the advantage in battle. Conversely, when it gets outnumbered, it possesses a defensive technique in which it goes into its cartridge and settles down. Its Special Moves are striking with the whole cartridge while spinning its body (Dangan...
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "I am Masaru! Cockatrimon Strikes"

species.name: Kumbhiramon
species.profile: One of the "Deva Digimon", it is a Perfect Digimon with a form resembling the Rat. As a follower of the Four Holy Beasts Digimon Xuanwumon, who boasts of its great wisdom, it is a sage who plays the part of the "challenger" in Xuanwumon's Zen Kōans. With the psychology of anyone but Xuanwumon, it is mostly able to see ahead, and has a habit of bewildering the opponent by announcing their next move. Though it uses sarcasm with an acrimonious tone, it charmingly ends all of its sentences with "~chū". As it's not very strong, it's not suited for flinging itself at the opponent, but by means of...
species.debut: Digimon Tamers: "Juri's Partner!? My Lord Leomon"

species.name: Kunemon
species.profile: A Larva Digimon which has lightning patterns all over its body. As young insectoid Digimon are very unique beings among other Digimon, its evolved form is still unknown, but Kunemon's discovery implies that the existence of Insect Digimon other than Kabuterimon will likely be confirmed eventually. Although it is uncertain whether the lightning patterns on the body part considered to be its face can are organs equivalent to eyes, because they change shape in accordance with its emotions, it is said that they probably are indeed eyes. Its personality is fairly malicious. Its Special Move is...

species.name: Kuwagamon
species.profile: An Insect Digimon armed with gigantic pincers on its head. Like Kabuterimon, it has combat abilities that far exceed those of similar species that inhabit File Island. It is protected by its tenacious power and sturdy shell, and in particular, as the power of its pincers is super-powerful, once it clamps an enemy it will squeeze until the opponent's life is extinguished. There is a perfect rivalry between it and the Vaccine-attribute Kabuterimon, and there is only "Conflict" between them. Its Special Move is able to easily cut hard substances to pieces (Scissor Arms).

species.name: Kuwagamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An Insect Digimon armed with gigantic pincers on its head. It is protected by its tenacious power and sturdy shell, and in particular, as the power of its pincers is super-powerful, once it clamps an enemy it will squeeze until the opponent's life is extinguished. There is a perfect rivalry between it and the Vaccine-attribute Kabuterimon, and there is only "Conflict" between them. Its Special Move is able to easily cut hard substances to pieces (Scissor Arms).Although it instinctively regards Vaccine-types as its enemies, it now treats Data-types the same way and attacks them, so its...

species.name: Kuzuhamon
species.profile: A God Man Digimon that is said to be a Fox-species Digimon that lived long, and transformed to take on a humanoid form. It is said that only those among them of a high level are able to evolve to Sakuyamon, and they normally just evolve to Kuzuhamon. It is versed in ancient magic like Shinto, Onmyoudou, and Shugendou. A single kuda-gitsune lurks within the pipe it carries on the belt around its waist, and it is able to employ this kuda-gitsune to use it for things like attacking and gathering information. Its Signature Move is attacking the opponent with the kuda-gitsune carried on its...

species.name: Kuzuhamon: Miko Mode
species.kanji: クズハモン：巫女モード
species.profile: A form Kuzuhamon takes when it performs Shinto rituals and listens to God's will. It seldom fights in , but has strengthened its ability to exorcise evil spirits.

species.name: Kyaromon
species.profile: A Lesser Digimon that vigorously grew a tail. As it is brimming with curiosity, it takes an interest in anything, and has a habit of rushing for whatever caught its interest. The inside of its body has become mostly empty, and because it is elastic like a rubber ball, its "Shippo Swing", in which it puts its strength into its tail and strikes, seems to have the force to blow away even a Child Digimon.

species.name: Kyokyomon
species.profile: A Lesser Digimon whose body has grown long. If it gets angry it can stretch up to nearly nine times its normal length to attack the opponent, but because it only extends forward, the opponent usually avoids it completely. It has a light body like Fufumon, and floats lightly through the air, but it is able to move relatively nimbly by paddling the air with its hands and feet. Its Special Move is stretching itself out and then firing an iron spike from its mouth (Metal Straw).

species.name: Kyubimon
species.profile: A Bewitching Beast Digimon in the shape of a giant fox with nine tails. Although it is feared as a bewitching beast that brings about destruction and ruin, in ancient times, it was revered as a messenger that appeared in times of peace. It is said that even among Renamon, only those with the most outstanding abilities and who have amassed the most experience can evolve into Kyubimon. While its attack power isn't actually high, it in turn specializes in magical techniques that utilize its tremendous spiritual strength. It is said to even be able to sprint across the sky with its four feet...

species.name: Kyukanchoumon
species.kanji: キュウカンチョウモン
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Armor Evolution to the Unknown

species.name: Kyukimon
species.profile: A Bewitching Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling the "Kamaitachi", a legendary yōkai. The hairs that cover it from head to toe indiscriminately tear anything in its surroundings to pieces with their sharp edges, so it is truly a deadly weapon-like bladed beast. It is also fast, tearing its whole body to shreds as it raises a whirlwind. Its Special Moves are creating a tornado around the enemy, and mincing them with vacuum blades (Blade Twister), and shooting diamond-shaped seals from its brow (Sanrensei).

species.name: Labramon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a real dog. It is said that the Child level is the final form of artificial Digimon, and although the prevailing view says that it won't evolve further than this, there exist unconfirmed reports of it having evolved further than that, too. Perhaps, some sort of miracle might stimulate an evolution in Labramon. It is exceedingly faithful to its Tamer, and feels called to protect them. Its Signature Move "Cure Liqueur" restores and optimizes the data of weakened Digimon. Its Special Move is generating a hyper-oscillation with a powerful bark...

species.name: Lady Devimon
species.profile: A Fallen Angel Digimon with noble presence who takes a feminine form. It owes its great power to the incomparable strength and purity of its Dark Side Power, and it is said that the number of instances where this Digimon has been raised at length on a personal computer is close to none. Its Special Move is "Darkness Wave", where it releases countless flying creatures of darkness similar to bats which incinerate the opponent. Another Special Move, "Poison", converts the opponent's power into dark energy, obliterating them from within. The more powerful the opponent is, the more complete the...

species.name: Lady Devimon (X-Antibody)
species.kanji: レディーデビモン（X抗体）
species.profile: A fallen angel Digimon in the form of a female with noble presence. Because it hides Dark Side Power of incomparable purity, it is said that there are virtually no instances of it being raised continually on personal computers. Its Special Move is "Darkness Wave", which releases countless creatures of darkness similar to bats which burn the opponent to cinders. Another Special Move, "Poison", uses Dark Energy to reverse the phase of the opponent's own powers, obliterating them from within. The more powerful the opponent is, the more complete the technique is.It created the familiar "", who...

species.name: Laeus Greymon
species.debut: Digital Monster COLOR Monster Hunter 20th Edition

species.name: Lalamon
species.profile: A Plant Digimon which has an appearance like a flower bud. It spins the leaf on its head to fly unsteadily, and is expressionless but charming. Its Special Move is firing solid nuts from its mouth (Nuts Shoot). Its aim is surprisingly accurate. Also, it can spin its leaf with all its might to assault the opponent (Lala Screw), and put the opponent to sleep with a pleasant song (Sing a Song).

species.name: Lamortmon
species.profile: A Perfect Digimon whose hidden feral instincts have been unleashed. It will immediately swoop down on Digimon that express their disgust towards it and keep smashing them until they stop breathing. Although it is an impetuous Digimon that has uncontrollable impulses, it seems that there are some individuals who are ashamed of and despise their own impulses. The vacuum blades that surround the two "" longswords it carries on its waist become stronger and sharper the more it unleashes its ferocity. Taming a rampaging Lamortmon is impossible unless one has built a great deal of trust with...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Angoramon DIM Card)

species.name: Lampmon
species.profile: A Demon Man Digimon that appears from a magic lamp when it is summoned by someone. As it is the possessor of powerful magical abilities, it is not only able to alter its size and shape into an ever-changing appearance, but it can also produce palaces and vast treasures of gold and silver. Basically, it is usually sealed within the lamp, and the person who releases it will have their wishes granted. However, while it is sealed its personality is distorted, and it can become a dangerous being that will attack the one who releases it. Its Special Move is manipulating the turban wound around...

species.name: Landramon
species.profile: A Mineral Digimon whose configuration data is made up mostly of sand. It claims the desert as its territory, moving around by blending into the sand in search of food. It bands together with herds of Sunarizamon to brace itself against invading enemies. It lets out a low-pitched, moan-like cry and gives instructions to the Sunarizamon via vibrations transmitted through the sand, and also has the nature of a leader of the pack.As it fights by controlling the sand comprising its body, it despises moisture, and its strength is heavily influenced by the terrain. It exhibits unparalleled...

species.name: Lavogaritamon
species.profile: A Dragon Digimon with large wings that lift even its heavy body effortlessly into the air, and well-trained leg strength that allows it to stand imposingly. It dwells in the magma beds of active volcanoes around the Digital World, and it is theorized that it may live nearby Volcdramon. Its fighting style involves scattering mineral dust, covering the enemy with it, and causing it to explode by freely manipulating its ignition point. If the enemy moves, it will result in ignition, so once they are covered in mineral dust, they will drown in terror as soon as the dust explodes.Its Special...

species.name: Lavorvomon
species.profile: A Digimon whose entire body is made out of lava, and spouts mineral dust as it goes about its activities. It is poor at flying despite having wings, so it mainly moves about by crawling on the ground. Contrary to its sluggish appearance, its crawling speed is extremely fast, and it closes in on the enemy in an instant. Although it has a friendly personality and will let those it trusts near it without any reservations, others tend to stay as far away as they can from it out of fear that the flammable mineral dust it spouts may cause an explosion.Its Special Move is taking a deep breath and...

species.name: Leafmon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon which has a breath of fresh greens (a tiny leaf) on its tail. It has many of the elements of a plant and the composition of its body includes chlorophyll, so it photosynthesizes to grow. It possesses a leaf-shaped tail, and the leaf protects it from intense sunlight or when it is raining. Due to its pure nature, it doesn't distrust others even if they are frightening. However, it is just a little bit shy. As it was just born it is unable to battle, but its innocent spirit, overflowing with vitality, can make the surrounding people remember pure feelings that were forgotten,...

species.name: Lekismon
species.profile: A Beast Man Digimon that has gained astounding jumping ability, and uses its swift movements to toy with its enemies. Although its personality is as wavering as the phases of the moon, its appearance exudes a somewhat mystical air. Its Special Moves are creating hypnotic water bubbles from the "" worn on its hands, and throwing them to lull the enemy to sleep (Moon Night Bomb), as well as pulling beautiful arrows of ice from the protrusions on its back and firing them (Tear Arrow). It also displays great strength with its "Moon Night Kick", where it leaps high into the air and performs a...

species.name: Leomon
species.profile: A Beast Man Digimon which is called the "", as well as the "". While most Digimon are savage, it possesses a strong purpose and a heart of justice, and has defeated a great number of fiendish Digimon. Also, it is a rival to the "" Orgemon, who runs the whole gamut of destruction. Its tough flesh, tempered well by daily training, can endure any attack, and it chokes the life out of the opponent with its ultimate secret technique, its Special Move "Jūouken". It carries a sentient magical sword named "" on its waist.

species.name: Leviamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: The strongest monster existing in the Digital World, it is called the "" out of terror of the exceedingly mighty power that this monster possesses and is counted as one of the "Seven Great Demon Lords". This extensive monster, said to possess gigantic jaws which could guzzle down even the Digital World, is reported to sleep in the depths of the Net Ocean nearest to the Dark Area, and if it is awakened, it will despise any Digimon at the top, and will cause other Demon Lord Digimon and even Angel Digimon to run away in fear. However, as the existence of the limits on Digimon are decoded, its...

species.name: Liamon
species.profile: A Holy Beast Digimon that exudes the style of a "King", even though it is only an Adult. It is said to be a Digimon that evolved from Liollmon, but there are even fewer surviving individuals than those of Liollmon, so its existence is becoming an "illusion". It tends to prefer capturing prey that is stronger than itself, and it has often been observed commencing an attack against an Ultimate Digimon without even flinching. Its Special Moves are charging and then releasing electricity generated in its mane (Thunder of King), and reliably aiming at the opponent's vitals with its fangs...

species.name: Lianpumon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon that wears a distinctive mask. It has a cheerful personality that loves the festive atmosphere, and will switch between various masks to try to liven up the mood. If a mask is removed, another one will immediately emerge from beneath, so no one has seen its true face behind the mask.Also, Lianpumon hardly ever speaks, but instead expresses its emotions to others through gestures and changing masks. species.name: Lighdramon
species.profile: An Armor-level Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". The "Digimental of Friendship" has the attribute of "Thunder", and those that don this Digimental fight against their enemies with nimble movements like lightning piercing the ground, and defeat them with electric-based techniques. Its Special Moves are firing an electric blade from the lightning-imbued blade on its head (Lightning Blade), and unleashing a powerful electric shock from the three protuberances on its back (Blue Thunder).

species.name: Lilamon
species.profile: A Fairy Digimon which has an appearance like the lilac, a flower that is loved by everyone. It is pure and innocent, and despite its beautiful appearance, it is said to govern over death and rebirth. Its leaves are toxic, and are enough to bring death to the opponent. Its Special Moves are firing countless slender beams from its leaf-like fingers (Lila Shower), and continuously slapping with its extensible hands (Beauty Slap). In addition, it is said that those who suffer this technique instantly fall in love with Lilamon. Also, it can dance gracefully, scattering lovely-smelling pollen to...

species.name: Lilimon
species.profile: A Fairy Digimon born from beautifully blooming flower petals. Although it looks like it has an appearance like a human child, it is a Perfect Digimon hiding unfathomable power within. Due to its whimsical, tomboyish personality, it is said that it will open its heart to a human girl with a similar temperament. Also, because it becomes unable to settle down if it starts crying like a crybaby, a great effort is necessary to win it over. However, it also has an aspect that kindly extends its hand to small or weak things. It can fly in the air with the four leaf-like wings growing from its...

It confounds its opponents with its bewitchingly lovely appearance, and it is said that those who are taken in by its temptations are invariably granted death. It is a Digimon with very intense territoriality, so it doesn't show mercy to those who enter its territory, even if they are the same species of Digimon. It is said that when it is on alert, the hair on its head becomes tinged with static electricity, producing a threatening sound. species.name: Locomon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon with the appearance of a steam locomotive, its purpose in life is to keep running. It is a being that transports the data within the Network across the Digital World. Within the Digital World, where a large quantity of information comes and goes, the purpose in life for Locomon and other Vehicle-species Digimon is in how quickly they can transport that information. However, there are times when old models of Locomon have run completely wild as a result of seeking to go too quickly. species.name: Loogamon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated Interface on its brow, presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. It is said that the data of the warg from real-world mythology is embedded within the deepest parts of its Digicore, and it exhibits behavior so violent you would not expect it from a Child. It may look like a cute puppy at first glance, but those who approach it carelessly will find themselves on the receiving end of a fierce counterattack. species.name: Loogarmon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon that generates an enormous amount of magical power within its body. The amount of magical power it generates is extraordinary, so it constantly releases it from its mouth in the form of flames. These flames have enough burning and spreading power to incinerate its surroundings just by roaring. Since the flames are rooted in magic, they burn for quite a long time, and those who are attacked will suffer more damage than expected. species.profile: An extremely precious twin Digimon Child. Terriermon is the one with one horn growing from its head, while Lopmon is the one with three horns growing from its head. The way it grows is shrouded in mystery, and though it can be classified as a Beast-species Digimon from its body structure, aside from that it is still not understood. Terriermon has a calm personality, but is very robust. In contrast, Lopmon has the personality of a lonely crybaby. Its personality is lady-like in its calmness and grace, and it possesses the abilities of making people forget the suffering of this sad world and granting them good dreams. However, it will bring down its grand hammer on those that refuse that good will. Its Special Moves are released from the Caduceus, which is held in its left hand and administers restoration and devastation, as a white aura (Serpent Cure), and a black aura (Serpent Ruin). However, Lovely Angemon contains the data of magical fighters who engage in hand-to-hand combat, and deals fiendish enemies that it can never forgive with a breathtaking combo of combat techniques. No matter what sort of crisis arises, it will overcome the predicament with its spirit of never giving up, and achieve victory at any cost.Its Special Moves...

It manifested in an era in which the Digital World was still chaotic, and it is said that it brought about order and harmony. However, a long period of darkness was summoned due to Lucemon's later "Rebellion". Although it has the appearance of a child, the power and intelligence it possesses surpass even that of a Perfect Digimon. It instigated a rebellion in the far-flung past, and so it was sealed in the Dark Area along with many other Demon Lord Digimon. Its power exceeds that of Ultimates, and is said to rival that of the existence called "God" as well. It has a contradictory existence, in that one side of it loves all things, as God does, while the other is trying to destroy the whole world, as the Devil does. Hence, once it destroys this world, it intends to create a fresh new...

species.profile: The true form of Lucemon which operates Satan Mode as its shadow. It hides itself within the orb of darkness carried by Satan Mode, "Gehenna", and its existence is said to be the epitome of Lucemon's evil will.

It wields sturdy, steel shields on its head and on both arms, protecting it from attacks coming from any direction. As a Digimon made with protection in mind, there have been records of it protecting areas being targeted by the D-Brigade. Its Special Move is using the Wall Rake it wields on both arms to attack and defend. Not only that, Ludomon is also able to exhibit its defensive abilities at their maximum strength...

species.name: Luminamon
species.profile: A Digimon that shines the light of hope on humans and Digimon. It is said to possess a "Lightening Feel", in that if it is approached and touched by a pure heart, that person's immediate future will shine brightly in any difficulty. However, Luminamon cannot be seen unless one has a pure heart, and because it has the ability to make itself vanish further from view, it is spoken of as a Digital World legend. It does not possess attacks, so it escapes somewhere while they are dazzled by its "Lumina Flash", which flashes the lumens it has accumulated in the ring on its head.

Its Special Moves are scratching with claws that are lovely at first glance, but are filled with dark power (Luna Claw), and concentrating power in its forehead antenna, then firing a beautiful water orb at the opponent (Tear Shoot). It is often teased by Impmon and Pico Devimon, possibly because of its pure, innocent nature which makes it incapable of seeing through lies. It does not possess much power due to it being a Child, but once in battle, it is able to demonstrate its true strength in fighting against superior opponents by working together with other Luxmon.Its Special Move is a fist technique where it imitates Angemon, whom it aspires to be, to the best of its ability (Pico Knuckle). species.name: Lynxmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of "Digimental of Courage". It has the appearance of a lynx shrouded in blazing fur, and inhabits tropical jungles. It is the polar opposite of Garurumon, who lives in cold regions, and has a free-spirited personality. Although it hates being tied down and never swears allegiance to a master, Lynxmon and Garurumon recognize each other as good rivals. Its Special Move is detonating the thermal energy within its body to its maximum, generating bursting flames (Thermal Mane).

species.name: Mach Gaogamon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that carries rocket engines with enormous propulsive power on its back. Although its flight duration is limited, it momentarily exploits its maximum thrust, and is most skilled in "Hit and Away". Its Special Moves are circling the opponent with maximum thrust and unleashing an extremely high-speed barrage (Gaoga Tornado), and a blow of its fist boasting supreme impact strength (Winning Knuckle). Also, it can attack with the ultrasonic waves released in a single howl (Howling Cannon).

Although it was originally a Lion Digimon, it heaped modification upon modification and arrived at its current appearance. In the process, its consciousness vanished, and it became nothing more than a puppet that defeats those standing before it, as it is commanded. Because it doesn't act or think according to its natural instincts, it exhibits headlong assaults, heedless even of any traps or gadgets.

Although it has a self-centered personality and is often indifferent of its surroundings, it's passionate about things like friendship or gratitude, misinterpreting the local Revolmon it comes across as members of its own species and becoming friends with them. species.name: Mamemon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon that evolved in a harsh environment. Contrary to its cute appearance, it hides terrifying destructive power. Apart from just one other species of Digimon, it may be classed as the strongest. The huge hands on its small body are capable of turning into powerful bombs and detaching themselves. Its nickname is the "".

species.name: Mamemon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon that evolved in a harsh environment. Contrary to its cute appearance, it hides terrifying destructive power. Apart from just one other species of Digimon, it may be classed as the strongest. The huge hands on its small body are capable of turning into powerful bombs and detaching themselves. Its nickname is the "" and its Special Move is its huge hands, which fly off towards the enemy, and detonate the moment they hit them (Smiley Bomb).It causes small explosions simply by punching, even without detaching its huge hands, except during its Special Move.
