species.name: Paomon
species.profile: Paomon, unlike other Digimon that developed naturally, is an artificial Digimon that was created through human effort for the purposes of appreciation and rearing. Although there is no shortage of Digimon at the Child stage whose configuration program is remodeled through human effort, Digimon artificially created from the Baby stage are rare. According to one theory, it was developed jointly by research groups in Shanghai, Taiwan, and Okinawa, but its birthplace is not certain. It will sometimes spit highly acidic bubbles to intimidate the opponent.

species.name: Parallelmon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon that can freely travel back and forth between the Digital Worlds of other dimensions. It is a fiendish being that devours the data of Digimon in worlds it has crossed into, and its goal is unclear. As the world always falls into chaos whenever the elusive Parallelmon appears, research teams have identified its arrival as a disaster.Its Special Move is absorbing Digimon with a beam fired from its eye (Absorbent Bang). When something besides a Digimon gets hit directly by the beam, they are sent flying into another dimension. In addition, it has "Endless Trance", in which...
species.debut: Digimon Adventure V-Tamer 01: "Double Tamer!! The Great Super-dimensional Battle!!"

species.name: Parasaurmon
species.profile: A gentle Dinosaur Digimon that lives in a warm climate. The fruit-like organs around its long neck sprinkle a sweet scent into its surroundings. This scent has the role of informing the herd of their position, and it seems that the scent differs slightly depending on the individual.It is often attacked by other Digimon that are drawn in by its scent, but it deprives invading enemies of their freedom with the numbing gas "w=Palsy Sweet" that it spews out of its mouth. In battle, it emits its "Wavy w=Basso profondo", a super-low-pitched cry that crushes even rocks, at a loud volume, and...

species.name: Parasimon
species.profile: A special Digimon that can't survive without leeching off of other beings, even though it is an Ultimate. Parasimon is powerless when by itself, but when it gathers in numbers, it can easily defeat Adult-level Digimon. When Parasimon leeches off of another, it can draw out the host Digimon's abilities to their utmost limit, exhibiting a terrifying power. Also, it can amplify the host's desires, and it is capable of taking advantage of those weaknesses. The existence of Parasite Digimon types other than Parasimon has been confirmed, and the influence of Parasite Digimon, in addition to...
species.debut: Bo-681 (Booster 14) or Digimon Tamers: The Runaway Digimon Express

species.name: Parrotmon
species.profile: A Giant Bird Digimon shaped like a parrot. A strange, mysterious bird that wandered from another Digital World through a rift in space-time, the talons on its feet possess mighty power. As it is very highly intelligent and calm, it prefers not to battle, but once it is angered, it gets out of control. Its Signature Move is flying at the speed of sound, and mowing down the enemy with a shock wave (Sonic Destroyer). Its Special Move is generating electricity in the feathers growing on its head, and loosing thunderbolts on the enemy from above (w=Mjölnir Thunder).

species.name: Patamon
species.profile: A Mammal Digimon characterized by its large ears. It is able to fly through the air by using them as large wings, but because it only goes at a speed of 1 km/h, it is said that it is definitely faster walking. However, it's very popular because its appearance is cute when it is desperately flying (though it seems that it doesn't feel the same). Due to its extremely obedient personality, its trainers are well-defended. Also, even though Patamon doesn't wear a , it is able to exhibit its hidden holy power, and it appears to have inherited the genes of ancient Digimon. Its Special Moves are...

species.name: Pawn Chessmon (Black)
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that was born from data leaking out of a chess game supercomputer. Its power is weak, but it is promoted when it strives for prominence, and it is an ordinary pawn that conceals the mystery that it is said to possess Ultimate-class power. Its catchphrase is, "I only advance!" It considers its fellows who are striving for prominence ahead of it to be its rivals. Its Special Moves are stabbing with its spear (Pawn Spear), and charging with its buckler held up (Pawn Buckler). Also, when it procures rear support from its comrades, it can use a special formation that can halt...
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "I am Masaru! Cockatrimon Strikes"

species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that was born from data leaking out of a chess game supercomputer. Its power is weak, but it is promoted when it strives for prominence, and it is an ordinary pawn that conceals the mystery that it is said to possess Ultimate-class power. Its catchphrase is, "I only advance!" It considers its fellows who are striving for prominence ahead of it to be its rivals. Its Special Moves are stabbing with its spear (Pawn Spear), and charging with its buckler held up (Pawn Buckler). Also, when it procures rear support from its comrades, it can use a special formation that can halt...
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "I am Masaru! Cockatrimon Strikes"

species.name: Pawn Gaossmon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Glorious DigiXros, Seize it! Our Future!!"

species.name: Pawn Shoutmon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Shinobi Zone, The Comical Ninja Battle!"

species.name: Peckmon
species.profile: A Bird Digimon with powerful leg strength, such that it would be faster for it to run than to fly in the air. Its Special Moves are jumping high into the air, rapidly spinning its entire body and pulverizing the enemy with its gigantic claws (Spiral Claw), and firing the steel feathers it stores in the undersides of its wings (Kunaibane). Also, it specializes in a striking technique in which it pecks the enemy with its sharp beak like a woodpecker (Thousand Beak).

species.name: Pegasmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Holy Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Hope". The "Digimental of Hope" has the attribute of "Holy", and those that don this Digimental are able to obtain sacred power. Those that acquire this power are able to exhibit their absolute strength against evildoers. Its Signature Move is unleashing a powerful blow with its hind legs (Rodeo Gallop). Its Special Moves are firing a holy beam from its brow (w=Silver Blaze), and creating the void of space inside both of its wings, and sending out shooting stars (Shooting Star).
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: "Digimental Up" or St-127 (Starter Ver. 3)

species.name: Pegasmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An Armor-level Holy Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Hope". The "Digimental of Hope" has the attribute of "Holy", and those that don this Digimental are able to obtain sacred power. Those that acquire this power are able to exhibit their absolute strength against evildoers. Its Signature Move is unleashing a powerful blow with its hind legs (Rodeo Gallop). Its Special Moves are firing a holy beam from its brow (w=Silver Blaze), and creating the void of space inside both of its wings, and sending out shooting stars (Shooting Star).The armor it wears has been...

species.name: Penmon
species.profile: A Bird Digimon discovered within an Antarctic base's computer, it is similar to a penguin. Because it lives in an ice-covered region, it has a fault of being weak in the heat, but as it has an affable personality, it will follow after you with a waddling walk. Also, its wings have degenerated, and although it is unable to fly and its walking speed is slow, it is able to move with a speed of more than 60 kph by sliding across the ice on its belly. Also, in the water it is even able to swim using its small wings. Its Special Move "Mugen Binta" is a technique in which it approaches the...

species.name: Petaldramon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Wood which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. Countless buds sprouted from Arbormon's surface and grew suddenly, and it changed into a form resembling a giant lizard with plants over its surface. Although it's just like Arbormon in that you can't tell what it's thinking due to its lack of expression, it possesses a great appetite that is the exact opposite of Arbormon, who doesn't require food. When it opens its mouth, it sticks out its ivy-like tongue and swallows anything. Once it swallows its prey, the branches on its back grow and it...

species.name: Petermon
species.profile: A Digimon which has the appearance of a boy that dances freely in the sky. It tempts young and childish Digimon that refuse to evolve with, "Let's make a country just for children," calling them to the children's world of "Never-Ever Land" that it built. It's said to have a naive and innocent personality, but thanks to its purity there a brutality lurks within. In particular, although it calls it a "Pretend Punishment", it mercilessly beats Digimon who break their promises. With Petermon's first-class handling of its sword, it delicately manipulates the knife on its hip to punish the...

species.name: Peti Meramon
species.profile: A Digimon that evolved from Mokumon, its entire body is ablaze due to how fiercely its Digicore burns for a body of its size. It has a wild temperament for its small size, causing its Digicore to burn intensely, but it cannot fight properly despite its aggressive personality as its offensive power is still low. Not only that, it is extremely weak to water and Ice-Snow type Digimon, so it will flee the moment it encounters them. Incidentally, any relation between it and Meramon has not yet been made clear. It spits "Chīsana Kaendan" out from its mouth to attack the opponent, but they aren't...

species.name: Petit Mamon
species.profile: The Petit Mamon are Small Devil-type Virus monsters. They're siblings: the older sister who loves her younger brother, Pal; and Pul, the younger brother with a pure heart. They travel with Rei, who is held captive in Demon Castle, and begin to interact with humans.

species.name: Petitmon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon that possesses large horns and tiny wings. As its body is extremely light, it lives constantly floating through the air, and maintains its posture in the air by blowing air from its wings and mouth. Although it usually has a cheerful personality, if the three scales on its belly are touched, it goes into an extremely bad mood. When bodily harm draws near, it spits its "Atsui Toiki" to surprise the opponent, while simultaneously using it as propulsive force to quickly flee, so it's not easy to catch.

species.name: Phelesmon
species.profile: A Fallen Angel Digimon shaped like an aristocrat. In exchange for granting someone their desires, it is said that it will snatch away their soul. It is said that it is a Boogiemon that advanced and evolved, but the details are still uncertain. Its Signature Move is changing the opponent into a black stone statue (Black Statue). Its Special Move is driving the enemy to insanity with a curse-filled shout (Demon's Shout).

species.name: Piccolomon
species.profile: A Fairy Digimon that is fluent in magic. It can recite the advanced programming language of another dimension, allowing it to create miracles that seem like magic. This mysterious Digimon is able to pop up in any place, time, and space; despite its small size, it can seal away the enemy's abilities with its own special ability, and then pulverize the opponent with a mighty blow. With its mischief-loving personality, it enjoys making computers run wild with its cherished spear, "", that it always holds in its hands (although it has no ill intent). Its Special Move is a super-powerful bomb...

species.name: Pickmon
species.profile: Digimon which are enrolled in the "Starmons" corps, where they make up most of the members. The "Starmons" are composed of a corps of several Pickmon with a Starmon at their heart. There is a strict hierarchy to the corps, and disobedience is not allowed because they must have absolute obedience to their superior. For that reason, there are more than a few Pickmon who have given up midway on becoming a Starmon, then left and gone back home, but nevertheless, Pickmon that work hard, aim at independence, and stand out from the crowd will succeed in being promoted to Major and becoming a Starmon.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Taiki Goes to Another World!"

species.name: Pickmons Slingshot
species.kanji: ピックモンズパチンコ

species.name: Pico Devimon
species.profile: A tiny familiar Digimon which has the appearance of a bat. It exists to serve as a familiar for higher-class Digimon like Devimon and Vamdemon, but it is also said to be the one responsible for tempting Devimon, who was an angel-species Digimon, and luring it to the Dark Side. Although its offensive ability and the like are not strong, it is cunning and makes mischief all over. It prefers the dark, and is often with a higher-level Digimon at all times, so it seems that it is seldom observed on its own. Its Special Move is throwing a gigantic syringe at the opponent, draining their blood...

species.name: Pidmon
species.profile: An "Angel Digimon" with two wings, whose body is clad in shining white cloth. Although it is a being of perfected virtue like Angemon, its rank is below Angemon's. However, its power is on par with Angemon, and it is a being that destroys evil while wielding its . Its Special Moves are showering its feathers, which burst into holy flames, like meteors (Fire Feather), and charging at tremendous speed, and then unleashing an intense blow with the (Pid Speed).

species.name: Pile Volcamon
species.profile: One of the evolutions of Volcamon, of which there are said to be seven types. It possesses tremendous power and destructive force, and is well-versed in all sorts of combat techniques, starting with those from pro wrestling. As it evolved, its original massive body was polished even more, transforming it into a smart form suited for hand-to-hand combat. Its Special Moves are using the eruptive power of the volcanoes on its shoulders to slam the enemy into the ground head-first (Volcanic Driver), and the strongest fist that can pierce even Chrome Digizoid (Diamond Fist).

species.name: Pillomon
species.profile: A Digimon with the appearance of both a pillow and a sheep combined, it is always floating about while sleeping. Although one will fall into a pleasant sleep by snuggling up with Pillomon, the resulting dreams they see then will be fed on by Pillomon. There are two different types of bubbles that float alongside it as it sleeps; if it is sleeping well, anyone who touches the "Lullaby Bubble" that floats beside it will instantly be lulled into a pleasant slumber. If it is not sleeping well however, the "Akumu no Awa" that floats beside it attacks the spirit by inflicting hallucinations and...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "The Rare Card is Gone! Invincible Rook Chessmon"'s Eyecatch

species.name: Pinamon
species.profile: A Chick Digimon that always runs about restlessly. Because it expresses its emotions in how it runs, it doesn't stand still unless it is a time when it is bored or sleeping. Because its emotions do not appear on its face, its emotions must be read from how it runs, so it is a Digimon with which making a connection is very difficult. Although Pinamon hates its tails being touched, just like Puwamon, because a miniature electric shock, "Piripiri Spark", is generated from the tails, more caution is needed when touching its tails than with Puwamon.

species.name: Pinochimon
species.profile: Built from the body of a cursed Jyureimon, it is an Ultimate Puppet Digimon. It is thought that it was probably a single fiendish hacker that constructed Pinochimon from Jyureimon's data. It has an appearance like a marionette, but it can move under its own volition. Its personality is detestable, as it tells fibs, and when a computer presents false information, it is the work of Pinochimon. Its Special Move is packing gunpowder into its revolver-style hammer, then striking with its strongest technique (Bullet Hammer). If one suffers this attack, they will probably vanish without a trace,...

species.name: Pipimon
species.profile: A Baby Digimon that was born from the fruit of a tree. It is said to appear as a Partner before people who have lost and then regained their hope.

species.name: Pipismon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mutation Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". This bat-shaped Digimon is said to have been born from the monitoring data of an ultrasonic sensor made by a certain electrical equipment manufacturer. Its large ears are able to capture sounds of any frequency. Also, the inside of its mouth has the structure of a speaker, allowing it to copy any sound captured by it ears as it is and emit it back. It specializes in night operations, and is able to accurately detect the enemy's position by using ultrasound, even in the dark. If you hear strange...

species.name: Piranimon
species.profile: A ferocious Aquatic Digimon that acts in large schools. The exoskeleton covering its head amplifies the power of its jaws so that it can reliably bring down the enemy with its sharp fangs. That power is said to rival that of a Mammon stomping.After it pulls its target underwater using its "Cruel Invite", where it impales them with its caudal fin, which is sharpened like a fish hook, it punctures the body of its prey with "Calamity Vise", in which it rapidly oscillates as it gnaws through them, killing them. Since it attacks a single Digimon in schools, not a scrap of data is left behind...

species.name: Pistmon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Pitchmon
species.profile: A microbe-like Digimon which was discovered in the "Net Ocean", which had long been studied as the birthplace of life within the Digital World, it has the smallest size among the many Digimon. Since it seems to be living with nothing but emotions, its behavior changes very frequently. Since it is extremely full of curiosity, it greatly wishes to communicate with the outside world, but as yet, no means to do so has been found. However, it is a Digimon Baby that is loved by everyone, due to its big, bright red eyes which are charming enough to shake the opponent's feelings. It spits out...

species.name: Piyomon
species.profile: A Chick Digimon whose wings have developed to become like arms. It is able to dexterously operate its wings and use them to grip objects, but for that reason, it is poor at flying in the air. It usually lives on the ground, but when danger draws near it escapes by flying away. However, since its flying ability is on the same level as Patamon, it sees Patamon as its rival. Its dream is to someday become Birdramon, who can fly freely about the sky, and it seems it doesn't want to become Cockatrimon, who cannot fly at all. As its personality is to be brimming over with curiosity, it loves to...

species.name: Platinum Numemon
species.profile: An exceedingly rare Numemon that evolved by being among the first in the Digital World to discover the "Platina Mine", and absorbing the deposits found within. Since then, its personality has undergone a complete change, leading it to gather any and all jewellery it can find and using them to decorate itself, as if it had suddenly struck it rich. It is an extremely "gorgeous Digimon", regardless of its appearance. Its defense is fairly high thanks to its golden wings and the jewellery strengthening its body, but its offense is sub-par. Its Special Move is flinging the trash residue (poop)...

species.name: Platinum Scumon
species.profile: A po*p-shaped Digimon that shines like platinum. It is a species of Scumon that absorbed the data of minor metals, giving it a luxurious appearance, but its abilities are at the same level as Scumon's. It appears to not have powered-up in any significant way. Its Special Move is flinging metallic, shining po*p at the enemy (Rare Metal Unchi).

species.name: Plesiomon
species.profile: A previously imaginary Digimon discovered within the computer of a British cryptozoology research institute. It was a Digimon that had already been rumored among researchers. Although it rarely makes an appearance, it seems to show up when visibility is reduced due to being shrouded in fog. It is a mysterious being whose appearance gives the impression of being polished to shine white. It sings with a high-pitched, crystal-clear voice, wrapping the listener in sorrow and making them lose their fighting spirit (Sorrow Blue).

species.name: Plesiomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A previously imaginary Digimon discovered within the computer of a British cryptozoology research institute. It was a Digimon that had already been rumored among researchers. Although it rarely makes an appearance, it seems to show up when visibility is reduced due to being shrouded in fog. It is a mysterious being whose appearance gives the impression of being polished to shine white. It sings with a high-pitched, crystal-clear voice, wrapping the listener in sorrow and making them lose their fighting spirit (Sorrow Blue).According to the latest research analyzed from its high-pitched,...

species.name: Plotmon
species.profile: A Holy-species Digimon child characterized by its lop ears. Because it is still very young, it is unable to manifest its holy powers, and isn't even aware of its own mission. For that reason it is naturally insecure, so it can become either good or evil. However, the time will come someday when Plotmon, who was born as a Holy-species Digimon, will awaken to its mission as one of the "Virus Busters". Also, Plotmon is an experimental Digimon that was created by Digimon researchers, and because it was made to imitate the pets that live with humans, it has an appearance close to that of a real...
species.debut: Digimon Adventure: "The Bond of Destiny! Tailmon"

species.name: Plotmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Holy-species Digimon child characterized by its lop ears. Because it is still very young, it is unable to manifest its holy powers, and isn't even aware of its own mission. For that reason it is naturally insecure, so it can become either good or evil. However, the time will come someday when Plotmon, who was born as a Holy-species Digimon, will awaken to its mission as one of the "Virus Busters". Also, Plotmon is an experimental Digimon that was created by Digimon researchers, and because it was made to imitate the pets that live with humans, it has an appearance close to that of a real...

species.name: Plutomon
species.profile: A Digimon that attacks evil with terror and violence, and governs the realm of the dead. It wanders the world pursuing criminals or villains who deserve to fall into the realm of the dead, and it is said that if it detects prey, Plutomon appears wrapped up in a deep darkness. Plutomon, who finds joy only in chewing the wicked, has mouths lined with sharp fangs throughout its body, and the mouths make a chattering sound in want of prey. It is feared even by good Digimon for this oddity.The techniques which Plutomon possesses all conceal the brutality to cast the wicked to the realm of the...

species.name: Pokomon
species.profile: A nocturnal Baby Digimon that evolved from Relemon. Due to it only acting in the evening and on moonlit nights, it is said that its existence is close to an illusion. For that reason, it confers a kind of status among Tamers to raise a Pokomon. It will grow into an extremely heartening Digimon depending on how it was raised. It always acts to avoid public notice, and although it is difficult to capture Pokomon, who is swift and speedy despite its appearance, it will show up without thinking if you set out its favorite food of fried tofu. Its Special Move is changing into a stone that...

species.name: Polar Bearmon
species.debut: Digimon Liberator: "GODDESS FROM THE ICE AGE"

species.name: Pomumon
species.profile: Although it looks like a Bird-type, it is a Plant Digimon whose body is packed with juices with high sugar content like that of a fruit. For that reason, it has many natural predators such as Bird and Insect Digimon. Despite having wings, it is mainly active on land because its flight speed is so slow that it becomes defenseless.When it senses danger, it protects itself with "Rapid Seed", in which it spits out countless seed-like bullets from its mouth. Its "Fruits Rush", where it curls up and speeds off, is often used as a means of escape rather than an attack.

species.name: Ponchomon
species.profile: An Armor-level Ghost Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Purity". Although it is classified as a Ghost-type, it is an unusual Digimon that looks like a Plant-type, judging from its appearance, and it is rumored that when a Togemon has died due to unforeseen circumstances, it will become a Ponchomon. It is said to be a Digimon that was generated from a "Latin music distribution program" that exists on the Network. It looks as if it has a cheerful personality, but its facial expression can't be read, and it is eerie to other Digimon. Because all of its actions are...

species.name: Popomon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon that looks like a species of plant. It skillfully uses its tail, which looks like a leaf, and it moves by jumping little by little. Because it has a very timid personality, it will immediately flee if any strangers approach, but it is said that once it gives its trust to someone, it will be attached to them for life. While escaping the opponent it uses its "Hair Mist", scattering the hairs of its coat to create a distraction.

species.name: Poromon
species.profile: A Small Bird Digimon that evolved from Pururumon, and can now fly at low altitudes. It has small feathers growing closely packed on its body, and unusually for a Baby Digimon, it has wings. Its most charming feature is the feather ornament attached to its head, so it maintains it intently. It has a fundamentally tidy personality, but because it cannot turn its neck(?) even if it wants to groom itself, it relies on its comrades. Its Signature Move "Pororo Breeze" is flapping its wings to raise a cloud of sand, then seizing the opportunity to flee when the opponent flinches.

species.name: Potamon
species.profile: A gourmet Digimon that read data on all kinds of fries. As it walks about eating fries, it wants many Digimon to know how delicious they are, and goes around sharing fries that it recommends. It views those who criticize its fries as complainers, and bashes its "Shubashuba Potato", which sends razor-sharp fries flying, and its big, flat, piping hot "Bashed Potato" down from the sky, and lets those who have apologized to it enjoy the splendor of its fries. It is in a competitive relationship with Burgamon over who is better when it comes to fast food.

species.name: Poyomon
species.profile: With a translucent body, it is a Digimon Baby that drifts through the "Net Ocean" like a jellyfish. As it has the most primitive structure among the Digimon discovered to date, it has been showered in attention as the "Missing Link", the key to solving the mystery of the origin of Digimon, by the scholars and enthusiasts studying the roots of Digimon. In order to defend itself from intruders it spews potently acidic bubbles out of its mouth.

species.name: Prairiemon
species.profile: An Armor-level Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Kindness". It spends its time burrowing in dry land, and is able to dig underground at a speed of 100 km/h using the large claws on both of its arms. Observations show that it has a nature of moving in herds; although it rarely ever appears on the surface due to its timid personality, it has a habit of sunbathing in groups on fine days with calm weather, so Prairiemon researchers will probably need to read a weather map. When it is assaulted by the enemy and falls into a predicament, there are times when it...

species.name: Prince Mamemon
species.profile: Having taken in data on the Net concerning a royal family, it is a Prince of the Mamemon World. Partnering with King Etemon, it plays the part of a mock royal family of the Digital World, and that's why it looks so gorgeous.Although its personality isn't awful, it was incited by King Etemon and is convinced that it truly is a member of the royal family, and the embarrassing thing is that it considers even the "Royal Knights" to be its subordinates.Its Special Move is unleashing an intense headbutt without breaking its smile (Smiley Warhead). Despite its appearance, the part that it boasts...

species.name: Prince Mamemon (X-Antibody)
species.kanji: プリンスマメモン（X抗体）
species.profile: A Digimon that underwent a mutation after reading data on a royal family. The crown and mantle that it wears were reproduced from royal records, so they are very gorgeous. Because of its appearance, it is called the "". Its Special Move is headbutting the enemy without breaking its smile (Smiley Warhead).It was reproduced from royal records with greater emphasis in parts. Although there is a rumor that its long legs are the result of its , it is said that its very gorgeous and elegant "Delmo Walking" causes even enemy Digimon to make way for it.

species.name: Pristimon
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon with a body made from a soft fabric material. The texture of the surface of its body feels pleasant to the touch, and it has an appearance that makes it tempting to cuddle, partly due to its adorable look, but it has a violent nature, so it is dangerous to touch it carelessly. Its characteristic tail is equipped with an energy generator, which produces the energy it runs on by spinning four-stage generator coils. Its Special Move is shooting the energy produced by its generator at full power from the muzzles on its palms (Pri Shot). The clawed gauntlets on its arms are...

species.name: Proganomon
species.profile: A Mineral Digimon with a turtle-like appearance that primarily inhabits desert regions. It uses its drills and excavators to break through bedrock and move underground, but each time it does so, it triggers earthquakes, causing hollows in the ground and the ground to collapse. At night, it retracts its hind legs into its shell, and travels long distances by expelling the sand and gravel stored in its body in search of a safe place to sleep.Most of its shell, which makes up more than half the volume of its body, is comprised of mineral data, so whenever a Proganomon gets erased, only its...

species.name: Proto Gizmon
species.profile: A Digimon with no sense of self that was artificially remodeled to execute missions as ordered. Its Special Moves are firing a small laser from its red eye (PT Laser), and spinning and then tearing the enemy to pieces (PT Helix).
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "The DATS Team is Annihilated?! The Clash with Mercurymon"

species.name: Proximamon
species.profile: A mysterious Digimon that is said to govern over destruction and creation, and possess immense power. Since it is a Digimon whose "theoretical" manifestation was predicted in a simulation on a high-speed computing device, it is unknown whether it exists in the real Digital World. It has the ability to generate the opposing forces of holy energy and evil energy, and is said to be capable of disassembling every constituent substance in the Digital World with evil energy, and reconstructing the disassembled substances with holy energy to create new ones. Because it disassembles and recreates...

species.name: Psychemon
species.profile: A Digimon characterized by its perturbing, flashy colors. It is said to be a variant of Gabumon. Although it has a personality that is as bright and showy as the colors on its body, it apparently turns cowardly when its fur pelt is removed, just like Gabumon. Its Special Moves are concentrating colorful electrical energy in primary colors, and causing it to explode in range of the enemy (Colorful Spark), and accumulating that same colorful electrical energy in its horn and releasing it (Hadehade Horn). Also, its "Genshoku no Mai", which utilizes the primary colors on its body to perform a...

species.name: Pteranomon
species.profile: An Armor-level Pterosaur Digimon with wings of steel that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". Holding the alias of "", it can fly at the highest altitudes among aerial Digimon, and it is able to pinpoint bomb the enemy without revealing itself. It has excellent eyesight, and is capable of capturing the enemy's figure even from an altitude of 10 km up in the sky. Since its Special Move "Beak Pierce" is a technique in which it nosedives from high in the sky and pierces the enemy with the sharp tip of its beak, penetrating even armor, regardless of its thickness, and...

species.name: Pteranomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An Armor-level Pterosaur Digimon with wings of steel that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". Holding the alias of "", it can fly at the highest altitudes among aerial Digimon, and it is able to pinpoint bomb the enemy without revealing itself. It has excellent eyesight, and is capable of capturing the enemy's figure even from an altitude of 10 km up in the sky. Since its Special Move "Beak Pierce" is a technique in which it nosedives from high in the sky and pierces the enemy with the sharp tip of its beak, it penetrates even armor, regardless of its thickness, and...

species.name: Pteromon
species.profile: A Bird Dragon Digimon that flies about freely through the skies over vast forests. The horns on its head are soft, and serve more as sensory organs than they do for offense. It can acutely perceive changes in climate by reading the wind striking against its horns.It has a strong interest in other species, and often flies through the sky alongside them in attempt to make contact; this includes Child Digimon such as Piyomon and Falcomon, and occasionally larger Adult and Perfect Digimon. Also, it has the ability to instantly regrow its feathers to heal its wounds when injured.Its Special...

species.name: Publimon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon wearing a shell hood that loves observing other Digimon, and transmits the data it has compiled on them throughout the Digital World. Since the content is very trivial, it will occasionally report things regardless of whether it puts its life at risk, for example, clashing with Angel Digimon for taking an interest in the Three Archangels. Although it is supported by a large number of readers due to the content that it publishes, there are many readers who detest it. However, those who harm its readers will fall victim to its forced coverage of them vigorously.Its Special...

species.name: Pucchiemon
species.profile: An Armor-level Fairy Digimon which evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Kindness". Owning a whimsical personality, it loves to have its head stroked and to share secrets with others, and can be found singing songs when in a good mood. However, it hates having its tail touched, and it will fall into a foul mood and refuse to listen to you if you keep trying. Its power isn't strong, but it has the strange ability to becalm its opponents. Furthermore, Pucchiemon of a green color are known to exist, but their numbers are very low, so their presence is considered to be quite valuable....

species.name: Pucchiemon (Green)
species.profile: An Armor-level Fairy Digimon which evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Kindness". Owning a whimsical personality, it loves to have its head stroked and to share secrets with others, and can be found singing songs when in a good mood. However, it hates having its tail touched, and it will fall into a foul mood and refuse to listen to you if you keep trying. Its power isn't strong, but it has the strange ability to becalm its opponents. Furthermore, the number of individuals of this green species is very low, and their presence is considered valuable. Its Special Move releases a...

species.name: Pukamon
species.profile: Although its appearance gives the image of an aquatic dinosaur infant, this playful Digimon's clever movements are like those of a seahorse. However, the friendly personality it had as Pitchmon has totally vanished, and it quickly flees if others approach. Its outer skin cannot yet bear the water pressure and low temperature of the deep sea, so the duration it can spend submerged in deep waters is not long.

species.name: Pulsemon
species.profile: A Digimon that evolved under the influence of pulse waveform data stored in hospitals and gyms. It has a lively personality that treats anyone without discrimination. Pulsemon's characteristic hair is linked to its emotions, and droops whenever it feels down. It is a cunning fighter who battles by capitalizing on its natural agility, and moving around in the shape of a lightning bolt.Its Special Moves are ramming into the enemy with all its might at lightning speed (), and discharging electricity generated within its body from its hair ().In addition, many other Digimon like Pulsemon that...
species.debut: Digimon Project 2021: NEW DIGITAL MONSTER BEGINS

species.name: Pumpmon
species.profile: A plush toy Digimon with a pumpkin head. There's an urban legend that says Pumpmon came to be when mutations developed in a computer virus created during the season of the Western holiday of "Halloween". However, though it doesn't inflict any harm at all because it was not a malignant virus, its appearance belies the powerful offensive ability it holds. As is apparent from its blank look, poor expression of emotions is characteristic of Puppet Digimon. Its Special Move is manifesting a gigantic pumpkin in the air, then squashing the opponent with it (Trick or Treat).

species.name: Punimon
species.profile: A new kind of newborn Digimon. Its gelatinous red body is squishy, and there are three feeler-like things growing on its head. It is unable to battle, but it can produce resilient, acidic bubbles to intimidate its opponents.

species.name: Pupumon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon which has grown a body as light as a bubble, as well as very thin wings. Its somewhat largish eyes are very sensitive to an object's movement, and if something moves it notices it and immediately springs away, but this does not mean it's a coward, as if it continues to be unkind Pupumon counterattacks. If the opponent approaches, it spits "Doku no Awa" from its mouth to attack.

species.name: Puroromon
species.profile: A Larva Digimon which flies freely by individually operating its three pairs of wings. It is not yet powerful, but be that as it may, it is difficult to catch because of its random flying about, which surprisingly gets the opponent completely annoyed. Its Special Move is injecting a tiny quantity of venom with the tiny stinger on its rump (Chikkuritto).

species.name: Pururumon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon with a chubby body similar to silicone, it jiggles flabbily when it crawls forward. Both of its small fins are unexpectedly handy, but to be absolutely precise it is not yet able to fly. As it loves the smell of the sun, on days with good weather it lies sprawled on the lawn and smells the scent of grass with a sniff, immersing it in a good mood. If it gets in a pinch, it foams out acidic bubbles and covers the opponent in them, then seizes the opportunity to flee.

species.name: Pusumon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon whose entire body is covered in soft, cotton-like fur; only the yellow hairs sticking out of its forehead are fairly hard. It grows restless without its pacifier, and will cry loudly and incessantly if its pacifier is lost. It is able to expand its body by taking in a deep breath and shoot that inhaled air out together with its pacifier in order to intimidate the opponent.

species.name: Pusurimon
species.profile: A quadrupedal Lesser Digimon with yellow spines growing from its back. It is always running around energetically, though it will sometimes appear to stop in its tracks when in reality it has just fallen asleep on the spot. Its Signature Move is causing the fur covering its body to stand and harden, then curling itself into a ball and doing a jump-tackle while spinning (Chikuchiku Rolling).

species.name: Puttimon
species.profile: It is a sacred Digimon Baby who is the template for all Angel-type Digimon. On the other hand, it has poor self-judgment between good and evil, and can be quite adorably mischievous. If anything, it's popular for bringing about euphoria, good fortune, and such. Though as a newborn it's rare for it to do so, it can fly skillfully about the sky with the two wings growing from its back. When it flies about in the sky, it is able to place its opponent in a happy mood with a mysterious powder called "Angel Dust".

species.name: Puwamon
species.profile: A Chick Digimon covered in soft feathers. Its eyesight is extremely great, and because it is able to survey a vast range, it can react instantly to surrounding movements. Its personality is intensely curious, and it began gaining popularity because it lacks shyness and easily makes attachments. However, it extremely dislikes when its tail is touched, and so if its tail is touched carelessly, caution will be necessary, since it will shower you down in blinding feathers (Fuwā Feather).

species.name: Puyomon
species.profile: A soft and sticky Slime Digimon that was discovered in the "Net Ocean". Its single, lens-like eye lacks emotional expression, so you can't tell what it's thinking, but it drifts through the sky or the sea, trying to stick to objects and other Digimon with its tentacles. Once it sticks onto something, it will emit tingling static electricity (Pachipachi Gas), but this seems to be a form of communication unique to Puyomon rather than an attack. When multiple Puyomon stick to each other, their "Pachipachi Gas" becomes more powerful, making it difficult to approach the surrounding area.
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Jellymon Dim Card)

species.name: Puyoyomon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Jellymon Dim Card)

species.name: Pyocomon
species.profile: A Bulb-type Lesser Digimon with a large flower blooming from its head. It is able to move by skilfully manoeuvring its root-like tentacles, and it can even float upwards into the air, albeit only to a small height. It is brimming with curiosity, and its restless movements make it look downright adorable. It has a habit of living together in flocks, and they may number from a few to even a few hundred depending on the flock.
species.debut: Digimon Adventure: "Adrift? The Island of Adventure!"

species.name: Pyonmon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Angoramon Dim Card)

species.name: Pyontomon
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 20th Anniversary Memorial Story Project (Unreleased Digimon)

species.name: Pyramidimon
species.profile: A Digimon with an enormous figure that some Digimon evolve into by taking in data from ancient ruins scattered throughout the Digital World. Its body is comprised of sand data, and because it is constantly surrounded by a sandstorm, it keeps ordinary Digimon at bay.As a result of absorbing ruins and the ancient data stored within them, it possesses extremely high intelligence and the power to hold its own, even when facing large armies. Since it consumes a lot of energy when active, it often sleeps camouflaging itself as a pyramid.Even if it suffers heavy damage, it can instantly regenerate...

species.name: Quantumon
species.profile: An Ultimate Digimon enshrined in the aerial city of "Larc", which floats above the vast "Net Ocean", shrouded by enormous clouds. Quantumon extracts huge amounts of data from the Net Ocean using the expansion devices installed on Larc, and runs millions upon trillions of simulations of the future. Together with its Digimon followers, Quantumon implements the best measures it has formulated against disasters that are predicted to occur in the Digital World.Its Special Move is transforming space into a gate via quantum processing, and forcefully sending the enemy into another dimension...
species.debut: Digimon Ghost Game: "The Black Dragon of Destruction"

species.name: Quartzmon
species.profile: A colossal Digimon that keeps absorbing data to amplify its power. The , which makes up most of its body, is a fusion reactor that generates "", Quartzmon's power source, from the data it has absorbed. Quartzmon's true form is situated at the very top, and can act independently of the , and furthermore, it is also capable of altering its appearance. It hungers for the data of the entire world, and will swallow even Digimon whole and absorb them. Its Special Move is emitting the generated within the into its entire surroundings (Gypt Ryūshi Hou), and if you touch them even the slightest bit,...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "A Golden Bug! The Mystery of Metallife Kuwagamon"

species.name: Queen Chessmon
species.profile: The strongest Digimon of the Chessmon series which possesses extreme range and offensive ability. It is a reliable being that defends the cowardly King Chessmon. That superior offensive ability is a power that sometimes seems rather inhuman. Its catchphrase is, "God of Chess, bestow pardon!" Its Special Moves are impaling the opponent's vitals with the swords on its armor (Heart Breaker), "Queen Stamp", and "Queen Stick". Also, it can give the opponent a hard time with its "Hime no Wagamama".

species.name: Rafflesimon
species.profile: An Ultimate-level Fairy Digimon said to be the largest flower in the Digital World. While its appearance is so beautiful that it enraptures all who lay eyes upon it, the stench it emits is out of this world. There are a number of people who fell for Rafflesimon's beauty at first sight and sought to find it again after a single glance. However, Rafflesimon's lifespan is short, and its life processes will cease after just several days have passed. Because of the extremely low likelihood of being able to catch sight of a Rafflesimon, it is also known as the "". Despite its circumstances,...

species.name: Raguelmon
species.profile: An Ultimate level Digimon who observes all Angel Digimon with eyes of distrust, in order to prevent the fall of other Angel Digimon. The moment it detects an Angel Digimon that has begun to fall, it will attack and destroy them before they would have fallen completely. However, because it was shunned for its role as an observer, it began to be filled with nihilistic thoughts until its sole line of thought was to reject everything. At that stage, it no longer discerns between friend and foe, turning into a fearsome Digimon that carries out destruction indiscriminately.Its Special Move is...

species.name: Raidenmon
species.profile: A heavyweight-class Machine type Digimon equipped with electromagnetic weapons. It was created as a shooting-type, unlike Raijinmon, who similarly uses lightning as its energy. Although it is not as adept in close combat, it defends itself using its thick armor, and counterattacks with its left arm. Its Special Moves are causing a corona discharge brought upon by a 45000-volt electric attack (w=Kirlian photography Brand), and firing ultra-high temperature spheres from the gun barrels on both of its shoulders (Rising Sun).

species.name: Raihimon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Darkness that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors and acquiring unknown abilities. There are none who have seen this hero, and due to the fact that it doesn't leave behind so much as evidence of the opponents it has confronted, it is called the "". Its Special Moves are disabling all of the laws of physics in the surrounding region and bringing down the opponent (Schwarz Lehrsatz), and an attack fired from the eyes of the lion on its head (Rot Kreuz).

species.name: Raiji Ludomon
species.profile: The evolved form of Tia Ludomon, it has been further mechanised and attained the ability to fly. By sacrificing its agility, it gained durability that allows it to withstand even an attack from an Ultimate level head-on. The shields attached to its shoulders and arms automatically put up an electric barrier which cannot be seen, causing enemies to be confused as to why their attacks are not working. Not only that, it is also able to increase the area covered by its barrier in exchange for being unable to move, allowing it to protect entire regions to a certain extent.Its Special Moves are...

species.name: Raijinmon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon bestowed with the name of the Raijin of Oriental folklore. A fighting-type that excels in close combat, its Signature Move is "Blitz Arm", in which it dishes out a barrage of punches using the same blitz-type arm as Justimon. Its Special Move is charging with the connector on its tail, and firing intense lightning from its shoulders into its surroundings (Elekugel).

species.name: Rampage Greymon
species.kanji: ランページグレイモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Darkness!! Conspiracy's Dark Fortress!!"

species.name: Ranamon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Water which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. It has a sharp intuition and an unstable mood, possibly because it had been in an area that was mostly active in a section of the ocean within a weather forecasting system. Its emotions are erratic; when it is in good mood, it shows off how graceful and lady-like it is, but when it gets upset, it cries hysterically like a baby. In battle, it rarely attacks directly, and mainly does so indirectly by manipulating rain. However, since its combat abilities are intense when it is emotionally...

species.name: Rapidmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon that Armor Evolved from Terriermon with the "Digimental of Fate". Rapidmon is normally a Perfect which evolves from Galgomon, but thanks to the "Digimental of Fate", it is able to shine gold and sublimate power up to the Ultimate Level. Its Special Moves are rapid-firing homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back (Rapid Fire), and "Golden Triangle", which is similar in power level to Magnamon's Special Move, "".The power contained within the Digimental of Fate has been drawn out even further by the X-Antibody, and it is now capable of...

species.name: Rapidmon Armor
species.profile: A Holy Knight Digimon that Armor Evolved from Terriermon with the "Digimental of Fate". Rapidmon is normally a Perfect which evolves from Galgomon, but thanks to the "Digimental of Fate", it is able to shine gold and sublimate power up to the Ultimate Level. Its Special Moves are rapid-firing homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back (Rapid Fire), and "Golden Triangle", which is similar in power level to Magnamon's Special Move, "".
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Digimon Hurricane Touchdown!! Supreme Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

species.name: Rapidmon Perfect
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that evolved from Galgomon. It holds the alias of "", and it reliably brings down opponents with movements that approach the speed of light. Also, by using its gigantic ear-shaped radars, it is able to act even in the dark, and is also able to detect the existence of distant enemies. The silhouette of its body makes one think of a shaved poodle. During battle, its neck protector shuts. Its Special Moves are rapid-firing homing missiles from both of its arms and the revolver equipped to its back (Rapid Fire), and firing a beam from its whole body that completely disassembles...

species.name: Raptor Sparrowmon
species.kanji: ラプタースパロウモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Warrior!! The Released Demon!!"

species.name: Raremon
species.profile: An Undead Digimon whose muscles have all rotted away. It tried to extend its life by mechanizing its body, but its body was unable to stabilize, and its configuration data has begun to break down. However, because it was given life by those machines, it will not die, and survives with this grotesque appearance. Because its body has broken down, its offensive power and mental capacity are nonexistent, and it acts on instinct. Its entire body exudes a stench so foul that Baby Digimon will simply run away from it, but it is no match for Digimon who have grown to the Adult level.

species.name: Rare Raremon
species.profile: The Perfect form of Raremon, who survived the progressive decay of its body through further mechanization, and took on a bizarre appearance. Its body repeatedly breaks down and reconstitutes itself, and eyes and mouths keep emerging and decaying. The foul stench it gives off from its entire body has increased so much that even Ultimates have difficulty approaching it. Because it consumes energy to keep its body intact, it supplies itself with energy by dissolving enemies with its "Digest", in which it swallows them whole via the mouth on its head. In addition, it spews toxic "Decayson" gas...

species.name: Rasenmon
species.profile: Rasenmon's true form, which it attained after accepting its negative emotions without fearing them and regaining the courage it needed to believe in itself. Having broken free of the negative emotions that shackled it down, it is now reborn into this new form and is able to completely control the power that drove it berserk in the past; its violent temperament has also faded, and it now sports a kind and gentle personality.In battle, it is capable of amassing even more power by absorbing the energy derived from its allies' emotions; however, it is only able to use this ability to carry out...

species.name: Rasenmon: Fury Mode
species.kanji: ラセンモン：激昂モード
species.profile: A ruthless, nine-tailed Ultimate Digimon that became unable to control its power of darkness when large amounts of negative emotion data flowed in from others while it was evolving from a Perfect Digimon. It is a destroyer that gave in to its rampaging power of darkness when it finished evolving, instinctively devastating its surroundings. It suffers from inner conflict stemming from its fear of and attempts to reject the swirling negative emotions inside of itself, which gave rise to its destructive impulses and subsequently its vicious personality.Its Special Moves are extending its...

species.name: Rasielmon
species.profile: An Ophan Digimon that was once appointed to the same rank as Ofanimon. It possesses the mysterious power to see right through everything in the world from the "Kernel" (God's domain). It is said that with that power, it knows all about events that happen throughout the Digital World, and has accumulated a divine amount of knowledge.Its Special Move is freely combining the five elements from the magic circles on its arms and releasing enormous energy (Knowledge Stream). As for its "w=Sefer Raziel HaMalakh", which brings about all kinds of miracles to exterminate the adversary, not even...

species.name: Ravmon: Burst Mode
species.kanji: レイヴモン：バーストモード
species.profile: A Ravmon that has temporarily reached the limits of its abilities through Burst Evolution, it is a unique form which wears all the energy within the atmosphere as an aura. Its Special Moves are enlarging its wings to a gigantic size and releasing a dark purple aura (Musou-Tenshou-Yoku-no-Jin), and furiously performing a terrible and wild dance of violence (Dotou-Yami-Kumo-no-Mai). Also, it can stab the opponent in a flash of thunder with its dark purple aura (Raikou-Issen-no-Tsuki).

species.name: Rebellimon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon equipped with a high-powered engine. It is said to have evolved from a Digimon driven to the brink of death that took in junk data from its surroundings. It is an outlaw who loots parts from other Machine-species Digimon in order to further strengthen and remodel its body, which is made out of junk. Occasionally, it has been witnessed racing noisily with large gangs of Machmon.Its Special Moves are firing a large quantity of missiles from its left arm (Vanquish Missile), and pulverizing the enemy's body as it minces them with the heavy machinery on its right arm (Maximum...

species.name: Red Vegimon
species.profile: A strengthened version of Vegimon whose entire body has ripened and turned red. It has high intelligence and offensive ability, unlike Vegimon, who is still unripe. This red, ripened form is Vegimon's true form, and it is possible that the harsher environments found on the Folder Continent caused Vegimon to take on this original form. Its personality has turned even more devious and cunning. Its Special Move is a spewing out its putrid, poison-laced breath (Hazard Breath). Anyone who carelessly tries to take it on, mistaking it for an ordinary Vegimon, will no doubt meet a terrible fate.

species.name: Regulusmon
species.profile: An Evil Dragon Digimon that plots to rule through rage and fear. Despite being a Perfect, it boasts a power that is reminiscent of Megidramon, one of the Four Great Dragons Digimon who is renowned for being the most evil, and so Regulusmon's arrival is nothing short of a disaster. Its body is the source of an infection known as "GRB" (Gulus Realm Burst), and it is said that Digimon infected with "GRB Factor" have their personalities altered and become frenzied. However, the infection has not been confirmed in Digimon that have had the secretion "Black Digitron", which is said to be the...

species.name: Relemon
species.profile: A mysterious Digimon that is said to only be born on moonlit nights. It is said that Relemon born specifically on the night of the full moon receive its magical power, and as they grow, are able to use greater and more wondrous abilities than other Digimon. Because it is nocturnal, it seldom appears before people and has a shy personality. It is not able to attack, but it can transform into anything to defend itself, if it is close to the size of its body. However, it can still be found because it can never conceal its tail.

species.name: Renamon
species.profile: A Beast Man Digimon with the appearance of a golden Fox. The relationship Renamon has with humans is directly apparent; it is said that depending on how it was raised during its time as a Baby, it can evolve into a Renamon of particularly high intelligence. It is always calm, cool, and collected, as well as disciplined enough not to lose that composure in any situation. Its slender, tall appearance stands out when compared with other Child levels, and rather than emphasising on power in battle, it instead makes sport of the enemy with various techniques that utilise its speed. Its Signature...

species.name: Renamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Beast Man Digimon with the appearance of a golden fox. Renamon is a Digimon whose relationship with humans is directly apparent; it is said that depending on how it was raised during its time as a Baby, it can evolve into a Renamon of particularly high intelligence. It is always calm, cool, and collected, as well as disciplined enough not to lose that composure in any situation. Its slender, tall appearance stands out when compared with other Childs, and rather than emphasizing on power in battle, it instead makes sport of the enemy with various techniques that utilise its speed. Its...

species.name: Reverse Weddinmon
species.kanji: リバース・ウェディンモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Sweets!! The Girls' Sweet Trap!?"

species.name: Revolmon
species.profile: A mutated Digimon whose body has become a gun barrel. Although the details of how it was born are completely unclear, it has a deep sense of justice and is active as a "Virus Buster". The "Virus Busters" are Digimon who have the ability to eradicate and delete the consciousness of "evil" that can reside even within Vaccine Digimon, but most commonly resides within Virus Digimon. However, it also has a gambling-loving side and really loves Russian roulette in particular; it has quite the hard-to-hate personality and may overlook even a Virus Digimon if they can get through a round of Russian...

species.name: Rhamphomon
species.profile: A Pterosaur Digimon with large, membranous wings. Possessing remarkable flight capabilities, Rhamphomon is able to seize even Digimon that are bigger than itself with both its feet while flying. It soars from the ground to the skies in one swoop, and spends most of the day in the air, circling around riding air currents. If it spots prey as it circles around, it will fold its wings, perform a nosedive, and swoop down on them. When it brings down its prey, it stuns them with its "Crystal Cannon", in which it fires an ultrahigh-speed crystal cannonball from its mouth, or its "Hammer Strike",...

species.name: Rhino Kabuterimon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Thunder that has transcended legend by inheriting all the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors and acquiring unknown abilities. It has such a gigantic body and a heavy shell that it could be mistaken for a Dinosaur. It has the ability to generate a special magnetic field with ultrahigh voltage electric current, and is able to freely manipulate it using its gigantic horn. Although rushing techniques are its specialty, it doesn't actually come into contact with the opponent, but instead tosses them away with that special magnetic field. Its Special...

species.name: Rhinomon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Miracles". It is clad in armor made of Chrome Digizoid; not only is it thick, this armor is covered in a reflective surface that renders it incapable of being destroyed even by laser-based attacks, let alone physical ones. Also, despite its sluggish appearance, it is able to move at speeds abnormally fast for its size by using its excessive power to move its body. Its Special Move is cloaking itself in a barrier made of light emitted from the "" jewels embedded in its armor, then charging into the enemy...

species.name: Rhinomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Miracles". It is clad in armor made of Chrome Digizoid, and this armor cannot be destroyed even by laser-based attacks, let alone physical attacks, owing to its reflective surface in addition to its bulky fortification. Also, despite its sluggish appearance, because it moves its body using its excess power, its movement speed can even be said to be unusually fast for something its size. Its Special Move is cloaking itself in a barrier made of light emitted from the "" jewels embedded in its armor, then...

species.name: Rinkmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mutant Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". It is a Cyborg Digimon created from the sample data of an experiment where elementary particles were accelerated to the speed of light in an accelerator. It is said to have been born from the fusion of that sample data, a Digimon raised for experimental use, and the Digimental. A very agile Digimon, it can accelerate up to 98 percent of the speed of light, so there are no Digimon who can rival Rinkmon in speed. In contrast to its outstanding speed, however, its strength is weak and it does not...

species.name: Rize Greymon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that has mechanized over half of its body. In spite of its large build, it flies to the sky to attack the enemy. The offensive power of the shots fired from the gigantic revolver on its left arm is said to rival that of a single nuclear warhead, and it is normally impossible to rapid-fire due to its tremendous power and recoil. In order to withstand that power, its gun barrel is made from Chrome Digizoid. Its Special Moves are a high-speed rapid-firing at the limit of the Chrome Digizoid's endurance (three-round bursts) (Trident Revolver), and firing a beam barrage from its...

species.name: Rize Greymon (X-Antibody)
species.kanji: ライズグレイモン（X抗体）
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that has mechanized over half of its body. In spite of its large build, it flies to the sky to attack the enemy. The offensive power of the shots fired from the gigantic revolver on its left arm is said to rival that of a single nuclear warhead, and it is normally impossible to rapid-fire due to its tremendous power and recoil. In order to withstand that power, its gun barrel is made from Chrome Digizoid. Its Special Moves are a high-speed rapid-firing at the limit of the Chrome Digizoid's endurance (three-round bursts) (Trident Revolver), and firing a beam barrage from its...

species.name: Rook Chessmon (Black)
species.profile: A Digimon which has an appearance like a fortress which boasts impregnable defense. Although it's a gigantic Digimon it is very fast, and it defends against the opponent's strikes, then attacks. Its catchphrase is, "The opponent is nothing after me!" Its Special Moves are charging the opponent as it stands at attention, mowing them down and destroying them (Stronghold), and firing from the gunports on its arms (Rook Gatling). Also, it can use a stubborn, immovable, steadfast defense (Castle Wall).

species.name: Rook Chessmon (White)

species.name: Rosemon
species.profile: A Fairy Digimon with an appearance resembling a rose, it is referred to as the . It has the appearance of a beautiful woman, and desires to remain beautiful forever. Its personality is more or less that way, and though it is excessively self-conscious about such things, its true strength does not in fact compare unfavorably with other Ultimates. Also, it wears on its breast a "Tiferet", a jewel which is engraved with the symbol of love and beauty. This that it possesses is said to promise it eternal beauty and power. Its Special Move is taming Digimon, no matter how frenzied, with a thorned...

species.profile: A unique Aquatic Mammal Digimon that came about when a peculiar signal originating within software for researching interspecies communication transformed into a Digimon. Due to its movement range being limited to the sea, it became able to move about the sea at high speed. As expected from its appearance, it possesses advanced intelligence, but its form of thought is too complex for a normal person to understand. Although it is a species that doesn't like useless battles, it won't go easy against an opponent that comes and challenges it. Its Special Move is emitting the ultrasonic waves...
