species.name: Rust Tyranomon
species.profile: The Ultimate of Tyranomon who has lived through the fierce, continuing battles that have lasted since the genesis of the Digital World, and evolved alongside it. Having endured many years in harsh environments as Metal Tyranomon, its whole cyborg body shows signs of rust. Its tactics are geared towards annihilation warfare, and it is capable of ravaging an entire enemy base by itself. Rust Tyranomon has the nature of a Digimon predator, gorging on hundreds of thousands of Digimon within a short period without leaving a trace. Its Special Moves are extending forth the battery on its back and...

species.name: Ryudamon
species.profile: A Beast Digimon that, because it has an old-style Interface on its brow, is presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. Although its body is clad in Japanese-style armor high in defensive ability, its movements are nimble, so it fights by resolutely leaping into the opponent's chest. It studies the business of combat as it fights, and possesses Bushikatagi, with bravery and a soul that doesn't fear more powerful Digimon. The data that is said to have been hidden within the deepest parts of its Digicore, during an experiment, is the ferocious...

species.name: Saber Leomon
species.profile: An Ancient Beast Digimon said to possess explosive, Mach speed power. However, the details about it are shrouded in mystery, though a theory suggests that it might have been a Leomon who was transformed into a beast. It possesses explosive Mach speed power, and with that speed it can easily dodge attacks, no matter how fast they are. Its two greatly developed fangs and sharp claws possess tremendous destructive power, and it is referred to as the ultimate Digimon. Its Special Move is hardening the countless "Hairs" of its mane and firing them at the opponent (Infinity Arrow). Because its...

species.name: Saberdramon
species.profile: A Digimon shrouded in black flames. Due to the roughness of its temperament, for which it continues counterattacks against enemies to a ferocious degree, it's difficult to even approach it. Its Special Move is striking from the air with the talons on its feet (Black Saber).

species.name: Sagittarimon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mythical Animal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Hope". It is a superior species of the Centalmon family, and it is told that it is a mythical being. Although it is an Armor that pseudo-evolved from an ancient Digimon due to the power of the Digimental, it will sometimes evolve as a mutation among Centalmon (not an Armor Evolution). Because it consumes a large quantity of energy while in this form, it reverts after a short period. Its Special Move is firing an arrow made of the super-metal Chrome Digizoid (Judgment Arrow).

species.name: Sagomon
species.profile: A Demon Man Digimon that was banished from the Digital World's heaven, and fell to the backwoods of North Bridge Island. Although it usually has a cheerful, joke-cracking personality, if it touches the skulls wrapped around its waist it goes into a fury like a raging fire. That is because if even one of the nine skulls wrapped around its waist is lost it will be transformed into a terrifying Digimon. It possesses the "Nezha (deity)" staff which demonstrates terrifying destructive power in the super-heavyweight class, it spins it freely to raise a waterspout (Kouyouhoujou: Kamon no Jin), and...

species.name: Saint Galgomon
species.profile: A colossal Machine Digimon whose whole body has become a mass of weapons. The amount of weapons it has equipped rivals that of Metal Garurumon (Incidentally, while Metal Garurumon uses cold-based weapons, Saint Galgomon uses heat-based weapons). Each of its weapons, such as its lasers, missiles, bazookas, vulcans, and flamethrowers, are concealed. Although its speed is considerably slow, because it puts all of that energy into power, it possesses unbelievable destructive force. Because its lack of speed is compensated for by its weapons, it is able to cope with attacks from every direction...

species.name: Sakumon
species.profile: A tiny Digimon with a single blade protruding from its head. Its whole body is golden, and the blade on its head shines very brightly. Its personality is mischievous and it is constantly moving as long as it is awake, but it is bad at balancing due to the weight of its head, so surrounding Digimon can occasionally be seen running around trying to escape because of it swinging its blade as it rolls around.

species.name: Sakuttomon
species.profile: A Baby Digimon that evolved from Sakumon, and that now has two blades. Its balance has been stabilized by the blades now positioned on its left and right side, as well as with the addition of its small feet. While it has stopped rolling around and become more active, getting stuck in a ceiling or wall will cause it to be unable to move.

species.name: Sakuyamon
species.profile: A Digimon that holds the role of a miko, acting as an agent of God's will. Like Taomon, it freely uses Onmyoudou techniques in battle, and has the ability to employ God Beast-species Digimon. It always carries four pipes on the belt around its waist, within which lurk four kuda-gitsune. It is able to use these kuda-gitsune for everything from attacking to gathering information. Just like Holy Angemon's , it is able to change into a which administers Shinto rituals. Its Signature Move is attacking the opponent with the four kuda-gitsune carried on its waist (x= The four kuda-gitsune possess...

species.name: Sakuyamon: Miko Mode
species.kanji: サクヤモン：巫女モード
species.profile: A form Sakuyamon takes when it performs Shinto rituals and listens to God's will. It seldom fights in , but has strengthened its ability to exorcise evil spirits.

species.name: Sakuyamon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Digimon that holds the role of a miko, acting as an agent of God's will. Like Taomon, it freely uses Onmyoudou techniques in battle, and has the ability to employ God Beast-species Digimon. It always carries four pipes on the belt around its waist, within which lurk four kuda-gitsune. It is able to use these kuda-gitsune for everything from attacking to gathering information. Just like Holy Angemon's , it is able to change into a which administers Shinto rituals. Its Signature Move is attacking the opponent with the four kuda-gitsune carried on its waist (x= The four kuda-gitsune possess...

species.name: Salamandamon
species.profile: An Amphibian Digimon that "Armor Evolved" with the "Digimental of Courage". It is as carefree as it looks with its flame-clad, salamander-like appearance, but once angered, it will cause the flames covering its body to flare up even more and attack. Its Signature Move is spewing out scorching-hot flames from its mouth (Heat Breath). Its Special Move is gathering oxygen in the air and triggering a violent explosion (w=Backdraft).

species.name: Sand Yanmamon
species.profile: A species of Yanmamon that lives in the desert. Unlike Yanmamon, it has a carefree personality, but is merciless against Digimon that enter its territory. Its Special Move is generating a small sandstorm by flapping its wings intensely (Desert Wind).

species.name: Sandiramon
species.profile: One of the "Deva Digimon", it is a Perfect Digimon with a form resembling the Snake. As a follower of the Four Holy Beasts Digimon Zhuqiaomon, it is the most cunning and cruel among the Deva. It doesn't like to decide matches in an instant, and prefers to instead choke the life out of the opponent while tormenting them bit by bit. It usually lives deep beneath the ground, and subterranean maneuvers are its specialty. During battle, it can produce a spear made of light, the , from its mouth, and skillfully wield it with its tail wrapped around it like a hand. Although the vanishes once it...
species.debut: Digimon Tamers: "Giant Snake Appearance! Great Edo Line, Great Panic"

species.name: Sangloupmon
species.profile: A noble, bloodsucking wolf Digimon. It is a considerably old species of Digimon, and is said to have survived since the of the Digital World. Digimon who have had their blood sucked by Sangloupmon have all the information drawn out of their Digicores, cease vital functions, and die. Sangloupmon is able to instantly move to different places as it rushes about the Net by breaking down its data into packets of its own volition. For this reason, it is said to be very difficult to capture Sangloupmon. Its Special Moves are flinging thousands of tiny blades and instantaneously skewering the...

species.name: Sangomon
species.profile: A Mollusk Digimon that lives in the shallows of the Net Ocean. It often mingles with other species due to its gentle disposition and cheerfulness. It uses the backs of Shellmon as a resting spot, and Ganimon have been witnessed trimming the coral protruding from its head.When attacked by intruders, it spreads a poisonous, lachrymatory mist from its coral and escapes (Refuge Mist); if it is unable to escape in time, it fights back with its "Coral Pressure", which releases high-pressure water from the ends of its arms.

species.name: Sanzomon
species.profile: A Monk Digimon that is journeying around the Digital World in order to achieve enlightenment. It overcomes many difficult ordeals, and as training it imposes asceticism on its own body, day and night. Although Sanzomon doesn't carry any weapons at all, it unleashes various techniques by reciting sutras. It brings the hearts of wild Digimon back to their senses by making them listen to endless words of gratitude (To Shishun-kyou). Sanzomon manifests the ordeals that it has suffered and showers them on the opponent (Kochou Mu-kyou). It displays an illusion that its scattered rosary beads are...

species.name: Savior Huckmon
species.profile: It evolved into this form after repeatedly meeting and parting with Digimon over its long journey, and living through countless fierce battles. It militarily intervenes in the strife that occurs incessantly throughout the Digital World, seeking ceasefires, and has brought aid to the Digimon on-site who have suffered harm. The result is not always a success, but the tears Savior Huckmon sheds before those tragic scenes strengthen it further, as it earnestly reaches out to the next Digimon that cries for help. It is capable of using its legs to walk bipedally despite them being blades; in...

species.name: Scorpiomon
species.profile: An Insect Digimon referred to as the "". It sneaks up from behind the opponent while hiding its presence, and pierces the opponent with the venomous stinger at the tip of its tail. The venom that Scorpiomon carries acts faster than the transmission speed of nerve data, killing the opponent before they even realize that they have been stung. It is referred to as an assassin for this reason, since its opponent will not even know of its existence. Its Signature Move, "Blackout", blinds the opponent by spraying a slightly poisonous mist. Through this technique, it ensures that the opponent will...

species.name: Scourge Chiropmon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon with an aircraft-like appearance. It is presumed to be a form that evolved by taking in the design data for a real-world stealth bomber. It has a habit of primarily operating at night, but because it has a body color that makes it hard to see at night, and an airframe shape that makes it difficult for various types of sensors such as radar to detect, it is difficult to catch glimpse of Scourge Chiropmon. As there have only been three sightings to date, it is a Digimon that is rarely encountered, but it is unclear whether it is a Digimon with a small population, or whether...

species.name: Scumon
species.profile: A repulsive, po*p-shaped Digimon that shines golden. It was born from the accumulation and mutation of scrap data thrown into the recycle bin of a computer desktop. It likes dark places, and being a pile of scrap data, it is similar to Numemon in that it is often hated by other Digimon. Its intelligence and offensive ability are nonexistent. Its partner, Tyumon, is a small rat-like Digimon who does not fight, but is unparalleled when it comes to cunning and is always coaxing Scumon into performing bad deeds.

species.name: Seadramon
species.profile: An Aquatic Digimon that has a long, serpentine body. Using its long body, it wreathes itself around approaching enemies and constricts them until they are suffocated. It did not have any intelligence to begin with, and it swims around the Net Ocean, wherever its instincts take it. Its Special Move is breathing absolute zero air out of its mouth, instantly freezing water and firing it at the opponent (Ice Arrow).

species.name: Seadramon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: Inhabiting the intensely competitive Net Ocean since ancient times, it is thought to be an Aquatic Digimon that evolved more drastically by continuing to battle. Characterized by its long, serpentine body, it uses its long body to wreath itself around enemies that are coming to attack, and constricts until the enemy suffocates. Naturally, it doesn't have intelligence or speech, and it swims around the Net Ocean leisurely according to its instincts. Its Special Move is breathing absolute zero air out of its mouth, instantly freezing water and firing it at the opponent (Ice Arrow).Its body...

species.name: Seahomon
species.profile: An Armor-level Aquatic Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Light". It inhabits places with high water pressure in the deepest trenches of the Net Ocean, so it has a small build, but when it rises up to an area of the ocean with shallow water, it seems that it becomes even larger than Seadramon-species Digimon. Although it is still a hypothesis, it is rumored that Seahomon is a survivor of ancient Digimon said to have perished in the past, and that it might have something to do with Seadramon-species Digimon. Its Special Move is spewing out a seven-colored beam from...

species.name: Sealsdramon
species.profile: It is said that only the one that passes the "Selection-D", a special selection test that screens through 100 Commandramon, can evolve to Sealsdramon. It is able to move over short distances at speeds that are impossible to perceive with the eyes, and without equipping things like camouflage features or a rifle, it has the ability to bring down its "Target" with just its taijutsu. Its primary function is assassination. Its Special Moves are a single blow from a knife sharpened to its limit (Death Behind), and measuring the opponent's vital points in an instant (Scouter Monoeye).

species.name: Searchmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Knowledge". It has "inquisitive" habits due to the influence of the "Digimental of Knowledge", and it performs information gathering and reconnaissance with the radome (radar) attached to its back. Searchmon can detect the presence of enemies no matter how small their sounds or vibrations are, and also gathers information on them. Its Special Move is emitting radio waves that derange the opponent from the radome on its back, leaving them in a state of complete confusion (Jamming Hertz).

species.name: Seiten Gokuwmon
species.profile: The end of a long journey in search of a truth doctrine. What it acquired during that journey was a power that embodies unity.Seiten Gokuwmon is a Tathāgata Digimon that evolved when Sanzomon used its sutras to elevate the bonds it had with Cho·Hakkaimon and Sagomon—whom it traveled alongside and grew up with—into a new power.Although its inherently belligerent nature remains unchanged, it is no longer as arrogant as it used to be, and has grown into a warrior who combines combat instinct with composure.Its spirit is not the only thing that has grown. The golden decorations on its back are...

species.name: Sephirothmon
species.profile: A Digimon that possesses power over Steel which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. It possesses thinking like that of a machine, which lacks emotions. By instantly analyzing the enemy, it accurately points out their weaknesses. However, it is very fragile when the enemy makes an action that falls outside of its calculations. Its ten spheres each have the same attribute as the other Warrior Ten, and are able to perform attacks with, and conversely, absorb attacks with those attributes. When the enemy's attack misses or its own attack hits, it gives out a low-pitched, creepy...

species.name: Sepikmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Demon Man Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". Due to the power of its strange mask, it is able to speak with the spirits of the dead. It usually lurks in the depths of the Digital World's jungles, and rarely ever appears before others. According to one theory, it is said that Sepikmon never leaves the jungle because the spirits of the dead are its only friends, and that it has no living ones. While in the Digital World's jungles, should you hear voices speaking as though in conversation despite no one being around, it would be best to...

species.name: Seraphimon
species.profile: A Seraph Digimon that is dressed in holy armor that shines silver, and possesses ten golden wings. As the highest-ranked being among Angel Digimon, it rules over them all. Although its true face and personality is hidden behind a mask and cannot be glimpsed, it is the being closest to the "Being of Good" called "God". It is told that when it descends for the final battle against evil beings, it will purify everything. Also, it is said that Demon, who fell to the Dark Area and became a Demon Lord Digimon, was originally a Seraphimon. Its Special Moves are firing seven super-heated spheres of...

species.name: Sethmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Demon Beast Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". Because the power of the Digimental of Love was too great, it was unable to control it, and so it was converted into the power of hatred. Its body is colored an ominous red, and it has the power to create calamitous storms. As it is the polar opposite of Holsmon, it is thought that they are the embodiments of the duality of love and hatred possessed by the "Digimental of Love". Its Special Moves are a hot wind that rages in the desert (Heat Storm), and striking with its two gigantic tusks (Tusk...

species.name: Sethmon Wild Mode
species.kanji: セトモンワイルドモード
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "The Final Kingdom, The Shining Sun's Bright Land"

species.name: Shademon
species.profile: A Digimon with no substance that haunts the shadows of humans and Digimon. It feeds on the despair of the haunted opponent and transforms it into its own nourishment, and it is said that which fiendish Digimon it evolves to varies by the amount ingested. Its Special Moves are continuously displaying illusions of being knocked to the ground 10000 times (Free Death Fall), and manipulating the surrounding Digimon to assault the enemy who is being haunted (Kill Me).
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Darkness!! Conspiracy's Dark Fortress!!"

species.name: Shademon (Nene Ver.)
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Darkness!! Conspiracy's Dark Fortress!!"

species.name: Shadramon
species.profile: An Armor-level Insect Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Courage". To be precise, it took the form of an insect-humanoid, but its sinister appearance and viciousness is the result of an unfortunate adverse reaction to the "Digimental of Courage". It manipulates flames similarly to Fladramon and their combat ability is more or less on par, but it is otherwise a wicked being who is the exact opposite of Fladramon, just like light and darkness. Its Special Move is a red hot blaze emitted from both hands (Flare Buster).

species.name: Shagaramon
species.profile: A Holy Dragon Digimon that resides in Ryushogu, an oceanic area in the Eastern Digital World where beautiful crystals grow. Using the cloth wrapped around its body and its ability to manipulate seawater, it is able to create ocean current gates that can transport anyone anywhere, and it is impossible to reach the secluded region of Ryushogu without riding the ocean currents generated by Shagaramon.Since it has the duty of banishing any Digimon that disturbs the peace in Ryushogu upon arriving there, Shagaramon has been entrusted as the gatekeeper of Ryushogu by Ryugumon. The Digimon...

species.name: Shakkoumon
species.profile: A Mutation Digimon which Jogress-evolved from Ankylomon and Angemon. It possesses white wings on its body, which shines silver, and according to one theory it is an Angel Digimon which descended to the ancient Digital World. It can rotate its neck and torso 360°, allowing it to attack facing every direction. As its face is expressionless it is difficult to determine what it's thinking, so some observers find it eerie, but its personality is exceedingly gentle. Its Signature Move is firing from its waist (Nigimitama). Its Special Move is a red laser beam radiated from both of its eyes...

species.name: Shakomon
species.profile: A Digimon shaped like a bivalve covered by a hard shell. Because its shell developed rapidly, its inner structure has become slime-shaped like that of a Baby. It is a cunning fellow who lures the opponent with its cute face, and attacks them once they get close. Also, when its shell is closed, it has such high defense as to easily deflect things such as light attacks. Its Special Moves are shooting jadeite formed within its body at the opponent (Black Pearl), and hitting the opponent with a high-pressure water current (Water Screw).

species.name: Shakomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Digimon shaped like a bivalve covered by a hard shell. Because its shell developed rapidly, its inner structure has become slime-shaped like that of a Baby. It is a cunning fellow who lures the opponent with its cute face, and attacks them once they get close. Also, when its shell is closed, it has such high defense as to easily deflect things such as light attacks. Its Special Moves are shooting jadeite formed within its body at the opponent (Black Pearl).Its bivalve shell has further developed, and contrary to the beautiful cherry-pink pattern on its shell, it is equipped with...

species.name: Shamamon
species.profile: A Goburimon whose duty is to listen to the will of God, and convey that to its clan. It performs a mysterious dance during its rituals, and it is said that once it gets fired up to the maximum, it becomes able to hear the prophecies of God. It also makes use of this ritual to predict matters that are of importance to its clan. Its Special Move is striking the enemy's head with the large club it uses for its rituals (Shama Hammer).

species.name: Sharkmon
species.profile: A large shark Digimon that evolves from Aquatic Digimon with a overwhelming tenacity to catch prey. Having taken in battleship data, over half of its body is mechanized. It is a fiendish Digimon that uses its anchor to capture Digimon that live in the Net Ocean or pass close by, and then devours them.Its Special Moves are deploying and firing its cannons (Issei Hōgeki), and torpedoes that self-destruct after biting the enemy (l=Plutodumon). In addition, it captures the enemy with its anchor, and charges at them while reeling them in (Fang Charge).

species.name: Shawujinmon
species.profile: A Demon Man Digimon banished from the Digital World's heaven. Although it is a calm and collected Digimon, it is said that a certain Digicore was sealed among the nine beads of its necklace, and if even one bead is lost it will be transformed once again into a terrifying Digimon. Its Special Moves are raising a waterspout by freely spinning its astonishing super-heavyweight class "Nezha (deity)" staff (Kouyoujou: Kamon no Jin), and striking the ground with its staff to shatter it and release a raging current (Kouyoujou: Taki no Jin). Also, for close combat it can stab with the crescent-moon...

species.name: Sheepmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Hope". The surface of its body is covered in wool of the finest quality. Also, Sheepmon's movements are very sluggish, so just watching them move in flocks will lull you to sleep. The equipment on its back is a booster/bazooka unit called the "", and with this, it reproduces the low-speed movement characteristic of Sheepmon. Its Special Move is forcibly putting enemy Digimon to sleep during any battle with giant balls of wool launched from the "" (Wool Grenade).

species.name: Shellmon
species.profile: A hermit crab-like Digimon that lives in the shallower seabeds of the "Net Ocean". Although it has a turtle-like appearance when settled inside its shell, it actually has a soft body like that of a mollusk. Because its body rapidly gets bigger as it grows, it switches homes each time until it reaches the size of a small mountain. Not only that, it has a habit of settling into anything it is able to fit its body into. Since it has low intelligence and a belligerent personality, one must take caution when coming across a Shellmon. Its Special Move is shooting liquid at high pressure (Hydro...

species.name: Shima Unimon
species.profile: A subspecies of Unimon that has stripes all over its body. Because the data of the Unicorn is more highly expressed in its body, it lacks the wings of the Pegasus. For that reason, it is unable to fly in the air, but it races across the land with its powerful legs. Also, its Unicorn horn is sharper than Unimon's, and its lethal potential has increased. Its Special Move is spewing a shock wave from its gigantic mouth (Raster Shot).

species.name: Shin Monzaemon
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that evolved as a result of Monzaemon taking in nightmare-related analysis data. At first glance, it is shaped like a teddy bear, but it is actually a fluffy, amorphous Digimon with a mysterious nature, like a cross between slime and clouds. It is a moody Digimon that has a childish personality and does not act intelligently. It has a habit of liking and taking in simple and cute things, and chooses immature Digimon that are Child-level and below as its targets. On the other hand, since it considers Digimon that have gotten more mature to be "repulsive beings with...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet BE (BEMemory Digital Monster 25th Anniversary Dim)

species.name: Shine Greymon
species.profile: A Light Dragon Digimon which fights with the red-hot solar energy it accumulates. Its Special Moves are spreading its gigantic wings, concentrating that light energy to its utmost limit, then firing it (Glorious Burst), and mowing down the opponent with wings of glimmering light (Shining Blast). Also, it can summon the , in which the power of Gaia is condensed, from the solid earth.

species.name: Shine Greymon: Ruin Mode
species.kanji: シャイングレイモン ルインモード
species.profile: A form of Shine Greymon that unleashed its power through hatred when its comrades were defeated and its pride wounded. Its thirst for unlimited power has transformed its originally "positive" solar energy into "negative" dark energy. Its Special Moves have all been drastically enhanced by dark energy as well. However, if it draws out dark energy beyond its limits during battle, it will risk turning into a Digitama.
species.debut: Digimon Savers: "The Day of Parting, The Strongest Enemy - Thoma!"

species.name: Shine Greymon: Burst Mode
species.kanji: シャイングレイモン：バーストモード
species.profile: A Shine Greymon that has temporarily reached the limits of its abilities through Burst Evolution, it is a unique form which wears an aura of solar-class high-energy flames. Its Special Moves are fusing its flaming shield and sword into a greatsword with explosively increased power (Corona Blaze Sword), and putting its body and soul into inducing a massive eruption (Final Shining Burst). Also, it can continuously fire incandescent flame shots (Torrid Weiss).

species.name: Shivamon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Shoemon
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If someone tries to touch it, it will jump quickly and immediately flee. Due to its timid nature, it can acutely sense vibrations in the floor or ground it is in contact with, and quickly detect the presence of invading enemies. The sole of its shoe has a very strong grip, allowing it to move smoothly over any rough road, and climb even vertical walls and pillars with ease as well. Since it prefers cleanliness, it dislikes walking in sandy areas or on muddy roads.Sweet fruits are its favorite food, and when the...

species.name: Shonitamon
species.profile: The "" born from two Digimon's overflowing curiosity. It specializes in methods of concealing its appearance, freely uses ninjutsu to penetrate enemy territory, and can transmit the enemy info it has accumulated to its allies with Monitamon's "" ability, and is able to withdraw whenever it likes without being noticed...however, although it has this potential, for some mysterious and specific reason, it is never seen exhibiting this ability. Because its curiosity easily gets the best of it, it frequently sneaks into areas differing from its objective, and performs the wrong armed...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars Big Digimon Collection Poster

species.name: Shooting Starmon
species.kanji: シューティングスターモン
species.profile: The Jogress-evolved form of Starmon and the Pickmons. A horde of Pickmons surround Starmon and their thoughts become one, allowing Starmon to ascend to a Super Major-type.Its Special Move is attacking by turning into a flaming star that penetrates the atmosphere (Astro Bomber), with such force that it creates a huge crater upon impact. Not only that, it is able to rekindle the weakened hearts of depressed, dispirited Digimon by shouting passionate phrases at them (Dynamite Soul). Its "Ryūsei Rock Damashī", a Combined Special Move with Shoutmon EX6, is a straight right punch filled with...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Stars! Like a Falling Star!!"

species.name: Shootmon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Shortmon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Sweets!! The Girls' Sweet Trap!?"

species.name: ShouCutemon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Shinobi Zone, The Comical Ninja Battle!"

species.name: Shoutmon
species.profile: A ferocious Digimon with extremely high aggressiveness due to its hot-blooded enthusiasm. However, it is friendly towards its comrades, and its friendship with other Digimon, surpassing species, can be deepened even further if they are recognized by Shoutmon.There is a unique feature to Shoutmon's singing that converts its passion to energy, and it can perform an attack called "Soul Crusher", which uses its mic to amplify the heated emotions blazing within its chest, then bash the opponent. Because passion is the very source of the attack, it will definitely inflict damage no matter the...

species.name: Shoutmon (King Ver.)
species.profile: A Shoutmon with a valiant air, and a yellow scarf that flutters in the wind. Its strength has increased drastically as a result of its training, and its performances, in which it uses its McField-brand mic, shine especially bright.Its Special Moves are facing its mic and letting out a passionate, maximum volume shout (Soul Crusher), putting on a polished mic performance and unleashing its bōjutsu techniques (Rowdy Rocker), and hurling a passionate fireball containing its heart and soul (Rock Damashī), all of which have been powered-up.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "The Students Disappeared! The Flickering Shadow of Sagomon"

species.name: Shoutmon DX
species.profile: The "", born when Omega Shoutmon, who boasts the swiftest speed, obtained the fighting strength of Zeke Greymon, who boasts unparalleled power, incarnating its high defensive and offensive power without losing Omega Shoutmon's speed by obtaining Zeke Greymon's "Gold Digizoid". There is never an opponent too formidable before the "", who boasts high mobility and offensive power.Shoutmon DX possesses a disposition that contrasts clever divinity with ferocious bestiality, deriving from the instincts within Omega Shoutmon and Zeke Greymon. Although it normally has a mild, kind, and friendly...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Don't Die, Greymon! The Birth of Shoutmon DX"

species.name: Shoutmon EX6
species.profile: Shoutmon EX6 which has become the "". It is formed from the DigiXros of evolved Digimon that included Omega Shoutmon, and it is considered to surpass Shoutmon X7 in defensive and flying ability because its body and wings shine gold and silver. The "" on its left arm destroys any armor in addition to super-oscillating the instant it pierces it. Also, its right arm is equipped with the "" sword. When Shooting Starmon is present, it unleashes a blow from its fist heavy enough to shatter a star using their Combined Special Move "Ryūsei Rock Damashī".

Its Special Move is hitting snowballs embedded with stones at the enemy with a thousand oni knocks (Snow Gob Bolt).

Its Special Move is summoning a snow cloud from its snow crystal-affixed staff, generating an immense blizzard (Crystal Cloud).

species.name: Soulmon
species.profile: A Ghost Digimon constructed from a cursed virus program. As it was a Bakemon that took in data of mages that appear in fantasy stories, the black hat it wears raises its magical power. Because of that, its attacks that make use of curses or magic are tremendously powerful. Its Special Move is releasing the souls of the dead upon the enemy (Necro Magic).

species.name: Soundbirdmon
species.profile:
A Bird Digimon characterized by its speaker built-in wings. It is very cautious and usually keeps quiet, but when a suspicious Digimon draws near, it drives them away by crying at high volume.Its Special Moves are singing at full volume and sending out a shock wave (Giga Scream), and emitting ultrasonic waves to immobilize the enemy (Sound Finish).
*A winning entry in the Digimon Xros Wars Original Digimon Contest.
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Bagra Brothers! The Bonds of Darkness"'s Eyecatch

species.name: Spadamon
species.profile: One of the legendary "Legend-Arms" who, according to legend, "if held by an angel will save the world, and if held by a demon will destroy the world", it is a Weapon Digimon that transforms itself into a weapon. Although its personality is earnest and serious, it has a side that is weak to pressure. Its combat abilities are low, but it shows its true merit once it becomes a weapon.

species.name: Sparrowmon
species.profile: A Digimon specializing in aerial battles, it soars at high speed without making a sound. It excels not only in speed but also in maneuverability, possessing the mobility to pull off sudden turns without any difficulty. Generally speaking, it gets carried away easily due to its moodiness. Because the quality of its flight varies depending on its current mood, one can immediately tell whether its mood is good or bad from whether it looks like it is flying well or badly. If it is performing highly difficult aerial acrobatics without even being asked, it is unmistakable proof that it is in high...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Girls!! The Mysterious Beauty Nene!!"

species.name: Sparrowmon AB
species.kanji: スパロウモン（アフター バー ナー）
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Xros Friend!! The Location of Trust"

species.name: Spinomon
species.profile: A Dinosaur Digimon that inhabits the green depths of the jungle. It boasts the greatest and strongest powers among the Dinosaur Digimon inhabiting the Digital World, and it is said that it possesses strength equal to that of Dinorexmon. Due to its extreme belligerence it leads a highly brutal existence, but the latest research has made it clear that it possesses astonishing intelligence. The blades on its back have become its greatest feature, and since they possess excellent defensive and offensive power, if it suffers a direct attack, the attacker is forced to suffer nearly fatal wounds....

species.name: Splashmon
species.profile: The general of the Water-tiger Army of the "Big Death-Stars". By changing itself into a liquid and moving from liquid to liquid, it is able to take the shape of a human or Digimon at will. For this reason, spying is its specialty, and it puts all the information it acquired together, then relays it to its Cyborg Digimon to implement its strategies. No matter the tactics, it always puts being beautiful as its top priority, and its personality is such that it will reject tactics that sully its own beauty. Although it leads an army, its faith is only in its own beauty, so it doesn't have even...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "To a New World! The Fire-fury General's Dragon Land"

species.name: Splashmon Darkness Mode (Drippins)
species.kanji: スプラッシュモンダークネスモード
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "The Xros Heart Break-up Crisis! The Water-tiger General's Devious Trap"

species.name: Splashmon Darkness Mode
species.kanji: スプラッシュモンダークネスモード
species.profile: The general of the Water-tiger Army of the "Big Death-Stars". By changing itself into a liquid and moving from liquid to liquid, it is able to take the shape of a human or Digimon at will. For this reason, spying is its specialty, and it puts all the information it acquired together, then relays it to its Cyborg Digimon to implement its strategies. No matter the tactics, it always puts being beautiful as its top priority, and its personality is such that it will reject tactics that sully its own beauty. Although it leads an army, its faith is only in its own beauty, so it doesn't have even...
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "The Xros Heart Break-up Crisis! The Water-tiger General's Devious Trap"

species.name: Starmon
species.profile: A Planet Digimon that was accidentally discovered within planet-analyzing software at a space development center. It is a space warrior equipped with a star-shaped armor suit, and star-marked gloves and boots. Its tattered yellow scarf indicates Starmon's combat experience. The eyes at the center of its body burn with fighting spirit, and are able to convey its will to the opponent without even saying a word. In addition, they can also be used in an advanced way to hypnotize the opponent. It is a hot-blooded Digimon that looks up to the hero, Leomon. Its Special Move is causing small...

species.name: Starmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Planet Digimon that was accidentally discovered within planet-analyzing software at a space development center. It is a space warrior equipped with a star-shaped armor suit, and star-marked gloves and boots. Starmon's tattered yellow scarf indicates its combat experience. The eyes at the center of its body are burning with fighting spirit, allowing it to convey its will to the opponent without even saying a word. In addition, it can also hypnotize the opponent as an advanced way of using them. It is a hot-blooded Digimon that looks up to the hero, Leomon. Its Special Move is causing small...

species.name: Starmons
species.profile: The "Starmons" are composed of a corps of several Pickmon with a Starmon at their heart. The will of the corps is at the discretion of Starmon, the Head of the corps, and the Head's decisions are briskly and unconditionally followed by the Pickmon, keeping them from falling out of line as they maneuver according to Starmon's directions. The complex maneuvers required by the corps techniques "Meteor Squall" and "Wish Upon a Star" are made possible by their strict hierarchical system.As Starmon has a cheerful, showy personality, it is an extreme optimist. Basically, it never gets depressed,...

species.name: Stegomon
species.profile: An Armor-level Stegosaur Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". It has countless blades on its back. These blades are used for performing counterattacks as well as defending itself from the enemy's attacks, and Stegomon is able to will them to move in its desired direction. It sometimes attacks with the spikes on its tail; generally, however, it is said that it mostly tanks the enemy's attacks and then repels them with its blades. Its Special Move is shooting the blades on its back up into the sky, which rain down on the enemy (Shell Needle Rain). Few...

species.name: Stiffilmon
species.profile: Only a small fraction of Filmon who have tempered their quills to the extreme can achieve evolution into this Perfect Digimon. The fur covering its entire body is said to rival Red Digizoid in hardness, acting as both a shield that protects its body from harm and as a weapon that boasts unparalleled offensive power. The "" it wields in both hands are its prided weapons, made from compressing its own shed fur to ultra-high density. It trains diligently on a daily basis, dreaming of the day that it can finally face Were Garurumon—who it views as its rival—in battle. Its Special Moves are...

species.name: Stingmon
species.profile: An extremely unusual Insect Digimon with a humanoid form. It possesses nimble movements and a tough exoskeleton, defining traits of Insect Digimon. It excels in its abilities as an assassin, aiming for the opponent's vitals with its nimble movements and keen judgment, and specializes in attacks that silence the opponent with a single blow. It is highly intelligent and has great composure, along with a cool disposition. Its Special Move is a terrifying technique in which it skewers the opponent with the Spikes on both of its arms (Spiking Finish).

species.name: Strabimon
species.profile: A Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when Wolfmon's power was halved. Because it has not lost its "Combat Instinct", unlike the similar half-beast, half-man Flamon, it has a ferocious side. For that reason, although it has the appearance of a Child Digimon, it will sometimes rampage enough that even the typical Adult Digimon is unable to control it. As with Flamon, although its power was decreased, it seems that Adult-class Digimon aren't a match for it. Its Special Move is cutting the opponent to pieces with the shining claws on its hands (Licht Nagel).

species.name: Strikedramon
species.profile: The "" that aims to be a Virus Buster is Strikedramon. Although there are many of its parts that are left-behind traces of Monodramon, like the horn extending behind it, because it transformed into the covered in , it can even be seen as a wholly different species. Although it is naturally a kindhearted Digimon since it is part of the Vaccine-species just like Angemon, once it discovers a Virus-species it becomes possessed by the extermination instinct (destruction instinct?), and it won't try to stop fighting until it has reduced the opponent to trash data. It is also said that, at that...

species.name: Submarimon
species.profile: An Armor-level Aquatic Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Sincerity". The "Digimental of Sincerity" has the attribute of "Water", and those that don this Digimental demonstrate their true power underwater. It swims freely around the ocean, and the techniques unleashed in underwater battles are no match for it unless they're also from a considerably Aquatic Digimon. Its Special Moves are discharging super-compressed oxygen (Oxygen Homing), and after distancing itself underwater, instantly accelerating and performing a ramming attack while spinning the drill on its...

species.name: Suijinmon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon that possesses parts from both Justimon and Mugendramon. While the reason why these parts are being used is unknown, there is no doubt that it has great combat strength. Its Special Moves are "Accel Arm", where it grips and crushes the enemy with its power-type arm, and "Mugen Cannon", a technique shared with Mugendramon.

species.name: Sunamon
species.profile: A Slime Digimon whose body is made of sand. Despite being a Baby, it has an aggressive personality and is very territorial. It has a body that falls apart like sand, or conversely, hardens like clay at will, but its pacifier never changes shape. If approached by an enemy, it threatens them by throwing a large amount of sand.
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Titan of Dust Dim Card)

species.name: Sunarizamon
species.profile: A Reptile Digimon that mainly acts in groups while camouflaging itself in desert areas. By controlling the amount of sand that makes up its body, it is able to expand and contract, and transform its limbs and tail. It is difficult to detect once it has blended in with the desert, and it is not uncommon for one to think that there is quicksand, but turns out to be hordes of Sunarizamon.It defends itself from intruders with its "Grit Nail", where it transforms its forelimbs to being claw-shaped and scratches with them, and "Sand Blast", which shaves off the enemy's body with sand that it...

species.name: Sunmon
species.profile: A Baby Digimon with an appearance that looks as if a flame has been lit on its head. The protuberances on its body, which are reminiscent of the sun, are soft and move as if they were limbs. It can only be seen during the daytime on sunny days. It has a gentle personality, and moves by lightly floating about on warm days. Its Special Move is spewing hot, luminescent bubbles (Sunlight Bubble).

species.name: Super Dark Knightmon
species.kanji: スーパーダークナイトモン
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Showdown! Dark Knightmon VS Xros Heart!"

species.name: Superstarmon
species.profile: The space warrior Starmon turned into this Perfect level Mutation Digimon. It raised its self-satisfaction and clothed itself in a flashy outfit, making its debut as a star. Although it means to use its sunglasses as a disguise to conceal its superstar identity, they do not help at all. Its Special Move, "Halley Squall", involves summoning countless meteors to rain down upon the enemy from overhead.

species.name: Surfimon
species.profile: Although it is an Aquatic-species Digimon, it is a Digimon that has been improved so that it can move quickly, even out of water. Its pride is high and it has a lone wolf personality that hates schooling like fish. Its Special Moves are rotating the spikes growing over its body like that of a chainsaw to attack and defend simultaneously (Barrier Blade), and accelerating to the speed of light and charging with the "" hoverboard it projects from the third eye on its head (Lightning Cutter).

species.name: Susanoomon
moves: Ama no Habakiri Celestial Blade Magna Arrow Blade of the Heavens
species.profile: Told of in Oriental legends, it is the strongest destructive god and the god which governs over regeneration. It is told that when the Network System descends into chaos, it will erase the existing system, and create a new one. Its Special Moves are slicing and stabbing everything in the world with the sword of light emanated from the "" (Ama-no-Habakiri), and an ultimate technique in which it points the sword of light (emanated from the Yamata no Orochi) at the heavens, which then rain incessant bolts of lightning upon the ground (Yakusa-no-Ikazuchi).

species.name: Swanmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Bird Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Love". The appearance of its white body, long neck and wings spread out is divine. It has a habit of preferring to live in cold regions, and it is said that when Swanmon passes through the Network, computers "Freeze". It used to be a species that behaved in bevies, but lately it often acts alone. Although the cause is unknown, it is said that a rise in atmospheric temperature within the Digital World may be the reason. Its Special Move is "w=Down feather Tornado". It spreads its wings, and engulfs the opponent...

species.name: Swimmon
species.profile: A Tropical Fish Digimon with a brightly colored body. It inhabits and forms schools within the warm coral reefs right below the equator. Using its large fins, it is able to fly above the ocean's surface for short periods, and the sight of a school of Swimmon elegantly flying about the surface of the ocean is counted as one of the Digital World's three most scenic views. The scales that cover the surface of Swimmon's body have the special characteristic of matching their coloring to the colors of their surroundings, and in case it is attacked by a gigantic aquatic Digimon, it is capable of...

species.name: Symbare Angoramon
species.kanji: ジンバーアンゴラモン
species.profile: The Adult form of Angoramon that has shed the long, soft fur covering it in pursuit of agility. Although it has lost the defense offered by the cushioning fur that used to cover its body, its movements have become nimble. It strives for beauty in its behavior and movements, and in battle, it dodges the enemy's attacks as if it were dancing, in lockstep with its own attacks.Its Special Moves are dishing out a barrage of quick kicks while standing on one leg (w=Jive (dance)), spinning its body and slashing the enemy with the razor-sharp tips of its ears (w=Ländler), and unleashing a powerful...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Angoramon Dim Card)

species.name: Tactimon
species.debut: Digimon Xros Wars: "Taiki, Go to Another World!"

species.name: Tailmon
species.profile: It has a very healthy curiosity, so it loves pranks. Although its body is small, it is a precious Holy-species Digimon, and its appearance does not match the true strength it possesses. It wears a on its tail, proof that it is a Holy-species, but if this is lost, its power is decreased and it can no longer exhibit its original power. In order to defend itself, it wears long claws copied from Saber Leomon's data. Its Special Moves are using its long claws and attacking the opponent (Neko Punch), and manipulating the enemy with a piercing glare (Cat's Eye). Those who suffer this glare will...

species.name: Tailmon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: It has a very healthy curiosity, so it loves pranks. Although its body is small, it is a precious Holy-species Digimon, and its appearance does not match the true strength it possesses. It wears a on its tail, proof that it is a Holy-species, but if this is lost, its power is decreased and it can no longer exhibit its original power. In order to defend itself, it wears long claws copied from Saber Leomon's data. Its Special Move is using its long claws and attacking the opponent (Neko Punch).Its body has become smaller, its curiosity and desire to cause mischief have been enhanced even...

species.name: Takutoumon
species.zh: 毗沙门兽<small> - From "<small>(毗沙门天)</small>" the Chinese name of "" — one of the "".</small>
species.profile: A God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It is a hero who despises deceiving others, and uses its sword to resolve actions that deviate from the path of righteousness. It frequently imposes its own sense of justice onto others, and since it does not even make the effort to explain itself again, it often fights alone.It has abandoned dialogue with anyone else and remains extremely taciturn, possibly because it believes that one's own thoughts are enough as long as they make sense to oneself. When forced into a conservation with someone, Takutoumon's...

species.name: Takutoumon: Wrath Mode
species.kanji: タクトウモン：ラースモード
species.zh: 毗沙门兽：雷霆形态 <small>/</small> 毗沙门兽WM<small> - From "<small>(毗沙门天)</small>" the Chinese name of "" — one of the "".</small>
species.profile: The form that Takutoumon boldly Mode Changes into when throwing itself into great battles. The has materialized into armor, its white mouse-shaped mechanism has transformed into a trident, and its appearance is a manifestation of the data of an "Eastern God" who is identified with a legendary warrior.It amplifies its own power by releasing the vast amount of fighting spirit it had stolen and sealed within the all at once. However, it is an extremely aggressive and dangerous form that went into a state one can safely say is berserk as a result of gaining this immense power.The , which is now...

species.name: Tanemon
species.profile: A Bulb Digimon with something resembling plant sprout burgeoning from its head. It is a Yuramon that floated around in search of the optimal environment, then settled into the ground and evolved. Due to its extremely timid personality, the moment it senses an intruder's presence, it will burrow into the ground with its four feet and bury its main body beneath the surface. Once it is completely hidden underground, the thing growing from its head camouflages as a plant, allowing it to defend itself from intruders. However, this is ineffective against herbivorous Digimon.

species.name: Tankdramon
species.profile: A Machine Digimon which functions as the riot-suppression and assault-extermination for the mechanized "D-Brigade". It specializes in the extermination of hordes of "Targets", and it boasts overwhelming firepower. It is equipped with radar which is able to lock onto thirty "Targets" simultaneously, and if one Tankdramon supplements its "Targets" by data-linking to other Tankdramon, it is said to be impossible to escape. Also, its mission survival rate is very high, and it is said that so far only one has ever been shot down during a sortie. Its Special Move is its "" firing a shell loaded...

species.name: Tankmon
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon which has the appearance of a tank. Tankmon holds the alias of "", since it will assist both Vaccine and Virus Digimon as long as it is to its own benefit. With its heavyweight-power and the heavy artillery installed throughout its body, it pulverizes all approaching enemies into scrap. As it is extremely fond of strife, it chases after conflicts no matter where they occur. Wherever this lone wolf Digimon goes, conflict will never cease. Its Special Move is firing a super-powerful missile from the gun barrel on its head (Hyper Cannon).

species.name: Taotiemon
species.profile: An Oni Digimon whose body is covered in wool-like fur, wearing an object resembling a bronze ornament. While it is innocent like a child, it is an immature, cruel brat as a result.It can be seen floating and moving through the skies over Jakeizan like a cloud. It is in a constant state of hunger—perhaps due to it having a bug somewhere—and attempts to voraciously devour any prey that catches its eye. When it preys, the ornament on its head opens wide, revealing its terrifying maw.The talismans affixed to its head have confined it so that it can never leave Jakeizan. Because of this, it is...

species.name: Taowumon
species.profile: A Demon Beast Digimon that resembles a boar with enormous tree tusks, enveloped in freezing cold vapors. It is the largest and most sluggish among the Digimon referred to as the Shikyoju.It is usually buried underground, sleeping as stiff as ice, and rarely ever shows itself. Once it awakens, it disperses intense cold vapors from the skull on the tip of its tail, transforming its surroundings into a snowscape. It then rushes recklessly toward the outer perimeter of Jakeizan, doing nothing but ram into its unbreakable barrier over and over again.Traces of data from a Digimon—also known as...

species.name: Technodramon
species.debut: Second Original Digimon Contest (Digimon Web) (Unreleased Digimon)

species.name: Tekkamon
species.profile: A Digimon said to have been created by an evil hacker to destroy programs, in opposition to the "Net Keeper" Giromon. It wears a mask made of iron, and glares at its enemies with sharp eyes.Its Special Moves are cutting the enemy's configuration data in half with a terrifyingly sharp sword (Zandenken), and flinging itself after turning into a pachinko ball (Skull Stand).

species.name: Tempomon
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Impulse City Dim Card)

species.name: Tentomon
species.profile: The original type of Insect Digimon who, although it has a hard shell, still has low aggression. It has one hard claw on each of its fore-legs, and four on each of its middle- and hind-legs, and in particular, the middle-legs are able to skillfully grasp objects just like a human hand. Although the other Insects at its evolution level only possess fighting spirit, it still retains its naturally friendly sentiments, and displays its carefree way of life by doing things like sniffing the scent of flowers and napping in the shade of a tree. Its Special Move, which it possesses just in case, is...

species.name: Terriermon
species.profile: With one horn growing from its head, it is a Digimon shrouded in mystery. It can be classified as a Beast Digimon from its body structure, but it's still not understood what kind of evolved form it will take on. Also, it is rumored that it is sometimes born with a twin. It's a very cute type of Digimon, and from its calm behavior it's hard to believe that it is a "Combat Species" Digimon, but when it comes to battle, it shows that it is more powerful than it appears. Its Signature Move is generating a tiny tornado by spinning its ears like a propeller (Petit Twister). Its Special Move is...
species.debut: Digimon Adventure 02: Digimon Hurricane Touchdown!! Supreme Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

species.name: Terriermon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: With one horn growing from its head, it is a Digimon shrouded in mystery. It can be classified as a Beast Digimon from its body structure, but it's still not understood what kind of evolved form it will take on. Also, it is rumored that it is sometimes born with a twin. It's a very cute type of Digimon, and from its calm behavior it doesn't seem like a "Combat Species" Digimon, but in the case of battle, it shows that it is more powerful than it appears. Its Signature Move is generating a tiny tornado by spinning its ears like a propeller (Petit Twister). Its Special Move is spewing out a...

species.name: Terriermon Assistant
species.profile: A hardworking Terriermon that supports Agumon Hakase. It loves learning about Digimon species and their way of life, and telling people what it has learned most of all. In addition to "Petit Twister", its Signature Move is enlarging the badge on its chest and hurling it (Dai Bacchi Gū).

species.name: Tesla Jellymon
species.profile: The Adult form of Jellymon that has grown by absorbing data from combat sports like steel cage death matches while in search of stimulation and pleasure. Its electric shock techniques have been further enhanced, and there are even more techniques adapted from things such as karate and professional wrestling in the fighting it unleashes. It easily dodges the enemy's attacks by capitalizing on the softness of its body.Its Special Move is sending an electric shock stored in its palms through the enemy's vitals (w=Physalia physalis). In addition, it has "Punischöne", in which it shocks and...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Jellymon Dim Card)

species.name: Thetismon
species.profile: An Aquatic Beast Man Digimon which has the appearance of a woman, records show that it was discovered in the deepest trenches of the "Net Ocean", the birthplace of Digimon. It brings peace to its own vast territory, and immediately approaches and brings down the hammer on Digimon that tumultuously disturb it. Although it shows no mercy to those who invade its territory, it is kind to Digimon in need of help, guiding them to safety, and has a spirit that fights for the weak against the strong.It eliminates invaders with its "Birī Smasher", in which it sends its fists flying by accumulating...
species.debut: Vital Bracelet Digital Monster (Jellymon Dim Card)

species.name: Thunderballmon
species.profile: Also known as the "", this Mutation Digimon is conjectured to be a member of the Mamemon-species. Its tiny body has the properties of a magnet, and is always clad in electricity and discharging lightning. When under enemy attack, it fires spheres of discharged electricity at as much as 10 MV towards them (Thunder Ball).
species.debut: Digital Monster Digimon Stickers EX Collection

species.name: Thunderballmon (X-Antibody)
species.kanji: サンダーボールモン（X抗体）
species.profile: Also known as the "", it is a Mutation Digimon that is conjectured to be a member of the Mamemon-species. Its tiny body has the properties of a magnet, and is always clad in electricity and discharging lightning. It fires spheres of discharged electricity as much as 10 MV at opponents who are coming to attack it (Thunder Ball).Its electric power has increased, demonstrating its intense shocking power even with just a punch or a kick, and has the strength to make even large Digimon lose their fighing spirit. Its "Thunder Bomber", a combo technique composed of an "w=Anode Punch" and a...

species.name: Thunderbirmon
species.profile: A Giant Bird Digimon that "Armor Evolved" with the "Digimental of Friendship". It has the ability to summon thunder clouds with an echoing cry like thunder, and control thunder with the horn on its brow. Although it has a rough temperament, it has a caring nature for its comrades. Its Signature Move is firing out countless electrically-charged feathers like rain (Spark Wing). Its Special Move is flapping wings clad in electricity, generating a storm of lightning (Thunder Storm).

species.name: Tia Ludomon
species.profile: The evolved form of Ludomon, it has grown even more durable and attained outstanding speed. It dashes at high speed across battlefields, rescuing straggling Digimon who are no longer able to fight. It is capable of transforming itself into a shield to be wielded to aid in escaping the battlefield, protecting its wielder from any attack that comes their way. Tia Ludomon's shields have magical properties that allow it to erect barriers of ice, which freeze and nullify opponent attacks. Its Special Moves are throwing the shields on its arms (Frisbicker), and charging at high speed and...

species.name: Tiger Vespamon
species.kanji: タイガーヴェスパモン
species.profile: A Cyborg Digimon that defends the mysterious "aerial, covert honey base, Royal Base". Vespamon boasts an astounding degree of stamina that could not be imagined from its slight and thorny silhouette, and it never stops moving during combat. The best of the best, said to be the top 0.08%, are inducted into the "covert honey corps, Royal Commando", and awarded a codename. Its codename "" comes from the fact that it is by far the best in solo combat, and it wields twin blades shaped like tiger fangs, the "covert honey arms, ". Its Special Move is stinging the opponent with the twin blades,...

species.name: Tinkermon
species.profile: A Fairy Digimon that is always snuggling up to Petermon. It does its best to work with Petermon in building "Never-Ever Land", a world of children. It bounces around in the best of moods when it is with Petermon, but if it's ignored then it will angrily strike Petermon and then fly off somewhere. After that, it is happy to come looking for Petermon and meekly receive pampering. Tinkermon's wings shine, and because there is a change in the strength of the radiance when it is tense, looking at the wings' radiance is considered a good way to suss out Tinkermon's mood. It applies a paralytic...

species.name: Titamon
species.profile: The titan of revenge, Titamon, was born from the hatred of the Digimon defeated by the Olympos XII in battles over the sovereignty of the Digital World. It holds the alias of "", and bearing the inexhaustible energy of its hatred within its gigantic body, it runs through the battlefield seeking the heads of the Olympos XII. Its large arms are covered in a multitude of skulls, which are all data of the power it has stolen from the enemies it has defeated so far. As its gigantic sword "" is a bone sword carved from Skull Greymon's bones, the hatred filling the sword makes a low growl. The...

species.name: Titamon + Skull Baluchimon
species.kanji: タイタモン＋スカルバルキモン
species.profile: Titamon used its strength to overpower and tame Skull Baluchimon, who is thought to lack emotion. Titamon's mobility, which was its sole weakness, has also been compensated for, and the way it rushes freely across the battlefield makes it truly worthy of being called a fierce god. Normally, the cold black vapors flowing from Skull Baluchimon's Digicore instill the fear of death in those who come into contact with them, rendering them powerless. However, Titamon absorbed them as its own through its tenacious willpower. Also, by fusing with Skull Baluchimon's data, the has transformed from a...

species.name: Tobiumon
species.profile: An Aquatic Digimon that corners its targeted prey at high speed. Its oddly developed fins allow it to fly, and its large arms enable it to move on the ground. It holds the alias of "" from how it brings down its targets regardless of whether they are on land, in the sea, or in the air.After it slows down its prey with its "w=Suckerfish Darts", organic missiles fired from its abdomen, it finishes them off with its "Flying Finish", where it unleashes a high-speed slash attack with its sharp fins.

species.name: Tobucatmon
species.profile: A Puppet Digimon which has the appearance of a cat that flies about the Net Ocean. Although it has a rough temperament, it loves the ocean, and the "F⑭" engraved on its body is proof that it is a fighter Digimon despite its appearance, and it is said that only 1% of the strongest among Tobucatmon are known and respected as "". It is able to fly at high speed by folding its wings, and has a regular habit of flying where it flashes the claws on its right feet when turning right and flashes the claws on its left feet when turning left, but sometimes its movements are read by the enemy. Its...

species.name: Tocanmon
species.profile: An Armor-level Bird Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Kindness". It is a Bird Digimon that tends to stay in its shell, contrary to its flashy appearance. Its wings have degenerated due to it living on land for a long time, and so it became a flightless bird. When it feels anxious, it will try to duck its head and retreat into its shell, but can barely do so with its huge beak being in the way. However, when its anger exceeds a critical point, it will open its huge, colorful beak and raise its crest to act intimidating. Its body, which is covered by its shell, has...

species.name: Togemogumon
species.profile:
An Armor-level Mammal Digimon that evolved through the power of the "Digimental of Friendship". Ultra-low temperature ice crystals stick out from its back like a pincushion. Touching even one of these crystals is enough to freeze you in an instant, so simply defending itself has become its greatest offense. Togemogumon is sluggish, but because its defending is also an attack in itself, it is balanced in both offense and defense. Its Special Move is firing the crystals on its back all at once (Hail Machine Gun). 
*Togemogumon was adopted from a winning Digimon entry in the "Digimon Web...

species.name: Togemon
species.profile: A Plant Digimon which has the appearance of a gigantic cactus. It can store nutrient data within its body, and can even survive for a long time in the empty desert areas. What it's thinking usually can't be understood at all by trying to discern it from its facial expression, as it spends most of the day staring off into space. However, once Togemon is angered, that expression changes completely, it starts getting violent, and it becomes unable to settle down. Its Special Move is further hardening the thorns on the ends of its arms and bang-bang striking with them (Chikuchiku Bang-bang).

species.name: Togemon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A Plant Digimon which has the appearance of a gigantic cactus. It can store nutrient data within its body, and can even survive for a long time in the empty desert areas. What it's thinking usually can't be understood at all by trying to discern it from its facial expression, as it spends most of the day staring off into space. However, once Togemon is angered, that expression changes completely, it starts getting violent, and it becomes unable to settle down. Its Special Move is further hardening the thorns on the ends of its arms and bang-bang striking with them (Chikuchiku...

species.name: Tokomon
species.profile: A tiny Digimon with limb-like protrusions growing beneath its body (head?). Baby Digimon that have grown limbs are extremely rare, and their appearance is enormously cute. However, caution must be taken; should one carelessly reach a hand out to it just because of its cuteness, it will suddenly open its mouth wide and bite with the closely packed fangs growing within. Having said that, it bears no ill will and has a very innocent personality.

species.name: Tokomon (X-Antibody)
species.profile: A tiny Digimon with limb-like protrusions growing beneath its body (head?). Baby Digimon that have grown limbs are extremely rare, and their appearance is enormously cute. However, caution should be taken in reaching out to it with one's hand just because of its cuteness, as it will suddenly open its mouth wide and bite with the fangs growing closely packed within. Having said that, it bears no ill will and has a very innocent personality.It is rare for a Baby to take in the X-Antibody, so it is often targeted by other Digimon. However, it has adopted a valiant personality and is not...

species.name: Tonosama Mamemon
species.profile: A Mamemon that read jidaigeki video data and mutated. Easygoing and always cheerful, it drags around its hakama, which it has difficulty walking in, and constantly falls over, rolls, and gets tangled up in it, making onlookers laugh and bringing joy to their hearts. It is magnanimous in that it welcomes any Digimon that comes to its castle, but once a Digimon that disturbs the area around the castle appears, it will... punish them without mercy... while rolling. In its Special Move "Appare Zakura", which is unleashed from its fan, it judges the enemy's wrongdoing with cherry blossoms that...

species.name: Torikara Ballmon
species.profile: A Digimon born from deep-fried food recipe data. Because it flies while giving off a delicious, lingering aroma, it seems that if Torikara Ballmon is nearby, other Digimon around it will feel more hungry. When chased by hungry Digimon, it blows "Shokubutsusei no Awa" from its mouth to make them slippery and files away, leaving only its scent behind while hindering their movements.

species.name: Toropiamon
species.profile: A Plant Digimon that inhabits jungles. It is thought to have evolved into this gaudy appearance by taking in the data of various trees and fruits. Its scent, which is like a mixture of all kinds of fruits, is so intense that those who are not used to it will get knocked out cold. The droplets secreted from its leaves, which act as wings, are so toxic that they can even dissolve iron.Its Special Move is dispersing a large amount of explosive pollen from the petals around its neck (Petally Carnage). Also, its "Tropical Venom", a gas spewed out of its mouth, is a potent poison that matures...

species.name: Tortamon
species.profile: A tortoise-type Digimon armed with a shell covered in sharp blades. As both its shell and body are highly dense, it is heavier than it looks, such that it creates fierce tremors with every step it takes. Furthermore, it holds the alias "" due to its shrill, metallic-sounding cry. While its usual walking movements are extremely slow, it can retract its limbs so that its body is in the shape of a disc and spin itself, allowing it to move at ten times its usual speed. Its Special Move is firing the blades on its shell as if they were multiple-warhead missiles (Shell Phalanx).

species.name: Toy Agumon
species.profile: A unique Digimon whose whole body is made up of unique plastic blocks. It is said that a child playing on the Internet created it to resemble Agumon's appearance, and so it is very cute. Unlike the confident Agumon, it has a cowardly side, and its blocks fall apart when it is surprised. However, it possesses a heart of justice that cannot turn a blind eye to evil. Also, it absolutely loves children, and enjoys communicating with them over the Net. Its Special Move is firing a flame-shaped toy missile (Toy Flame). It is fairly powerful.

species.name: Toy Agumon (Black)
species.profile: A Toy Agumon that has been dyed black. It was infected by a computer virus on the Network, and turned into a toy that bullies children. Its Special Move is firing a mini-missile in the shape of a flame (Toy Flame).

species.name: Trailmon Angler
species.kanji: トレイルモン アングラー
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "The Legendary Warrior! Agnimon of Fire"

species.name: Trailmon Ball
species.kanji: トレイルモン ボール
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: Revival of the Ancient Digimon!!

species.name: Trailmon Battle Form
species.kanji: トレイルモン戦闘フォーム
species.debut: Digimon Next: "The City of Light, Light City!"

species.name: Trailmon Buffalo
species.kanji: トレイルモン バッファロー
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "Thunder Power Shaking the Ground, Blitzmon!"

species.name: Trailmon Franken
species.kanji: トレイルモン フランケン
species.debut: Digimon Frontier: "Bullying is Unforgivable! Evolve, Chackmon of Ice"

species.name: Trailmon Kettle
species.kanji: トレイルモン ケトル
